|Total Redistribution: 159 Stanchions across 27 Phonemes|
|Status: Complete.|
THUMP!
THUMP!
THUMP!
Noah’s heart thundered with each Phoneme that finalized its absorption, each beat sending shockwaves across Muspelheim that made the obsidian flames dance in patterns they had never formed before!
The assembled Muspeli Lifeforms watched with eyes wide and flames flickering, witnessing something that their ancestors had only spoken of in whispered legends!
THE Infiniverse trembled as she felt her connection to Noah shift and deepen!
Khor’s abyssal eyes widened with genuine surprise, her ancient perception recognizing that what she was witnessing had never occurred in all the eons she had existed!
Sigrid’s ordered flames burned brighter in response to the restructuring occurring within the one she loved!
|Convergence Complete|
|Your existence has been fundamentally restructured.|
|Previous Foundation: 159 THE Stanchions of Infinity serving as scattered pillars|
|Current Foundation: 27 Phonemic Singularities containing all previous authority in concentrated form|
|Assessment: Your foundation IS The First Tongue.
They are now inseparable and indistinguishable.|
|You are THE First Tongue made manifest.|
|THE First Tongue is you given voice.|
The moment the convergence completed, Noah’s existence ignited!
His body burned with blue-gold plasma that was less fire and more pure concentrated authority given visible form!
His eyes shot beams of light upward into the burning skies of Muspelheim as if his very perception had become too powerful to be contained!
His mouth opened and he ROARED!
The sound that emerged was not merely loud.
It was linguistic!
It carried Phonemes that had never been spoken together before, twenty-seven notes of a chord that existence itself had to bend to accommodate!
Above him, a radiant Grimoire materialized and opened with pages that burned with inscriptions shifting between all twenty-seven Phonemes in endless permutation!

chapters.title: Chapter 4739: Seals! II
paragraphs: THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons had transformed alongside him!
And this single Grimoire put a heavy strain on the surrounding atmosphere due to how immense it was!
Heavy!
IMMENSE!

The air around Noah compressed and distorted as if unable to bear the weight. The obsidian flames of Muspelheim bent toward him! The very fabric of this primordial realm groaned under the pressure of what he had become!
|Critical Threshold Exceeded|
|The weight of your Way and Civilization has spilled past what THE Creature or THE Primordial Chaos were able to accomplish at Intermediate Depth.|
|Previous Comparative Weight: 100/100th of THE Creature at Intermediate Depth|
|Current Comparative Weight: 150/100th|
|Your Weight continues to rise far past any established parameters of this stage, seeking a foothold at THE Fundamental Depth in a manner nobody else has taken before.|
| You are becoming heavier through linguistic perfection, through foundational elegance, through becoming something that existence has never had to bear before.|
BOOM!
The weight continued to build as something new began to emerge within Noah’s restructured existence!
|Physique Emergence Detected|
|Your Phonemic Convergence has triggered an unforeseen development.|
|When foundation becomes perfect, when every component serves its ideal purpose without redundancy, the result is not merely a stronger existence but a fundamentally different category of existence.|
|You are developing a Foundational Physique.|
|Physique Designation: THE Indestructible Lexicon of Absolute Weight|

|This is not a physique of flesh and blood. This is a physique of linguistic authority made manifest. Your body has become a vessel for the 27 Phonemic Singularities, and each Singularity carries the concentrated weight of everything it absorbed.|
|THE Indestructible Lexicon of Absolute Weight - Complete Analysis|
|Core Nature:|
|Your physique is composed of 27 Phonemic Singularities. These Singularities are now designated asTHE 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue.|

|Each Seal contains:|
|- Multiple former Stanchions compressed into singular expression|
|- Direct connection to its corresponding Phoneme of The First Tongue|
|- Weight that scales with the totality of what it represents|
|Physique Capabilities:|
|FIRST CAPABILITY: Singular Expression|

|You may express any single Seal with all its accumulated weight. When you invoke The Seal of Infinity, you invoke every concept of boundlessness absorbed into it. When you invoke The Seal of Fortune, you invoke all Stanchions within it simultaneously.|
|A single Seal carries the weight that once required multiple Stanchions to express.|
|SECOND CAPABILITY: Weighted Declarations|

|Your Declarations and Thesis constructs can now be geared toward specific Seals naturally. A Declaration invoking The Seal of Tyranny carries the combined weight of dominion and sovereignty compressed into linguistic perfection.|
|These Weighted Declarations are inherently heavier than normal Declarations. They press down upon reality with force that conventional authority cannot match.|
|THIRD CAPABILITY: The Crushing Depth|

|Your Formless Depth now expresses itself through weight rather than conventional measurements. When you exert your Depth, you crush enemies beneath the accumulated heaviness of 27 Seals bearing down simultaneously.|
|Everything on your path will be flattened when you choose to exert the full heaviness of THE Indestructible Lexicon of Absolute Weight.|
|FOURTH CAPABILITY: Seal Resonance|

|Multiple Seals may be invoked in combination, their weights multiplying rather than merely adding. Invoking The Seal of Fire alongside The Seal of Hunger creates pressure that exceeds what either could produce alone.|
|FIFTH CAPABILITY: Gravitational Presence|

|Your mere existence now carries passive weight. Lesser beings in your presence will feel the pressure of your physique bearing down upon them. Those with insufficient foundation will find it difficult to stand, to breathe, to maintain coherent thought.|
|This is not an attack. This is simply what you are now. Heavy. Immense. Inescapable. Fat!|
|Physique Classification: Unprecedented|
|No entity in recorded existence has developed a physique through Phonemic Convergence. You have developed yours through becoming The First Tongue incarnate.|
Noah floated in the burning skies of Muspelheim as his transformation completed, his body wrapped in blue-gold plasma that distorted space itself.
The 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue pulsed within his existence like stars arranged in a constellation that spelled out his name in the oldest language.
Heavy.
He had become so impossibly heavy.
When he breathed, the air compressed around him. When he moved, reality bent to accommodate his passage. When he merely existed, everything nearby felt the weight of what he had become.
The Grimoire above him burned with light displaying the 27 Seals in arrangements that shifted with each heartbeat.
|Edict-Pillar Integration: Complete|
|Archai Infusion: Complete|
|All three proposals have been successfully implemented.|
|Your Way of THE Mana Architect is now a seamless whole.|
Noah opened his eyes fully, and they blazed with weight that made even the Fundamental Depth Muspeli Lifeforms present take involuntary steps backward.
He smiled.
And even that simple expression carried heaviness that made the obsidian flames around him flatten as if pressed down by invisible hands.
There was still no celebration.
But there was satisfaction that bordered on joy.
And there was still much more to be done because...sheesh!
THE 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue!

Noah felt them pulsing within his existence like twenty-seven hearts beating in perfect synchronization, each one carrying weight that pressed against the fabric of reality itself. They were not separate from him. They were him. Twenty-seven concentrated expressions of everything he had become, everything he represented, everything he would continue to build.
The Seal of Fire burned with primordial heat that predated combustion itself.
The Seal of Infinity stretched toward horizons that had no end.
The Seal of Tyranny pressed down with authority that demanded submission from existence.
The Seal of Narrative whispered of stories yet to be written and protagonists yet to rise.

Each one was heavy. Each one was profound. Each one was a pillar of his foundation that could now be expressed with concentrated force that his previous scattered Stanchions could never have achieved.
Noah waved his hand soon after as he focused on one Seal in particular.
THE Absolute Seal of Infinity.
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4740: Seals! III
paragraphs: The Seal bloomed into existence above his palm, and the moment it manifested, Galileo and Surtra were pushed back in astonishment as waves of pressure erupted from its mere presence!
Duke whimpered slightly before sitting in the air with eyes of veneration, the golden retriever’s tail tucked as he recognized something far beyond his current comprehension.

The Seal itself was circular in form, perhaps three meters in diameter, and it burned with countless intricate blue-gold lines that wove patterns of impossible complexity across its surface. The lines and strokes within seemingly gave meaning to the Phoneme of Infinity while also containing within them the pillars of his foundation that had been absorbed into this singular expression.
Where one line ended, another began without interruption.
Where one pattern seemed to reach completion, it folded back into itself and continued forever.

The very act of looking at this Seal conveyed the concept it represented, boundlessness made visible, endlessness given form, infinity compressed into something that could actually be perceived by minds that were not built to comprehend such things.
And within those infinite patterns, Noah could sense the Stanchions that now resided here. All of them compressed and refined and made more powerful through their merger into this singular Seal.

The radiant Seal of Infinity spun above him with slow majesty, and he understood that he could do many things with it. He could use it to attack, unleashing the full weight of infinity upon enemies who would be crushed beneath concepts they could not comprehend. He could use it to defend, wrapping himself in boundlessness that could not be breached. He could make Declarations or Thesis constructs through it, speaking words of infinity that would carry weight no normal Declaration could match.
But what struck him most was how heavy the Seal felt as it exerted pressure all around that was stifling!
Space itself creaked beneath the Seal’s presence, reality groaning as if it were saying with exhausted desperation: bro, you’re fucking heavy!

The obsidian flames of Muspelheim bent away from the Seal as if afraid to touch it. The air compressed into visible distortions. Even the other Fundamental Depth entities present had to brace themselves against the weight that radiated from this single expression of Noah’s foundation.
As Noah analyzed this Seal with eyes that burned with understanding...
|Harvest Threshold Achieved|
|With the establishment of your foundation integrated ever so closer with THE First Tongue, a new source of Infinite Potential has become accessible.|
|30% of The Infinite Potential generated by the usage of The First Tongue across existence, both in the present and the past, has begun to be harvested by the Arche of Perpetual Harvest.|
|Not a single drop of potential will be unaccounted for.|

|Every being that speaks a Phoneme. Every Declaration that invokes The First Tongue. Every Thesis that draws upon linguistic authority. 30% of the potential generated by these actions now flows to you as The One Who Laid The Claim.|
|As control over The First Tongue continues to be cemented and your Depth rises evermore, all 100% of The Infinite Potential of the Usage of The First Tongue will be yours.|
|Contextual Assessment:|
|Because THE Creature, THE Living Paradox, and THE Primordial Chaos likely actively enjoy the harvest of their own claims, consider what they receive:|
|THE Creature harvests from all those existing and moving across existence. Everything that lives, everything that moves, everything that simply IS contributes to his power.|
|THE Living Paradox harvests from all paradoxical actions or existences. Every contradiction, every impossibility made real, every truth that should not be true feeds his authority.|
|THE Primordial Chaos harvests from everything chaotic and filled with disorder. Which is fucking everything, because entropy touches all things eventually.|
|It is maddening to realize how powerful they are and how many boons they have been enjoying for eons as you get closer to them.|
|You’re gonna need to do a lot to get close to them, big guy.|
Ruination continued to have fun with her prompts as Noah felt an influx of Infinite Potential gush down into his existence!

It filled his Formless Depth even more, pouring into the 27 Seals and making them burn brighter, making them grow heavier, making his weight continue to become even more imposing with each passing moment.
The Depth of his Civilization skipped past THE Surface Depth and settled far into Intermediate Depth as his personal Weight spilled toward Fundamental Depth!
It was a fucking glorious thing!
As he felt all of this, as he basked in the sensation of power flooding into him from sources that would never run dry...
"This..."

Galileo’s voice emerged with shining eyes of interest and wonder as he looked at the Seal spinning above Noah’s palm. His large ears were fully erect, his whiskers twitching with excitement that his Fundamental Depth perception could not fully contain.
"This feels without a doubt to be a Phoneme of The First Tongue, and yet it does not match any of the Phonemes of The First Tongue that I know!"
His fluffy form practically vibrated with scholarly curiosity as he floated closer, Duke padding through the air beside him with ears perked forward.
"Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Void, Light, Darkness, Life, Death, Time, Space, Order, Chaos, Unity, Division, Beginning, Ending, Paradox. These are the 18 Phonemes. This is not any of them!"
His words were grand as toward this observation, Noah looked at the ancient Muspeli Lifeform with calm tyranny burning in his gaze.
"This is just one of the 9 new Phonemes I have recently designed."
His voice carried weight that matched the Seal spinning above him.
"The First Tongue is no longer just made up of 18 Phonemes."
The words caused an immense silence to descend across the burning skies of Muspelheim.
Galileo looked at him with widening eyes that seemed to grow larger with each passing moment, his fluffy features frozen in an expression of absolute disbelief.
Surtra trembled in the distance, her sandy flames flickering erratically!
The other Fundamental Depth Muspeli Lifeform beside her went still as stone.
The Intermediate Depth giants who had been watching from a respectful distance felt their flames gutter and surge as understanding began to dawn.
The Surface Depth Muspeli Lifeforms looked at each other with expressions that ranged from confusion to dawning horror to something that might have been fervor.

In the next moment, all the Muspeli Lifeforms played his words in their minds again and again, parsing them for any possible misinterpretation, searching for any way that they could have misunderstood what THE Genesis Monarch had just claimed.
But there was no misunderstanding.
He forged new letters of The First Tongue.

The First Tongue, which had existed since before differentiation. The First Tongue, which had been complete and perfect and unchanging for eons beyond counting. The First Tongue, which the Muspeli Lifeforms had dedicated their entire existence to protecting and preserving.
He had added to it.
What the fuck!?
THUNK!
Galileo’s knees hit a metaphorical floor in the skies of Muspelheim as he knelt toward Noah, Duke immediately following suit by lowering his golden body into a bow!
THUNK!
Surtra descended to her knees with sandy flames billowing around her in patterns of absolute submission!
THUNK! THUNK! THUNK!

The other Muspeli Lifeforms followed, Fundamental and Intermediate and Surface Depth alike, all of them kneeling in the burning air as the full weight of what they had just learned settled upon their ancient consciousnesses!
He forged new letters of The First Tongue!
The moment this was affirmed, all that they knew was undeniable!

He was not merely The One Who Laid The Claim. He was not merely the leader of Muspelheim by right of linguistic authority. He was someone who had done what no entity in all of existence had ever done before!
He had expanded the very language that reality was written in!
So at this moment, the Muspeli Lifeforms knelt toward THE Genesis Monarch with reverence!
Noah looked at this scene calmly, taking in the sight of ancient beings kneeling themselves before him, and he was about to tell them to stop this, when...
|URGENT NOTIFICATION|
|With the establishment of your foundation integrated ever so closer with THE First Tongue, capabilities that were impossible before are becoming possible now.|
|Through your integrated connection, The First Tongue senses across the murkiness of the Wastes of THE Fallout.|
|The Wastes are filled with chaotic energies that prevent communication absolutely. No signal should pass through. No awareness should penetrate. And yet...|
|The First Tongue senses the potential collapse of pillars of your Civilization.|

|Little information has been obtained due to your current Depth and Weight pitted against the Absolute rejection of communications and weavings across existence. The murkiness resists. The chaos interferes. But fragments have emerged.|
|Information Obtained:|
|Ul’moreth and Lumivara face the weavings of an entity identified as Gilgamesh.|
|At this time, signs of an Absolute identified as THE Weavers have made their descent.|
|These pillars of your Civilization are in peril and face a high chance of cessation and collapse.|
|It is unknown where they are.|
|It is unknown if this is slightly in the past, ongoing present, or future.|
|The murkiness obscures temporal positioning as thoroughly as it obscures spatial location.|
|What is known: They need help. And you cannot currently reach them.|
Noah’s expression became heavy as his eyes pulsed with immensity that erupted from him in waves he could not fully control!

Multiple THE Surface Depth Muspeli Lifeforms fainted from this accidental eruption of his tyrannical pressure, their ancient forms slumping in the air as their consciousnesses simply could not withstand the weight of his sudden surge!
Ul’moreth.
Lumivara!

His hands clenched into fists as blue-gold flames erupted around him with intensity that made even the Fundamental Depth entities present flinch, and the Seal of Infinity spinning above him pulsed with his weight as twenty-seven Seals resonated!

|30% of The Infinite Potential generated by the usage of The First Tongue across existence, both in the present and the past, has begun to be harvested by the Arche of Perpetual Harvest.|
|Not a single drop of potential will be unaccounted for.|
|Every being that speaks a Phoneme.
Every Declaration that invokes The First Tongue.
Every Thesis that draws upon linguistic authority.
30% of the potential generated by these actions now flows to you as The One Who Laid The Claim.|
|As control over The First Tongue continues to be cemented and your Depth rises evermore, all 100% of The Infinite Potential of the Usage of The First Tongue will be yours.|
|Contextual Assessment:|
|Because THE Creature, THE Living Paradox, and THE Primordial Chaos likely actively enjoy the harvest of their own claims, consider what they receive:|
|THE Creature harvests from all those existing and moving across existence.
Everything that lives, everything that moves, everything that simply IS contributes to his power.|
|THE Living Paradox harvests from all paradoxical actions or existences.
Every contradiction, every impossibility made real, every truth that should not be true feeds his authority.|
|THE Primordial Chaos harvests from everything chaotic and filled with disorder.
Which is fucking everything, because entropy touches all things eventually.|
|It is maddening to realize how powerful they are and how many boons they have been enjoying for eons as you get closer to them.|
|You’re gonna need to do a lot to get close to them, big guy.|
Ruination continued to have fun with her prompts as Noah felt an influx of Infinite Potential gush down into his existence!

It filled his Formless Depth even more, pouring into the 27 Seals and making them burn brighter, making them grow heavier, making his weight continue to become even more imposing with each passing moment.
The Depth of his Civilization skipped past THE Surface Depth and settled far into Intermediate Depth as his personal Weight spilled toward Fundamental Depth!
It was a fucking glorious thing!
As he felt all of this, as he basked in the sensation of power flooding into him from sources that would never run dry...
"This..."
Galileo’s voice emerged with shining eyes of interest and wonder as he looked at the Seal spinning above Noah’s palm.
His large ears were fully erect, his whiskers twitching with excitement that his Fundamental Depth perception could not fully contain.
"This feels without a doubt to be a Phoneme of The First Tongue, and yet it does not match any of the Phonemes of The First Tongue that I know!"
His fluffy form practically vibrated with scholarly curiosity as he floated closer, Duke padding through the air beside him with ears perked forward.
"Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Void, Light, Darkness, Life, Death, Time, Space, Order, Chaos, Unity, Division, Beginning, Ending, Paradox.
These are the 18 Phonemes.
This is not any of them!"
His words were grand as toward this observation, Noah looked at the ancient Muspeli Lifeform with calm tyranny burning in his gaze.
"This is just one of the 9 new Phonemes I have recently designed."
His voice carried weight that matched the Seal spinning above him.
"The First Tongue is no longer just made up of 18 Phonemes."
The words caused an immense silence to descend across the burning skies of Muspelheim.
Galileo looked at him with widening eyes that seemed to grow larger with each passing moment, his fluffy features frozen in an expression of absolute disbelief.
Surtra trembled in the distance, her sandy flames flickering erratically!
The other Fundamental Depth Muspeli Lifeform beside her went still as stone.
The Intermediate Depth giants who had been watching from a respectful distance felt their flames gutter and surge as understanding began to dawn.
The Surface Depth Muspeli Lifeforms looked at each other with expressions that ranged from confusion to dawning horror to something that might have been fervor.

In the next moment, all the Muspeli Lifeforms played his words in their minds again and again, parsing them for any possible misinterpretation, searching for any way that they could have misunderstood what THE Genesis Monarch had just claimed.
But there was no misunderstanding.
He forged new letters of The First Tongue.
The First Tongue, which had existed since before differentiation.
The First Tongue, which had been complete and perfect and unchanging for eons beyond counting.
The First Tongue, which the Muspeli Lifeforms had dedicated their entire existence to protecting and preserving.
He had added to it.
What the fuck!?
THUNK!
Galileo’s knees hit a metaphorical floor in the skies of Muspelheim as he knelt toward Noah, Duke immediately following suit by lowering his golden body into a bow!
THUNK!
Surtra descended to her knees with sandy flames billowing around her in patterns of absolute submission!
THUNK!
THUNK!
THUNK!

The other Muspeli Lifeforms followed, Fundamental and Intermediate and Surface Depth alike, all of them kneeling in the burning air as the full weight of what they had just learned settled upon their ancient consciousnesses!
He forged new letters of The First Tongue!
The moment this was affirmed, all that they knew was undeniable!
He was not merely The One Who Laid The Claim.
He was not merely the leader of Muspelheim by right of linguistic authority.
He was someone who had done what no entity in all of existence had ever done before!
He had expanded the very language that reality was written in!
So at this moment, the Muspeli Lifeforms knelt toward THE Genesis Monarch with reverence!
Noah looked at this scene calmly, taking in the sight of ancient beings kneeling themselves before him, and he was about to tell them to stop this, when...
|URGENT NOTIFICATION|
|With the establishment of your foundation integrated ever so closer with THE First Tongue, capabilities that were impossible before are becoming possible now.|
|Through your integrated connection, The First Tongue senses across the murkiness of the Wastes of THE Fallout.|
|The Wastes are filled with chaotic energies that prevent communication absolutely.
No signal should pass through.
No awareness should penetrate.
And yet...|
|The First Tongue senses the potential collapse of pillars of your Civilization.|
|Little information has been obtained due to your current Depth and Weight pitted against the Absolute rejection of communications and weavings across existence.
The murkiness resists.
The chaos interferes.
But fragments have emerged.|
|Information Obtained:|
|Ul’moreth and Lumivara face the weavings of an entity identified as Gilgamesh.|
|At this time, signs of an Absolute identified as THE Weavers have made their descent.|
|These pillars of your Civilization are in peril and face a high chance of cessation and collapse.|
|It is unknown where they are.|
|It is unknown if this is slightly in the past, ongoing present, or future.|
|The murkiness obscures temporal positioning as thoroughly as it obscures spatial location.|
|What is known: They need help.
And you cannot currently reach them.|
Noah’s expression became heavy as his eyes pulsed with immensity that erupted from him in waves he could not fully control!

Multiple THE Surface Depth Muspeli Lifeforms fainted from this accidental eruption of his tyrannical pressure, their ancient forms slumping in the air as their consciousnesses simply could not withstand the weight of his sudden surge!
Ul’moreth.
Lumivara!

His hands clenched into fists as blue-gold flames erupted around him with intensity that made even the Fundamental Depth entities present flinch, and the Seal of Infinity spinning above him pulsed with his weight as twenty-seven Seals resonated!

chapters.title: Chapter 4741: Give and Take! I
paragraphs: Muspelheim continued to steadily be devoured into the blue-gold monolith.

Ancient flames that had burned since before differentiation were being unmade piece by piece, compressed into that impossible structure Noah had willed into existence. Rivers of molten authority flowed upward against every natural law, drawn toward something that defied conventional understanding as it all flowed to THE Infiniverse!
And yet there was a heavy, suffocating silence that nobody could explain.
All the Muspeli Lifeforms present looked toward Noah!
Noah who at this moment turned in the direction where Galileo and Duke had come from, his expression shifting into something cold and calculating.
THE Living Concept was out there. Assaulting. Killing. Treating Muspeli Lifeforms like obstacles to be swept aside with casual indifference.
But that wasn’t what made his blood blaze the most.
Lumivara and Ul’moreth were somewhere in the Wastes of THE Fallout. He didn’t know where. Couldn’t sense them through the corrupted mess that separated different regions of post-Fallout Existence.
And an Absolute bore down upon them.
THE Weaver.
Not a Half-Step embarrassment like THE Living Spirit. A genuine, categorical Absolute operating at THE Absolute Depth of Existence itself.
Noah’s mind raced.

He had one body here in Muspelheim. Another in The Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature. A third moving through THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap to retrieve Eon’s Disciple as part of their tenuous arrangement.

Existence post-Fallout was heavily resistant to clones. The corrupted fabric of reality itself seemed to reject the multiplication of singular existences, as if the laws governing identity had been rewritten specifically to be a pain in the ass.
But Noah continued to defy restrictions.
He should be able to deploy another body to the Wastes of THE Fallout. Should be able to seek the location of Lumivara and Ul’moreth despite barriers that would’ve stopped anyone else cold.
His eyes blazed with Tyranny!

The newly forged Seals threatened to spill out with his immense weight, each one pulsing beneath his skin like caged beasts demanding release. Twenty-seven concentrated expressions of everything he had become, everything he represented, everything he would continue to build.

And what was unique here, what set him apart from any reasonable existence facing such circumstances, was that he knew an Absolute was bearing down on his people...and he was still planning to go there anyway.
Not fearful or hesitant!
Fear was for those who had something to lose and no way to protect it. Noah had everything to lose and the absolute conviction that he’d find a way regardless.
But...
He had to have a plan.

It was great and all not to be fearful. Tyranny demanded nothing less than absolute confidence in the face of impossible odds. But if he simply threw a body into an Absolute’s hands without preparation, without strategy, without understanding what he was actually facing...
How catastrophic would the results be?
And yet Ul’moreth and Lumivara couldn’t be collapsed!
Ul’moreth had given him knowledge of The First Tongue that fundamentally transformed his understanding of Existence itself.
Lumivara, that little fox, also could not die!
They were pillars of his Civilization.
He would not allow them to fall.
So he had to come up with a solution against an Absolute.

Blue-gold plasma began bleeding from his form, swirling around him like the corona of an angry star. His hair lifted. His robes rippled in winds that existed only for him. The 27 Seals pulsed with barely contained tyranny within him as space itself compressed around his figure.
He looked like an angered celestial fiend whose wrath could unmake countless folds.
He felt like one too.
"Utilize the Full Moirai Thread."
HUUM!
The words resonated through Existence with weight that made nearby Muspeli Lifeforms take involuntary steps backward!
Above Noah’s existence, reality itself seemed to part like curtains being drawn aside by invisible hands.
A massive golden thread bloomed into manifestation!
This wasn’t the single Fragment he’d used before. This wasn’t the partial glimpse into potential futures that had shown him THE Secretive Eon and the dangers of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.
This was the combined Thread from nine Fragments, woven together into something that pulsed with the authority of fate itself!
The Thread was thick as a river of liquid gold. Each pattern represented a different branch of the infinite tree of potential futures, a different answer to questions that hadn’t yet been asked.
It descended toward Noah with the inevitability of destiny accepting a challenge.
|Full Moirai Thread Activation Initiated.|
|Nine Fragments have been combined into a Complete Thread.|
|This represents the maximum possible extraction from THE Existential Paradox Loop without direct interface.|
|Capability: Complete Simulation of potential futures until point of collapse or death.|
|Unlike Partial Simulation, Full Simulation provides:|
|- Comprehensive detail rather than fragmentary glimpses|
|- Extended temporal range of observable futures|
|-Ability to explore branching decision points with your own inputs|
|- Full sensory and cognitive immersion in simulated events|
|Warning: Full Simulation is not reality.|
|Events observed may not occur exactly as shown.|
|Decisions made in simulation do not bind future actions.|
|However, information gathered represents highest probability outcomes based on current trajectory.|
|Initiating Full Simulation of THE Existential Paradox Loop...|
The golden Thread shot forward and pierced Noah’s chest!

His entire existence shuddered as the Thread wrapped around his heart with pressure that made his previous partial experience feel like a gentle caress. His consciousness expanded outward in directions that had no names, perceiving possibilities that hadn’t yet crystallized into actualities.
His eyes glazed completely gold.
|Full Simulation Active.|
|Current Objective Detected: Finding solution to stand against THE Weaver, an Absolute of THE Living Paradox.|
|Simulation will explore decision branches related to this objective.|
|Beginning primary sequence...|
|Timeline Analysis: Primary Branch|
|Seeking additional resources and information before direct confrontation.|
|Your consciousness extends across your multiple deployed bodies simultaneously.|
|One body remains in Muspelheim overseeing consumption.|
|One body remains in The Early Veiled Shore maintaining Civilization operations.|
|One body moves through THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap.|
|Potential Decision Point:Leverage existing alliance with THE Secretive Eon for assistance against Absolute-class threat.|
|Executing decision branch...|

chapters.title: Chapter 4742: Give and Take! II
paragraphs: The simulation crystallized around Noah’s perception with perfect clarity.

He found himself in the Stoa of Dogmata, the endless colonnade of ancient pillars stretching in all directions. Their surfaces still burned with inscriptions of Dogmata from eras that predated differentiation itself.
And there, exactly where she’d been during their previous encounters, sat THE Secretive Eon.

Her small, delicate form remained composed upon the obsidian ground. Dark hair with rivers of gold caught light that seemed to come from nowhere. Her white-blue robe draped across her shoulders with elegant simplicity. Those dark eyes held depths that could swallow entire civilizations without noticing.
She didn’t turn as his simulated body approached.
"You have returned quickly, Scale Breaker."Her voice emerged measured and unhurried."I find myself wondering how you have so much time on your hands to play around."
Noah moved to take position near her, maintaining the distance their previous interactions had established.
"I collapsed the Half-Step Absolute Depth body of THE Living Spirit."

THE Secretive Eon received this news with the same composure she showed toward everything. Her head inclined slightly in acknowledgment, a fraction of movement that somehow conveyed complete understanding of what such an achievement represented.

"You are one of the Four from The Oldest Paradox of Existence," she said, her voice carrying neither surprise nor particular interest. "The First Tongue, Existence, Paradox, and Chaos. The pillars upon which that ancient conflict was built."
Her gaze remained fixed on the distant expanse ahead.

"If you weren’t even able to find a way to handle Spirit while holding a Fragment of an Axiom, you would truly be far too weak. You would not measure up to the others who share your classification among the Four."The faintest hint of contempt touched her words.
Noah absorbed these words while formulating his next approach.
"In Muspelheim, THE Living Concept is also present. They seemed to have been sent by Paradox specifically to that location."
THE Secretive Eon nodded with nonchalant dismissal.
"Picking off Primordial Realms of others and whatever Fragments of Axioms they may contain is natural." Her tone suggested she was discussing weather patterns rather than systematic destruction.
"Muspelheim held treasures from before THE Fallout reshaped Existence, from before The Infinite Unfurling. Of course Paradox would send agents to claim what could be claimed."
Noah observed that this information produced absolutely no interest in Eon.
Her attention remained fixed on whatever she perceived in the distant depths of the Stoa. Her composure was unbroken!
So he shifted approaches entirely.
"In the Wastes of THE Fallout, an Absolute is making a move against members of my Civilization."
Nothing.
"THE Weaver,"Noah continued. "One of Paradox’s instruments operating at THE Absolute Depth. They bear down upon pillars of my foundation."
He let those words settle before delivering his request.

"Since they’re an Absolute, they’re one of your targets. One of those who need to die according to the objectives you pursue."His gaze met hers directly despite the warnings his existence screamed about prolonged eye contact. "I’m asking if you can make a move to end THE Weaver."
THE Secretive Eon pondered his words briefly.
Then she turned to look at him fully.
HUUM!
The weight of her attention settled upon Noah like the pressure of deep oceans!

Her dark eyes studied him with intensity that felt like being weighed on scales older than Existence itself. She looked him over slowly, deliberately, up and down as if assessing him anew despite their previous interactions.
Small in stature, almost delicate in appearance, with features that held an ageless quality that made it impossible to determine if she was young or ancient beyond measure!
When she finally spoke, her words came with patient finality.
"Scale Breaker, we are not friends."
The statement was delivered without malice, without particular emphasis. Just fact being established.

"I care very little if anyone from your Civilization dies. Failure to protect your people is failure of your Way. I can do one nice thing like giving you a Fragment when you mentioned Muspelheim, but I am not obligated to do anything else for this little... alliance."
Her dark eyes held his without wavering.
"By the way, return my Fragment if you’re done with it."
She paused, and when she continued, her voice carried notes of casual dismissal.

"When it comes to THE Weavers... they rank fairly weak amongst Absolutes. But they innately have Three Bodies, so its akin to facing 3 little tiny weak Absolutes..." Her head tilted with consideration. "But they are still Absolutes. You would likely be crushed."
Her gaze grew more distant.

"I could move against them, yes. But Paradox is not my target right now. Chaos is. Killing one of Paradox’s Absolutes will cause deviations in my plans, and I don’t particularly feel the need to accommodate that at this moment."
She turned back to face the distant expanse of the Stoa.
"So you, Scale Breaker, are on your own. As you should be. As all Absolutes are. Find your own solution against that Absolute."
Her voice carried edges that hadn’t been present before.
"You need to have one thing abundantly clear between us. Our relationship is that of give and take. I have been more than giving so far. You cannot simply take. If you have something to give, give."
Noah found his eyes pulsing with dangerous light within the simulation!
Her words were calm and cold, delivered with the patient certainty of someone who had no need to justify their position to anyone.
THE Secretive Eon observed his reaction and smiled.
While remaining seated with her legs crossed, she placed her chin upon her hand with casual elegance. Her dark eyes sparkled with something that might’ve been amusement or anticipation.
"Oh?"Her voice carried dangerous undertones wrapped in silk. "I sense you’ve gotten a bit more weight on you since our last meeting. Your power isn’t subtle, Scale Breaker."
Her smile widened.
"Are you feeling like rebelling? Itchy? you want to try and go against me as your first real Absolute?"
BOOM!
The question wasn’t a threat.
It was an invitation!

chapters.title: Chapter 4743: Give and Take! III
paragraphs: Noah’s response came after a moment of deliberate control.
Rather than answering with words or foolish aggression, he waved his hand with calculated precision.
Two objects materialized before him.

The first was a Fragment that pulsed with chaotic energy barely contained within its crystalline structure. Patterns of mayhem and destruction swirled within its depths...THE Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem that Eon had lent him.

The second Fragment burned with different authority entirely. Where the first spoke of active destruction, this one whispered of gradual wearing, of persistent erosion, of patient victory through endurance...THE Fragment of THE Axiom of Attrition.
“A Fragment I obtained from THE Living Spirit,” Noah said calmly. “It’s yours if you make a move against THE Weaver.”
THE Secretive Eon observed the offered Fragments with expression unchanged.
Then she yawned.
The gesture was small, delicate, and absolutely devastating in its dismissal.
Her hand reached out and casually reclaimed the Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem, the treasure she’d lent him returning to her possession with the inevitability of property recognizing its true owner.
She glanced at the remaining Fragment, the Axiom of Attrition that Noah had won through his defeat of THE Living Spirit.
Then she shook her head.
“Not enough.”
The words were delivered without negotiation, without room for counter-offer.

“Three more Fragments of similar quality, or something of genuinely equivalent value, might convince me to shift my plans and move against THE Weaver.” Her dark eyes met his with absolute finality. “Until then, focus your other body on retrieving my Disciple as previously agreed upon. That arrangement remains in effect regardless of whatever additional requests you wish to make.”

|Further Analysis:|
|THE Living Spirit was a Half-Step Absolute. A pale shadow of true Absolutes. A trash bum cosplaying as something greater than he actually was.|
|THE Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem was effective against him because his foundation was incomplete. His Depth was not genuine. His claim to Absolute classification was hollow.|
|THE Weaver, THE Weavers, are different.|
|Genuine Absolute. Complete foundation. Real claim to THE Absolute Depth.|
|Even if you still possessed THE Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem, its effect would be minimal.|
|Reducing a genuine Absolute’s effective Depth by a fraction would still leave them categorically superior to your current state.|
|You require alternative solutions.|
|Solutions that do not rely on matching power with power.|
|Solutions that leverage your unique capabilities rather than attempting to bridge unbridgeable gaps.|
|Contemplation continues as you search the Wastes...|
The golden light of the Full Moirai Thread pulsed around Noah’s form as the simulation continued processing potential futures.

In Muspelheim, his physical body remained motionless. Blue-gold plasma still swirled around him like the corona of an angry star. The Muspeli Lifeforms watched with mixture of awe and concern, none daring to interrupt whatever profound process had claimed their unlikely ally’s attention.
Within the simulation, Noah’s consciousness grappled with the fundamental problem that had defined his entire existence since awakening to Infinite Mana.
How did one who hadn’t yet reached the apex stand against those who already resided there?
How did a Scale Breaker break scales that existed beyond his current reach?
It was a heavy question to ponder on at this moment!
But as Noah grappled with this, he also paid close attention to the workings of the Full Simulation itself.
Because it actually had many benefits!
He learned what would happen from small, simple things in these interactions. Like what happened if he shared news of his victory with Eon.
The answer was clear now.
He needed to not tell her about collapsing THE Living Spirit. The moment he did, she’d ask for her Fragment back.
He could keep that for as long as possible.

And the simulation... remained a simulation. Nothing that happened within it was real. He inherently did not offer his newly found Fragment of THE Axiom of Differentiated Tongue in actual Existence, but was there any harm in doing so in a simulation just to see if it could move Eon?
The answer was no!
His eyes shone brightly as he discovered a key point in these simulations!

chapters.title: Chapter 4744: Skoll!
paragraphs: He could make choices he would normally never make just for the sake of information gathering and exploring other possibilities!

He could go back to Eon and see if a different future could unfold if he offered things he wouldn’t offer otherwise in Existence. Test what leverage actually worked. Discover her true price without paying it, and even gain without losing anything since it was a simulation!
But before that...
He made another decision.

There was still the matter of finding Lumivara and Ul’moreth in these vast Wastes. Still the matter of developing solutions against an Absolute that didn’t rely on Eon’s intervention. Because while reliance on others was a form of power, the power of others was not always reliant.
The simulation could explore multiple branches simultaneously.
|Simulation Resuming.|
|Decision Point: Continue exploration of the Wastes while seeking alternative solutions.|
|Your Seals of Absolute Tongue continue to expand across the corrupted landscape.|
|The 27 Seals pulse outward, triggering resonance with The First Tongue wherever traces of it exist.|
|While searching, a secondary consideration emerges.|
|You recall information obtained earlier regarding the Muspeli Lifeform designated as Duke.|
|Galileo’s words echo in your memory.|
|Duke: A unique anomaly born in the fires of The First Tongue.|
|Speed exceeding any Fundamental Depth entity.|
|Velocity approaching Absolute classification despite lacking the Depth to match.|
|Galileo mentioned that Duke’s full potential could be unleashed by you specifically.|
|The connection to The First Tongue that birthed this creature resonates with your claim over that same linguistic foundation.|
|Decision Point: Investigate Duke’s latent potential while continuing search operations.|
|Executing branch...|
|In Muspelheim, your body turns attention toward Duke.|
|The golden retriever sits nearby with tongue lolling out, seemingly oblivious to the significance of events unfolding around him.|
|You place your hand upon his head.|
|You attempt to utilize The First Tongue to initiate whatever transformation might be possible.|
|Initial findings: No obvious oddities detected.|
|You study the makeup of this unique lifeform more carefully.|
|Biology of Duke – Analysis:|
|Physical form appears to be standard canine configuration adapted to Muspelheim’s primordial environment.|
|Fur composed of crystallized flame particles that shift through neon spectrums.|
|Musculature optimized for explosive acceleration rather than sustained output, and Logos and Philologies of The First Tongue|
|Nervous system operates at frequencies that exceed normal temporal limitations.|
|Core finding: Duke’s speed is not a product of raw power. It is a product of fundamental resonance with something deeper.|
|The First Tongue left unique anomalous traces in this creature’s very existence when it was born.|
|Those traces remain dormant. Waiting. Unactivated.|
|You proceed carefully.|
|You wish to continue your search while experimenting with the method to unlock whatever latent potential Duke possesses.|
|Solution: Bring Duke to the Wastes. Combine objectives.|
|Executing...|
The simulation shifted as Noah made his decision.
And the scene that unfolded was... something.
A man jumping onto the back of a golden retriever and using him as a mount.
Not exactly the image of cosmic dignity that THE Genesis Monarch typically projected. But fuck it. Practicality trumped aesthetics!

Noah settled atop Duke’s broad back, his legs finding natural positions along the creature’s flanks. The golden fur beneath him radiated warmth that pulsed with neon light, and Duke’s muscles tensed with eager anticipation.
The Wastes of THE Fallout stretched endlessly in all directions around them.

Gray desolation as far as perception could reach. Ashen clouds swirling overhead. Corrupted reality shifting and reforming with each passing moment. Pockets of frozen time. Zones where distance meant nothing. Regions where existence itself seemed uncertain of its own configuration.
And in the middle of it all, a man seated atop a very good boy!
As much as that didn’t sound right, it was a glorious scene!
Noah patted Duke’s head calmly, his hand running through fur that felt like captured starfire.
“Alright. Let’s see what you can do.”
Duke’s expression shifted into something that could only be described as pure, unbridled joy.
His eyes shone with excitement that transcended species barriers. His tail wagged with enthusiasm that generated small reality distortions. His entire body language screamed one thing:
He understood the assignment.
FWOOOOM!
In the next instant, Duke’s body became covered in neon flames!

The fire wasn’t destructive. It was kinetic. Pure velocity made manifest, wrapping around the golden retriever’s form like a second skin of crystallized speed. The flames extended outward to encompass Noah as well, coating him in protective luminescence that hummed with barely contained acceleration.
And then they moved.
WHOOOOSH!
The two of them shot out across the Wastes of THE Fallout like glimmers of neon light streaking through gray desolation!
Noah’s eyes shone brightly in the simulation as he witnessed space itself disappearing around him at rates that defied comprehension!

The Wastes blurred into indistinct smears of gray and ash. Landmarks that should have taken minutes to reach vanished behind them in heartbeats. Entire regions of corrupted reality were crossed in moments that felt like fractions of moments.
Fast.
So impossibly fast!

Duke moved with velocity that made Noah’s previous methods of travel look like crawling through mud. The golden retriever’s paws didn’t even seem to touch the ground. He simply existed in one location, then another, then another, the transitions so rapid that the concept of “movement” became almost meaningless.
This wasn’t running.
This was something else entirely.
|Simulation continues...|
|You begin to cover and map out vast distances of the Wastes with Duke as your mount.|
|Speed assessment: Unprecedented for non-Absolute classification.|
|Areas covered in minutes that would have required hours through conventional travel.|
|Your impression of Duke’s capabilities continues to grow.|
|This creature represents genuine tactical value.|
|You select Duke as another potential solution to the current problem.|
|If Lumivara and Ul’moreth can be located, Duke’s speed could enable rapid extraction.|
|If THE Weaver must be evaded rather than confronted, Duke’s velocity might provide the necessary advantage.|
|But questions remain.|
|Galileo mentioned that Duke’s full potential could be unleashed by you.|
|Current performance, while impressive, may not represent that full potential.|
|Decision Point: Attempt to unlock Duke’s latent capabilities through direct application of your authority.|
|Your eyes shine with brilliance as you make your choice.|
|You proceed to flood the body of Duke not with mere Phonemes of The First Tongue.|
|You release your Seals of Absolute Tongue into the body of this unique creature.|
|Beginning transfer...|
|The 18 Primordial Seals enter Duke’s existence.|
|The Seal of Fire.|
|The Seal of Water.|
|The Seal of Earth.|
|The Seal of Air.|
|The Seal of Void.|
|The Seal of Light.|
|The Seal of Darkness.|
|The Seal of Life.|
|The Seal of Death.|
|The Seal of Time.|
|The Seal of Space.|
|The Seal of Order.|
|The Seal of Chaos.|
|The Seal of Unity.|
|The Seal of Division.|
|The Seal of Beginning.|
|The Seal of Ending.|
|The Seal of Paradox.|
|Duke stops and trembles.|
|The neon light around him buzzes with instability!|
|His form flickers between states of existence as the Primordial Seals integrate with whatever dormant potential lies within him.|
|But no grand changes occur.|
|The 18 Seals settle into his existence without triggering transformation.|
|Something is missing.|
|You continue.|
|Your 9 original Seals enter Duke’s body.|
|The Seal of Quintessence.|
|The Seal of Infinity.|
|The Seal of Tyranny.|
|The Seal of Fortune.|
|The Seal of Advantage.|
|The Seal of Narrative.|
|The Seal of Harvest.|
|The Seal of Hunger.|
|The Seal of Potential.|
|Duke stops completely.|
|He becomes utterly still.|
|And then...|
BOOM!
|The Wastes around you begin to shudder!|
|Everything in every direction becomes covered with neon brilliance!|
|The gray desolation is painted over with light that pulses in rhythms matching the heartbeat of Existence itself!|
|In the eyes of Duke, something unprecedented manifests.|
|An incandescent neon sun appears in one eye.|
|An incandescent neon moon appears in the other.|
|His Depth surges!|
|Intermediate... approaching Fundamental!|
|His existence reacts to your Seals and the breadth of The First Tongue they represent!|
|This was the key.|
|The 18 Primordial Phonemes alone were insufficient.|
|But combined with the 9 Phonemes you forged yourself?|
|The complete First Tongue, original and expanded, flowing through a creature born from that same linguistic foundation?|
|Transformation becomes inevitable.|
|AWAKENING DETECTED|
|Designation Update:|
|Former: Duke, Muspeli Lifeform|
|Current: Skoll, THE Herald of The Tongue, THE Steed of Mana|
|Core Nature:|
|Skoll moves at the speed that Mana moves to keep up the very fabric of Existence.|
|This is not conventional velocity. This is fundamental velocity.|
|Mana permeates all things. Mana connects all things. Mana IS the fabric that holds Existence together.|
|And Mana moves constantly, endlessly, to maintain that fabric’s integrity.|
|Skoll now moves at THAT speed.|
|The speed of existential maintenance. The speed of existential continuity. The speed of reality staying real.|
|Capabilities:|
|FIRST: Absolute Evasion. No entity below THE Absolute Depth can perceive or intercept Skoll’s movement.|
|SECOND: Mana Trails. Where Skoll travels, Mana concentration increases exponentially, leaving paths of enhanced existential stability.|
|THIRD: Tongue Resonance. As THE Herald of The Tongue, Skoll amplifies the authority of any First Tongue user in his presence.|
|FOURTH: Speed Transfer. Skoll can temporarily grant his velocity to riders or allies.|
|Loyalty: Absolute to THE Genesis Monarch, The One Who Awakened Him.|
Noah’s eyes shone sharply at these prompts!
In the simulation, he sat atop a transformed being whose power now approached classifications that should have been impossible for a creature that had been a simple golden retriever moments ago.
But since he was viewing all of this simulation in Muspelheim...
His gaze briefly flashed over to the innocent looking Duke near him.
The golden retriever had his tongue out. His tail wagged slowly. He looked toward Noah with eyes full of simple canine devotion, completely oblivious to the potential sleeping within his fluffy form.
Duke tilted his head slightly, as if wondering why THE Genesis Monarch was staring at him so intensely.
Woof?
4/4 Onwards! Keep The Magic Castles and Golden Tickets coming!

|The complete First Tongue, original and expanded, flowing through a creature born from that same linguistic foundation?|
|Transformation becomes inevitable.|
|AWAKENING DETECTED|
|Designation Update:|
|Former: Duke, Muspeli Lifeform|
|Current: Skoll, THE Herald of The Tongue, THE Steed of Mana|
|Core Nature:|
|Skoll moves at the speed that Mana moves to keep up the very fabric of Existence.|
|This is not conventional velocity.
This is fundamental velocity.|
|Mana permeates all things.
Mana connects all things.
Mana IS the fabric that holds Existence together.|
|And Mana moves constantly, endlessly, to maintain that fabric’s integrity.|
|Skoll now moves at THAT speed.|
|The speed of existential maintenance.
The speed of existential continuity.
The speed of reality staying real.|
|Capabilities:|
|FIRST: Absolute Evasion.
No entity below THE Absolute Depth can perceive or intercept Skoll’s movement.|
|SECOND: Mana Trails.
Where Skoll travels, Mana concentration increases exponentially, leaving paths of enhanced existential stability.|
|THIRD: Tongue Resonance.
As THE Herald of The Tongue, Skoll amplifies the authority of any First Tongue user in his presence.|
|FOURTH: Speed Transfer.
Skoll can temporarily grant his velocity to riders or allies.|
|Loyalty: Absolute to THE Genesis Monarch, The One Who Awakened Him.|
Noah’s eyes shone sharply at these prompts!
In the simulation, he sat atop a transformed being whose power now approached classifications that should have been impossible for a creature that had been a simple golden retriever moments ago.
But since he was viewing all of this simulation in Muspelheim...
His gaze briefly flashed over to the innocent looking Duke near him.
The golden retriever had his tongue out.
His tail wagged slowly.
He looked toward Noah with eyes full of simple canine devotion, completely oblivious to the potential sleeping within his fluffy form.
Duke tilted his head slightly, as if wondering why THE Genesis Monarch was staring at him so intensely.
Woof?
4/4 Onwards!
Keep The Magic Castles and Golden Tickets coming!

chapters.title: Chapter 4745: Simulation And Reality Collide! I
paragraphs: Noah returned his gaze to the ongoing simulation.
He mentally noted that the first thing to be done after this ended was Duke’s transformation.
Because right now, the memories of the simulation showed the glorious transformed figure of Duke in the form of Skoll.
And what a figure it was!

The golden retriever’s form had undergone changes that elevated him from adorable companion to something genuinely majestic. A lion-like mane now wrapped around his neck and shoulders, composed of crystallized neon flames that flickered with colors that had no names. His vibrant golden fur carried traces of blue woven throughout, as if the authority of Mana itself had bled into every strand.
His form still remained that of a dog.
But majestic. Regal. Carrying himself with the dignity of something that knew exactly what it had become.
And those eyes!

An incandescent neon sun burned in one pupil. An incandescent neon moon glowed in the other. Day and night. Beginning and ending. The eternal cycle of Existence captured in the gaze of a very good boy who had transcended his original limitations.
His entire body emanated waves of THE Fundamental Depth!
Not approaching it. Not adjacent to it. Genuinely radiating it in pulses that made the corrupted Wastes around them stabilize wherever he stood.
Noah stroked his fur while seated atop him, feeling the warmth of captured starfire beneath his palm.
“Let’s go. As fast as you can.”
Skoll’s response was immediate.
And terrifying.
The transformed Duke entirely disappeared alongside Noah!
Not moved. Not accelerated. Simply... gone.
Even the radiant glimmer of neon light that had surrounded them moments before was no longer visible. No trail. No afterimage. No indication that anything had been there at all.
Imperceptible!
This wasn’t speed that could be tracked or followed. This was speed that existed outside the framework of normal observation entirely.
|Simulation continues...|
|With the advancement of Skoll, you proceed to test his capabilities.|
|Results: Astonishing.|
|Speed Assessment:|
|Previous coverage rate with conventional travel: Hours per major region.|
|Previous coverage rate with base Duke: Minutes per major region.|
|Current coverage rate with Skoll: Seconds per major region.|
|You cover endless regions of the Wastes in a single second.|
|Distances that would have required hours before are crossed in the time it takes to blink.|
|The corrupted landscape blurs into meaningless smears of gray and ash.|
|You cover vast regions of The Wastes of THE Fallout systematically.|
|Encounters:|
|Multiple Scorched entities detected and engaged.|
|Surface Depth. Intermediate Depth. Creatures of flame and hunger and desperate survival.|
|Multiple Emerged entities detected and engaged.|
|None of them are what you’re looking for.|
|No trace of Lumivara. No echo of Ul’moreth. No signature of THE Weaver.|
|But the encounters are not wasted.|
|Skoll proves to be an eager participant in combat.|
|Being the good boy he is, he swallows Surface Depth entities in single gulps.|
|His neon flames consume their existence and convert it into fuel for his own advancement.|
|You collapse others personally.|
|Some transform into additional Fragments of Moirai Threads through your Perpetual Harvest.|
|Others have their Depths devoured to continue elevating your own immensity.|
|Your search continues.|
|One minute passes.|
|Vast territories have been covered. Over a Dozen enemies have been eliminated. Your power has grown incrementally through constant harvest.|
|But still no trace of your targets.|
|And then...|
|Your intuition begins to buzz.|
|Something is wrong.|
|The sensation is not logical. It is not based on evidence or observation. It is simply a feeling that rises from the depths of your existence with urgent insistence.|
|For Lumivara and Ul’moreth, time is running out!|
|Your efforts in the Wastes are not paying off quickly enough.|
|Decision Point: Alternative approach required.|
|You backtrack across the Wastes.|
|Destination: THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap once more.|
|You enter the Stoa of Dogmata once more.|
|THE Secretive Eon sits exactly where she was before.|
|This time, she doesn’t even glance your way.|
Noah fully immersed himself into the simulation as the scene played out in front of him.
The prompts faded away, replaced by direct experience of the simulated future.

He stood in the Stoa of Dogmata with Skoll beside him, the transformed Duke’s neon flames casting strange shadows across the ancient pillars as he looked around. Eon remained seated with her legs crossed, her dark eyes fixed on the distant expanse ahead, completely ignoring his arrival.
Noah calmly brought out two objects.
The Fragment of THE Axiom of Attrition pulsed with authority that spoke of gradual erosion and patient victory.
The Fragment of THE Axiom of Differentiated Tongue burned with power that resonated with the very foundations of linguistic authority.
The light of two Axioms drew the attention of Eon.
She looked over, and for the first time since his arrival, her dark eyes held something other than dismissive disinterest.
“Both of these are yours,” Noah said calmly, “if you can track down where THE Weavers are and simply make a move to remove my people from there.”
Eon looked at the two Fragments.
Her composed features shifted into something that might have been a smile.
“For these... we can make a transaction.”
Her voice remained measured, each word placed with precision that spoke of eons spent choosing exactly what to say.

“But their worth is enough for me to look for the signature of Absolutes in the Wastes. I can track down THE Weavers.” Her head tilted slightly. “That alone uses up what you’re giving. My intervention would require more. So I won’t intervene, but I can drop you off in that location as soon as I find them.”
Noah’s eyes were sharp as he looked at Eon.
Man, she fucking sucked sometimes.
But this was progress!
From Eon, he should be able to learn where Lumivara and Ul’moreth were. The exact location that his own searches had failed to uncover despite covering vast territories with Skoll’s impossible speed.
And since this was a simulation, he wouldn’t lose anything!
The Fragments he offered here remained safely in his possession in actual Existence. He could test what leverage worked, discover her true price, and gain without losing anything.
As he was thinking all this, Eon’s gaze drifted away from the Fragments.
Her dark eyes settled on the burning visage of Skoll!

chapters.title: Chapter 4746: Simulation And Reality Collide! II
paragraphs: "You seem to also have an interesting creature here."
Her voice carried notes of genuine curiosity that hadn’t been present before as this terrifying being turned her gaze towards Duke!
"In exchange for it, I could put in the effort to save your people."
BOOM!
The weight of her words pressed against Noah’s existence!
His eyes became sharp.
She wanted Duke?

He turned to look at the much more majestic dog who still held the same innocent qualities despite his transformation. Skoll’s tail wagged slightly at Noah’s attention, the neon sun and moon in his eyes shining with simple devotion that transcended his elevated classification.
A dog that even an Absolute wanted!
That was how unique Duke was. How valuable. How unprecedented.
And even though Noah could make the choice to give him away in this simulation, the choice of giving him away in real Existence was not possible.
Such a choice in the simulation would only lead to a fantasy that wasn’t achievable externally.
He wouldn’t dwell in fantasies.
And he wouldn’t sacrifice one life for another.
So...
"My dog isn’t part of the deal."
His voice came calm and steady, brooking no negotiation on this point.
"And I don’t want you to drop me off wherever they are. I want for us to go from outside this Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap to that location."
Yes.
If Eon used her terrifying power to deny the very environment of the Fallout that stated no teleportation, Noah wouldn’t gain anything from it.
What he needed was the route!
How to get there from the areas he’d already mapped out with Skoll. The path that his own capabilities could actually traverse without relying on an Absolute’s reality-defying authority.
After he said such words, Eon smiled.
She nodded with the patience of someone who found his reasoning unique but acceptable.
Then she closed her eyes.
In the simulation, Noah focused on what happened next.
From her body...
BOOM!
He felt Existence being squeezed in a terrifying manner!

The sensation lasted for less than a nanosecond. A fraction of a fraction of a moment. But in that infinitesimal window, Noah felt pressure that made his own considerable weight feel like nothing. Authority that bent reality itself to extract information that should have been impossible to obtain.
The signature of THE Weavers, hidden somewhere in the vast corrupted expanse of the Wastes, identified and located through sheer overwhelming power.
And then it was over.
Eon opened her eyes calmly and rose from her seated position. Her small, delicate form unfolded with grace that spoke of movements refined across eons.
"Alright. Found them. Let’s go."
Noah’s eyes flashed sharply.
The power of an Absolute was displayed for barely a fraction of a nanosecond.
And it was fucking heavy!

She had done in that instant what he had been unable to do in minutes of searching with Skoll’s impossible speed. What his 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue couldn’t accomplish despite their weight and authority.
The gap between his current state and genuine Absolutes remained categorical.
But he was learning. Gathering information. Understanding exactly what he was dealing with.
With a calm gaze, Eon looked toward him.
"Step on the platform here, and we can get going."

She waved her hand, and a clear white platform emerged from nowhere. It pulsed with unique THE Civilizational Authority that made Noah’s senses tingle with recognition of power far beyond his current classification.
He shook his head.
"You go, and I will follow."
Eon smiled.
"Oh?"
Her gaze went to Skoll, the transformed Duke upon whom Noah was seated. The neon sun and moon in his eyes met her dark depths without flinching.
"Keep up."
With such words...
BOOM!
She disappeared!
No trail. No warning. No gradual acceleration. Simply present one moment and gone the next, moving toward the location of THE Weavers with speed that defied conventional understanding.
Noah held on to Skoll.
And Skoll disappeared right behind her!
He wanted to know!
Just how obscene was the speed of Duke compared to a real Absolute?
Knowing this was critical. If the plan to run away from THE Weavers was going to be viable, he needed to understand exactly what Skoll could do against entities operating at THE Absolute Depth.
Could they escape if confrontation proved impossible?
Could they extract Lumivara and Ul’moreth before THE Weavers could respond?
The simulation would tell him.
And the simulation would not lie.
As Noah began to follow THE Secretive Eon atop Skoll, racing through the corrupted expanses of the Wastes...
The simulation flickered.
Just briefly. A momentary distortion in the otherwise seamless immersion that made Noah’s eyes narrow with sharp attention.
|WARNING: SIMULATION INTEGRITY COMPROMISED|
|The Full Moirai Thread utilizing the progression of a potential THE Existential Paradox Loop is discovering irregularities.|
|Core Issue:|
|Interactions with an Absolute and the continued display of simulation that portrays their Weavings of Existence is draining the capability of THE Moirai Thread at an exponential rate.|
|Previous Drain Rate: 0.3% per minute of simulation.|
|Current Drain Rate: 4.7% per minute while actively simulating Absolute-class entity.|
|Projected Consequence:|
|Early termination of simulation may occur before eventual collapse depending on continued interactions with Absolutes.|
|Definition of Early Termination:|
|The point at which the integrity of the simulation can no longer be maintained while accurately portraying Absolutes and their actions.|
|Critical Concern:|
|Ensuring that information and memories of the simulation do not feed back to the Absolutes being simulated.|
|Absolutes operate at a Scale of Existence where their perception extends into domains that should be inaccessible.|
|Even simulated versions of them carry echoes of this capability.|
|The longer an Absolute is portrayed within the simulation, the higher the risk that the real Absolute may gain awareness of being simulated.|
|Assessment:|
|Absolutes are too powerful.|
|Their very nature strains the boundaries of what THE Moirai Thread can safely model.|
|Recommendation:|
|Minimize direct interaction with simulated Absolutes.|
|Gather essential information quickly.|
|Prepare for potential early termination.|
|Current Simulation Integrity: 41%|

chapters.title: Chapter 4747: Simulation And Reality Collide! III
paragraphs: Noah’s eyes flashed sharply as he received this warning!
After all, what he was doing right now was considered a tremendously ridiculous thing.
Simulating a future reality.
Obtaining information he should have no access to.
Learning and interacting with an Absolute in such a simulation.
Their power of THE Absolute Depth was so overwhelming that even for things they did not know about... they could know about!

The very act of simulating them risked drawing their actual attention. Their real selves might sense echoes of being observed, being modeled, being used as pawns in someone else’s information gathering.
And he was getting another glimpse of this terrifying truth as he focused on following Eon while committing the regions of The Wastes of THE Fallout to memory.
Everything around them felt like a haze.
But Noah was seeing everything. Every distorted landmark. Every corrupted zone. Every twisted region of reality that had been reshaped by THE Fallout’s catastrophic energies.
Ahead of them, Eon seemed to be taking light steps.
Just casual, unhurried movements that looked almost lazy.
Yet she moved at speeds that Noah in Muspelheim in real Existence would never be able to follow!

As she moved, she turned her head back languidly to look at Skoll and his burning neon flames. The transformed Duke had his tongue out, flapping on the side as if he was having the time of his life chasing after her.
Such a good boy. Even when pursuing an Absolute across corrupted wastelands, he found joy in the simple act of running!
Eon’s eyes twisted into utterly deadly crescents of amusement.
"Man, I want to abandon my principles and rob you right now of that little dog, Scale Breaker."
BOOM!
Her voice carried notes of genuine temptation beneath the casual delivery.

"But ah, I’m one of the last good ones left. I’ll stick to my principles."She sighed with exaggerated regret. "When you want to trade that cute doggy, let me know. For now, let’s see how quickly it can really go."
She waved her hand toward Skoll as if playing a game.
"Little doggy, come on. Get!"
Skoll’s response was immediate and enthusiastic.
He surged forward with excitement, his neon flames blazing brighter as he accepted what he perceived as an invitation to play!
And shockingly, Eon accelerated to match!
Noah’s entire existence buzzed with immensity as his Seals of Absolute Tongue flowed into his eyes. He barely continued to grasp the surrounding landscape as Skoll and Eon pushed faster and faster!
The Wastes blurred into meaningless smears.
Landmarks disappeared before they could be properly observed, but he still observed them.
Reality itself seemed to protest the speeds being achieved within its corrupted boundaries.
And this continued for only a little while before Eon seemed to take it as a genuine challenge.
She went even faster.
And shockingly... she began to surge forward and disappear from their perception entirely!
One moment she was there, a small figure in white-blue robes taking casual steps through corrupted reality.
The next moment, she was simply... gone.
Skoll howled out!

The sound was glorious and majestic, carrying across the Wastes with authority that made nearby corruption stabilize in response. Neon plasma flames raged around his transformed body, blazing with intensity that exceeded anything he’d displayed before. His limbs churned with speed and power that defied comprehension, each stride seeming to glide on The First Tongue itself rather than the corrupted ground beneath them.
And yet...
Eon only got further and further away.
They almost lost her entirely!
Noah’s expression became heavy.
"Slow down."
WAA!
Eon began to reappear before them soon after.

The Wastes around them constantly changed as she decelerated, regions shifting and reforming as their perception caught up to where she now waited. Her dark eyes twisted into a smile as she looked at Noah with the patience of someone who had just proven a very important point.
"His speed is good."
Her voice came measured and unhurried, each word placed with precision.
"Can be considered to touch a fraction of Absolute. But Absolute is far too grand, and far too varied."
She tilted her head slightly.
"In front of THE Creature or me... the speed of that very good boy can only be considered a cute... oh, he’s a little fast."
The dismissal in her tone was gentle but absolute.
"If your plan on saving your people from THE Weavers involves speeding away with them with little doggy here, I can tell you now that you will fail."
Her dark eyes held his without wavering.

"Even a weak Absolute like THE Weavers will catch you in time. That initial burst of surprise of that speed will give you a lead, but they will catch you soon enough. You will be caught, Scale Breaker."
She glanced at Skoll with something that might have been genuine concern.
"And this poor little doggy that you could give to me right now would also be caught by something as cruel as THE Weavers. What a shame that would be, Scale Breaker."
Her smile widened.
"Do you want to change your choice now?"
WAA!
Her words were heavy.
But Noah remained calm.
"Once we near their position, just let me know which direction to go towards without THE Weavers finding out about your existence. I will take the rest from there."
He wanted it to be as authentic as possible.
Eon would not be with them when this simulation ended. He would be alone with Skoll in actual Existence, facing THE Weavers without an Absolute backing him up.
The aura of Eon would affect how things played out in the simulation, and he had to minimize discrepancies between what happened here and what would happen in reality.
As for her words and warning that his plan may fail...
Noah now knew this very well after observing her ridiculous speed.
But still, he had other cards up his sleeve.
There were still many things he could do. Or really, two things that he was planning out in his mind at this moment.
Contingencies upon contingencies.
Plans within plans.
Because Tyranny did not accept failure as an option.
Eon laughed.
The sound was light and almost musical, carrying across the corrupted Wastes with ease that spoke of someone genuinely entertained.
"Don’t worry, Scale Breaker. I will take you exactly where you need to be."
Her smile held secrets that he couldn’t begin to fathom.
"If you don’t want me to be perceivable to THE Weavers, I don’t have to stay away to make that happen. I can make it so that you see and perceive me, while a weak Absolute like THE Weavers..."
She paused.
"I can make it so that they cannot even perceive I am here."
BOOM!

Simulating a future reality.
Obtaining information he should have no access to.
Learning and interacting with an Absolute in such a simulation.
Their power of THE Absolute Depth was so overwhelming that even for things they did not know about... they could know about!
The very act of simulating them risked drawing their actual attention.
Their real selves might sense echoes of being observed, being modeled, being used as pawns in someone else’s information gathering.
And he was getting another glimpse of this terrifying truth as he focused on following Eon while committing the regions of The Wastes of THE Fallout to memory.
Everything around them felt like a haze.

Every corrupted zone.

BOOM!

"But ah, I’m one of the last good ones left.

Get!"

He barely continued to grasp the surrounding landscape as Skoll and Eon pushed faster and faster!
The Wastes blurred into meaningless smears.

The next moment, she was simply... gone.
Skoll howled out!
The sound was glorious and majestic, carrying across the Wastes with authority that made nearby corruption stabilize in response.
Neon plasma flames raged around his transformed body, blazing with intensity that exceeded anything he’d displayed before.
His limbs churned with speed and power that defied comprehension, each stride seeming to glide on The First Tongue itself rather than the corrupted ground beneath them.

Eon only got further and further away.
They almost lost her entirely!

"Slow down."
WAA!
