chapters.title: Chapter 4748: Simulation And Reality Collide! IV
paragraphs: Terrifying words that almost stopped everything echoed out!
THE Secretive Eon.
Every time she spoke, he had to reevaluate her power again.
Such a thing was just obscene!
She could make it so that even another Absolute could not perceive her?
Did this not mean that if Noah wasn’t careful enough, an Absolute like her could entirely hide from his perception while following him around?
He had to be very careful about this.
He had to make sure that he didn’t have a body around an Absolute that made any trips to THE Infiniverse or other important locations.
Because even without knowing it, there could have been an Absolute watching him this entire time.
As he had such thoughts, the simulation continued.
|Simulation Resuming.|
|While contemplating the implications of Absolute-class concealment capabilities, you and Skoll follow Eon across the Wastes.|
|You plan for multiple contingencies on how you will navigate this situation once the simulation ends.|
|Mental planning in progress.|
|All contingencies carry significant risk against genuine Absolute opposition.|
|Warning:|
|The integrity of this simulation continues to deteriorate with the continued revelation of the Weavings of an Absolute.|
|Current Simulation Integrity: 24%|

|In preparation for the eventual expected meeting with another Absolute soon, resources are being allocated to maintain viable simulation integrity for slightly more time after the introduction of THE Weavers.|
|Estimated additional simulation time after Absolute contact: 1 minute before critical integrity failure.|
|Use this time wisely.|
|Navigation Progress:|
|You continue mapping out the regions of the Wastes.|
|Even with the speed of Eon, an Absolute, it takes a total of 30 seconds to cross the relevant portions of the Wastes.|
|30 seconds at Absolute velocity.|
|The scale of Observable Existence post-Fallout is staggering.|
|This allows you to get a glimpse of just how far and how complex Observable Existence has become.|
|What you now understand and know is just a fraction ofEverything.|
|The territories you mapped with Skoll earlier represent a tiny corner of what exists out here.|
|Humbling. Terrifying. Motivating.|
|Approaching target location...|
Eon slowed down.
The corrupted landscape around them began to stabilize into something more recognizable as they approached whatever destination her Absolute perception had identified.
She smiled.
"Oh?"
Her voice carried notes of genuine surprise.
"Those carrying traces of your Way actually already managed to enter Half-Step Absolute Depth?"
She glanced back at Noah with eyes that sparkled with renewed interest.
"What a unique thing, Scale Breaker. Your pillars are more impressive than I assumed."

As Eon said this, Noah sensed the immense Weavings of Existence ahead. He could sense glimmers of The First Tongue as if she was talking about Half-Step Absolute Depth...this should be Ul’moreth? Up ahead, he sensed everything!
Auras of utter majesty bloomed across his perception!

He felt the maddening glimmer of Absolute pressing down over everything. A weight that made his own considerable heaviness feel insignificant. Authority that crushed the very air and bent reality into shapes that served purposes he couldn’t comprehend.
And yet...
Skoll’s speed was only barely affected.

The transformed Duke could still cross through such a region of oppression. His neon flames flickered against the Absolute pressure but did not dim. His stride remained sure even as reality itself groaned beneath the weight bearing down upon it.
Good boy. Such a good boy!
Eon smiled calmly.
"Well... we are here, Scale Breaker."
She turned to face him fully, her small form somehow seeming larger than the forces pressing down around them.
"I’ve kept up my end of the bargain."
Her dark eyes held something that might have been respect. Or pity. Or simply the patient observation of someone watching events unfold according to patterns she had seen countless times before.
"Good luck."
With such words, Eon disappeared from his perception entirely.
No warning. No transition. Simply present one moment and gone the next, her Absolute concealment rendering her invisible even to the senses of THE Weavers who dominated this region.
And Noah arrived at the point he had been seeking this entire time.
His perception finally observed the glorious hairy entity that was Ul’moreth!

The ancient Ginnu Lifeform stood valiantly, his obsidian-gold hair flowing with defiance that refused to bow even before Absolute pressure. His massive form was positioned protectively, placing himself between the threats ahead and...
Lumivara!
She was heavily injured!

Her brilliant form flickered with instability, her Weavings damaged in ways that made Noah’s heart clench with fury. She had fought. She had resisted. And she had paid the price for standing against forces that exceeded her classification.
But she was alive.
They were both alive.
For now.
Far ahead of them, a Legion of THE entities watched on with the patient hunger of predators who knew their prey had nowhere left to run.
At the forefront stood the glorious First Leader.
Gilgamesh.
His presence radiated authority that exceeded anything Noah had encountered among THE Fundamental Depth entities. A being of genuine power and absolute loyalty to THE Living Paradox!
And above all of them...
Three shrouded figures floated grandly with a glorious air of Absolute!

Robes and hoods covered their forms entirely, concealing whatever lay beneath in shadows that seemed deeper than mere fabric should allow. Their might pressed down like sharp blades hovering over Ul’moreth and Lumivara, ready to fall at any moment.
THE Weavers.
Three of them. Not one Absolute, but three!
Noah had found them.
But what would be the cost?
How would this perilous situation be navigated?
|Simulation Integrity: 18%|
|The Clock is ticking, Master.|
|What will you do?|
What would he do in this situation?
The answer was both difficult and easy.
A great man once said that in the face of hardship, the best way out is always through.
So Noah... would simply charge through!

He knew the simulation would progressively have its integrity eroded, especially with the simulation of another Absolute and what their capabilities were. The clock was ticking. Every second spent observing was a second wasted.
So when he went forward...
He went in with a bang!
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4749: Simulation And Reality Collide! V
paragraphs: With glorious speed, Skoll surged toward the confrontation ahead!

As if things were playing out in slow motion, Noah saw the eyes of THE Weavers land on him and his mount. Everything around them solidified and became unfathomably heavy. The air itself compressed. Reality groaned beneath the attention of three Absolutes focusing their perception on a single point.
And an instant later, he appeared in front of Ul’moreth and Lumivara!
He gazed up toward THE Weavers gloriously, his expression imperious and utterly without fear.
"You have been looking for me?"
HUUM!
His entrance was fast and unfathomably rapid!

It carried with it the glimmer of power, of velocity that only an Absolute would have! The very fact that he had crossed such distance under their suppressive authority suggested capabilities that exceeded what his classification should allow.
Behind him, Ul’moreth and Lumivara were astonished.
But before they could even say anything or react, Noah sent them both a mental message.
|Move quickly. No time to explain. Send me the memories of the entire path you have taken since THE Belly of Existence was torn open until you arrived here. Now.|
He did this for a critical reason.

If one of his two plans was forced to come to fruition, if he was forced to utilize THE Existential Paradox Loop and reverse time to an Anchor Point, he could find Lumivara and Ul’moreth across the Wastes even before they came across Gilgamesh and THE Weavers!
Prevention rather than rescue.
Both Lumivara and Ul’moreth did not delay.

Vast swathes of memories flooded into Noah’s perception. The Wastes they had crossed. The landmarks they had passed. The route they had taken through corrupted reality after THE Belly of Existence was torn open.
Everything.
While they did this, Noah also gave the command to Skoll.
|Speed Transfer to Ul’moreth and Lumivara. Now.|
The transformed Duke’s capabilities flowed outward, granting his impossible velocity to the two beings Noah had come to rescue.
He did all of this in the span of an instant.
And then he gazed up at THE Weavers.
Oh!
They were a horrid wonder to observe!
Three figures floated above everything, their robes and hoods finally parting enough for their faces to become visible beneath the shadowed fabric.
Ancient.
Decrepit.
Withered beyond what any mortal existence should endure and still function.

Their skin was papyrus-thin and gray, stretched over bones that seemed too prominent, too sharp, too angular to belong to anything that had ever been young. Deep wrinkles carved canyons across their features, each line representing eons of existence that had worn away everything soft and left only hardened purpose behind.
Their mouths were thin slashes that curved into expressions that might have been smiles or might have been the natural configuration of lips that had forgotten how to do anything else.
And their eyes!
Shockingly, those ancient orbs swirled with golden light!

Not the warm gold of dawn or the rich gold of treasure. This was the cold, calculating gold of fate itself, of threads being measured and cut, of destinies being woven and unraveled according to designs that predated the beings whose lives they manipulated.
THE Weavers!

Entities who had existed since before who kne when, who had woven the very fabric of THE Loom, who now served THE Living Paradox with the patient certainty of entities who believed they already knew how every story ended.
The more Noah locked his gaze with them, the more he felt their attention pressing against his existence like blades seeking weak points.
So he spoke.
Grandly.
Tyrannically.
"You were looking for me, but you had not expected me to reach Absolute so quickly?"
His voice carried weight that made the surrounding reality compress further.
"How does it feel that my mere presence here is already locking away access to The First Tongue for all of you?"
He spoke such words grandly!

The Thesis he had utilized against THE Living Spirit and his forces was not contested in Muspelheim. He could apply it anywhere! So he began applying it freely and grandly, his authority as The One Who Laid The Claim extending outward to restrict access to The First Tongue for all who opposed him.
Around him, he began to move on to his next phase of planning.
After claiming to be an Absolute, he would bluff as if a terrifying showdown was about to unfold.
And then...he would run with Ul’moreth and Lumivara!
A moment of surprise that would decide everything!
They would run with the speed of an Absolute, and a chase would ensue. But even then, he had a plan for this. Reversing time was currently the last resort as it affected too many things.
But just as he was about to continue...
BZZT!
The immersive simulation flickered!
Not gently. Not gradually. The entire constructed reality around him shuddered with instability that spoke of imminent collapse.
|CRITICAL WARNING|
|A horrid discovery has been made.|
|Additional designations of THE Weavers identified:|
|THE Moirai.|
|THE Daughters of THE Night.|
|THE Spinners of Fate.|
|Core Capability:|
|They hold unfathomable control over fates and potentialities.|
|They perceive the threads of possibility that connect some futures to some pasts.|
|They sense when those threads are being manipulated by outside forces.|
|Current Status:|
|They are about to discover that this is a simulation.|
|They are about to perceive that another entity is encroaching upon their Absolute domain of fate and potential futures.|
|If this discovery is completed, your identity and location will be exposed to genuine Absolutes.|
|Emergency Protocol Initiated:|
|To prevent discovery...|
|To protect your anonymity...|
|To preserve the element of surprise that represents your only advantage...|
|THE Moirai Thread you utilized has snapped itself prematurely.|
|Simulation terminated.|
|All gathered information has been preserved.|
|Your existence remains hidden from THE Weavers’ perception.|
|For now.|
HUUM!
Golden brilliance erupted all around!
The immersive illusion shattered like glass being struck by a hammer, fragments of simulated reality dissolving into streams of golden light that flowed back into Noah’s existence.
He found himself fully back in Muspelheim.
THE Infiniverse floated nearby, its blue-gold radiance pulsing with patient attention.
Galileo watched with ears fully erect, his fluffy form practically vibrating with questions he knew better than to ask at this moment.
Duke sat with his tongue out, looking toward Noah with innocent eyes that had no idea what potential slept within his fluffy form.
Surtra and the other Muspeli Lifeforms gazed at him with expressions ranging from awe to concern.

And in the distance, he could sense Sigrid, Ra’Zan, Riya, The First Farmer, Titano, Protos, and multiple others who had witnessed his motionless form surrounded by golden light for however long the simulation had lasted.
Noah’s expression became heavier.
His eyes flickered brilliantly as he processed everything he had learned!

|THE Daughters of THE Night.|
|THE Spinners of Fate.|
|Core Capability:|
|They hold unfathomable control over fates and potentialities.|
|They perceive the threads of possibility that connect some futures to some pasts.|
|They sense when those threads are being manipulated by outside forces.|
|Current Status:|
|They are about to discover that this is a simulation.|
|They are about to perceive that another entity is encroaching upon their Absolute domain of fate and potential futures.|
|If this discovery is completed, your identity and location will be exposed to genuine Absolutes.|
|Emergency Protocol Initiated:|
|To prevent discovery...|
|To protect your anonymity...|
|To preserve the element of surprise that represents your only advantage...|
|THE Moirai Thread you utilized has snapped itself prematurely.|
|Simulation terminated.|
|All gathered information has been preserved.|
|Your existence remains hidden from THE Weavers’ perception.|
|For now.|
HUUM!
Golden brilliance erupted all around!
The immersive illusion shattered like glass being struck by a hammer, fragments of simulated reality dissolving into streams of golden light that flowed back into Noah’s existence.
He found himself fully back in Muspelheim.
THE Infiniverse floated nearby, its blue-gold radiance pulsing with patient attention.
Galileo watched with ears fully erect, his fluffy form practically vibrating with questions he knew better than to ask at this moment.
Duke sat with his tongue out, looking toward Noah with innocent eyes that had no idea what potential slept within his fluffy form.
Surtra and the other Muspeli Lifeforms gazed at him with expressions ranging from awe to concern.

And in the distance, he could sense Sigrid, Ra’Zan, Riya, The First Farmer, Titano, Protos, and multiple others who had witnessed his motionless form surrounded by golden light for however long the simulation had lasted.
Noah’s expression became heavier.
His eyes flickered brilliantly as he processed everything he had learned!

chapters.title: Chapter 4750: Simulation And Reality Collide! VI
paragraphs: THE Weavers were THE Moirai. Fate manipulators who could sense when their domain was being encroached upon. The simulation had nearly exposed him to genuine Absolutes who would have then known exactly where to look for the one who dared to peer into futures they controlled.
But he had what he needed.
The route through the Wastes.
The knowledge of Duke’s transformation.
The understanding of what he faced and what his limitations were.
He turned toward THE Infiniverse.
“I will go and get Lumivara and Ul’moreth back. Ruination will bring my body that she controls here to Muspelheim. Focus on doing a partial simulation with it focused on THE Living Concept first.”
He gave such orders rapidly.
THE Infiniverse pulsed with acknowledgment, and Noah could sense Ruination’s presence already shifting to comply with his commands.
Right after, he looked toward Galileo and Surtra.
“We will get to catch up after. For now, there is much to be done.”
His gaze turned to the golden retriever who perked up excitedly at the attention.
“Duke...”
The dog’s tail wagged with enthusiasm that transcended species barriers. His eyes shone with simple devotion that had no idea it was about to be transformed into something glorious.
“Let’s go.”
HUUM!
Duke blazed with brilliant neon light!
Noah seamlessly proceeded to sit on Duke’s back, his body settling into position with the familiarity of someone who had already done this many times in a simulation that no longer existed.
And they disappeared!

The burst of speed was explosive. Immediate. Neon light streaked across the burning skies of Muspelheim for a fraction of a second before vanishing entirely, leaving behind astonished Muspeli Lifeforms and even Sigrid, Ra’Zan, Riya, The First Farmer, Titano, Protos, and multiple others.
They would be filled in in time.
But time was exactly what Noah didn’t have currently.
In the Wastes of THE Fallout.
Noah appeared in the chaotic and grandiose Wastes as all the events that had played out in the simulation buzzed in his mind.
Gray desolation stretched endlessly in all directions.
Ashen clouds swirled overhead with energies that would destroy lesser beings.
Corrupted reality shifted and reformed with each passing moment.
In the simulation, he had lost all the Fragments of the Axioms to Eon. But he currently held all three.
The Fragment of THE Axiom of Mayhem.
The Fragment of THE Axiom of Attrition.
The Fragment of THE Axiom of Differentiated Tongue.
In turn, he had waves of information and a terrifying, dangerous future.
But his eyes still blazed with possibility!
It would be difficult, yes.
But not impossible.
For him, impossibility would always ever be... a suggestion.
So.
The first thing to be done at this moment was the transformation Duke had undergone in the simulation.
But for real.

He turned his gaze on Duke who had not yet transformed into Skoll. The golden retriever sat on the corrupted ground with his tongue out, tail wagging slowly, completely oblivious to what was about to happen.
Noah’s existence buzzed.
His glorious Seals began to be released.
The 18 Primordial Seals of Absolute Tongue flowed from his existence and into Duke’s body!
Fire. Water. Earth. Air. Void. Light. Darkness. Life. Death. Time. Space. Order. Chaos. Unity. Division. Beginning. Ending. Paradox.
Duke trembled as the Seals integrated with his existence!
The neon light around him buzzed with instability, his form flickering between states as primordial authority settled into whatever dormant potential lay within him.
But no grand changes occurred.
Not yet.
Noah continued.
His 9 original Seals entered Duke’s body!
Quintessence. Infinity. Tyranny. Fortune. Advantage. Narrative. Harvest. Hunger. Potential.
Duke stopped completely.
He became utterly still.
And then...
BOOM!
The Wastes around them began to shudder!
Everything in every direction became covered with neon brilliance! The gray desolation was painted over with light that pulsed in rhythms matching the heartbeat of Existence itself!
|AWAKENING CONFIRMED|
|As foreseen through the usage of THE Moirai Thread, the transformation has manifested in actual Existence.|
|The dormant potential within Duke has been unlocked through exposure to the complete First Tongue.|
|18 Primordial Phonemes alone were insufficient.|
|Combined with the 9 Forged Phonemes created by THE Genesis Monarch?|
|Transformation became inevitable.|
|Former Designation: Duke, Muspeli Lifeform, Anomalous Speed Entity|
|Current Designation: Skoll, THE Herald of The Tongue, THE Steed of Mana|
|Classification: Awakened Absolute-Adjacent Entity|
|Core Nature: Moves at the speed that Mana moves to keep up the very fabric of Existence.|
|The prophecy of simulation has become the reality of now.|
|Skoll has been born.|
Before Noah, the transformed Duke stood in all his glory.

A lion-like mane now wrapped around his neck and shoulders, composed of crystallized neon flames that flickered with colors that had no names. His vibrant golden fur carried traces of blue woven throughout, as if the authority of Mana itself had bled into every strand.
His form still remained that of a dog.
But majestic and regal!
An incandescent neon sun burned in one pupil.
An incandescent neon moon glowed in the other.
His entire body emanated waves of THE Fundamental Depth!
Noah breathed calmly.

He reached out and stroked the fur of Skoll, feeling warmth that pulsed with captured foldfire beneath his palm. The transformed Duke’s eyes shone with glorious vibrancy, but beneath all that existential power, the same innocent devotion remained.
Such a good boy.
Even as THE Herald of The Tongue, he was still a very good boy!
“Alright. Let’s do things for real now.”
Noah’s voice came steady and sure.
“It will be dangerous, but danger and struggles go hand in hand. In the end, there should be glory as long as the difficulty is passed.”
He met Skoll’s glowing eyes directly.
“Ready?”
He said such words knowing exactly what was coming.
THE Weavers. THE Moirai. Three genuine Absolutes who controlled fates and potentialities, who would sense any disturbance in the threads of destiny they wove.
But Skoll only blinked happily.
His expression remained innocent despite his transformation.
“Woof!”
Noah patted Skoll again. And just like the Simulation...
“Let’s go. As fast as you can.”

Both of their bodies began to be covered by neon light that blazed brighter with each passing moment. The corrupted Wastes around them bent away from their combined radiance, reality itself recognizing that something unprecedented was about to move through its damaged fabric.
The first plan of a chase would be carried out.
And Noah had an idea of exactly where this chase would go.
Eventually, he could not outrun an Absolute.
The simulation had proven that definitively. Even Skoll’s impossible speed could only touch a fraction of what genuine Absolutes could achieve. THE Weavers would catch them in time.
But where he planned to run toward...
The tools to bypass this difficulty would appear.
And this one wouldn’t even necessarily be reliant on THE Secretive Eon!
They disappeared.
Neon light streaked across the Wastes of THE Fallout, carrying THE Genesis Monarch and THE Herald of The Tongue toward a confrontation that would determine whether his pillars survived or fell!
6/6 Onwards!

chapters.title: Chapter 4751: Si Vis Pacem, Para Bellum I
paragraphs: Si vis pacem, para bellum.
If you want peace, prepare for war.
The ancient words had echoed through countless civilizations across countless eras, spoken by generals and philosophers and common folk alike who understood a fundamental truth about Existence.
Peace was not a gift freely given.
Peace was not something that simply happened because one wished for it strongly enough.

Peace was a fortress that had to be built with blood and iron and the willingness to use both. It was a garden that could only flourish when surrounded by walls high enough to keep out those who would trample its flowers. It was a dream that required nightmares to be faced and conquered before it could become reality!
The pacifist who refused to raise a blade would watch everything they loved burn while congratulating themselves on their moral purity.
The warrior who never knew when to sheathe their blade would drown in blood of their own making until nothing remained worth protecting.
But the one who understood the paradox? The one who loved peace so deeply that they would wage war against anything that threatened it?
That one could build something that lasted!
Noah...could be considered very similar to THE Peacemaker in this regard.
He also loved peace.

He loved farming and tending to crops and watching things grow under his careful attention. He loved the quiet satisfaction of creation rather than destruction. He loved seeing his people flourish, seeing his Civilization expand, seeing the seeds he planted bloom into something beautiful.
But for his own peace?
For the safety of his people?
He would go to war with Existence itself.
This time, he was only going to war with a part of Existence.
The forces of THE Living Paradox!

His mind was filled with immensity as he crossed The Wastes of THE Fallout atop Skoll. Everything was absolutely mapped out. He knew exactly where he needed to go. Every corrupted landmark, every distorted region, every twisted zone of reality that the simulation had burned into his memory.
The route was clear.
The destination was certain.
And how could he explain the sensation that came as he got closer and closer to THE Weavers?
It was actually... serenity.
Strange, wasn’t it?
Heading toward three genuine Absolutes who could crush him with a thought, who controlled fates and potentialities, who had pinned his pillars down and prepared to collapse them.
And he felt serene.
Whatever was coming, let it come.
HUUM!
His Formless Depth and immensity roiled within his existence!
His Seals vibrated with terrifying weight! Twenty-seven concentrated expressions of everything he had become, everything he represented, everything he would continue to build.
There was no fear.
Even while going against an Absolute, there was no fear!

It wasn’t because he knew how things would turn out. The simulation had been terminated before he could see the full outcome of this confrontation. He was flying partially blind into a situation that could result in his collapse.
But simply because this was his Way.
Simply because he felt his immensity that denied anything that wished to go against him!
Tyranny did not bow.
Tyranny did not hesitate.
Tyranny stood in the open and dared Existence to challenge it.
So he patted Skoll’s fur calmly.

The transformed Duke’s neon plasma flames raged around them both, blazing with colors that had no names. The incandescent sun and moon in Skoll’s eyes burned with excitement. His mane of crystallized fire billowed backward as they moved at speeds that made reality itself struggle to keep up.
Everything seemed to play out in slow motion.
The corrupted landscape stretching endlessly.
The ashen clouds parting before their passage.
The weight of Absolute authority growing heavier with each instant.
And then...
He felt it.
That oppressive aura of THE Absolute Depth!
It pressed down upon everything like the weight of mountains made from concepts rather than stone. It crushed lesser beings simply through proximity. It demanded acknowledgment from reality itself.
And Noah passed through it!
BOOM!
The scene that unfolded was glorious!
Noah crossed into the standoff between THE Weavers and his pillars with speed that carried the signature of something only Absolutes should possess!
Ul’moreth stood valiantly, his obsidian-gold hair flowing with defiance despite the injuries that marked his massive form.
Lumivara flickered behind him, heavily damaged but alive, her brilliant existence still burning with the stubbornness of one who refused to fall.
The Legion of THE entities watched from a distance, Gilgamesh at their forefront with an expression of cold calculation.
And above everything, three shrouded figures floated with the overwhelming presence of Absolutes who had never once considered the possibility of being challenged.
Noah appeared directly before them.
He looked straight at THE Weavers!

Their decrepit faces became visible beneath their hoods. Ancient. Withered. Papyrus-thin skin stretched over bones that seemed too prominent. Deep wrinkles carving canyons across features that had existed since before differentiation.
And their eyes!
Those golden orbs swirled with light that spoke of fates being measured and cut.
But now, those ancient eyes pulsed with something new.
Surprise.
"THE Daughters of THE Night."
Noah’s voice emerged with weight that compressed the surrounding reality.
"You have been seeking an Absolute of The First Tongue. One of those who laid the claim to the Oldest Paradox of Existence."
His gaze held theirs without flinching.
"If Paradox came himself, I would understand. But he actually sent you to me to die..."
His lips curved into a smile that held no warmth whatsoever.
"Are you ready?"
HUUM!
His words came off filled with the vibrancy of The First Tongue!
Immensity backed his Seals as they manifested externally around himself and Skoll!
The Absolute Seal of Quintessence blazed into existence, spinning with patterns that spoke of fundamental perfection!
The Absolute Seal of Infinity stretched outward, its endless designs conveying boundlessness made visible!
The Absolute Seal of Tyranny pressed down upon everything, demanding submission from reality itself!
The Absolute Seal of Fortune! The Absolute Seal of Advantage! The Absolute Seal of Narrative! The Absolute Seal of Harvest! The Absolute Seal of Hunger! The Absolute Seal of Potential!
Nine Seals that belonged only to him!
Nine letters of The First Tongue that he had forged himself!
They displayed externally around his form like a constellation spelling out his name in the oldest language!
Oh!
There were...many things that made what happened next possible!

His blazing eyes.

He looked like a fiend descending to deliver judgment.
He looked like something that should not be challenged.
He looked like an Absolute.
All of this gave him an extremely enticing and magnetic allure!

Momentarily, even the distant Gilgamesh felt something stir within him. The First Leader who never felt fear found his blood beginning to flow with possibility. His eyes shone with calculations that had not existed moments before.
Could this entity actually be what he claimed?
Could THE First Tongue have truly produced something on this level?
And THE Weavers...
A flash of surprise flickered across those decrepit faces!
A moment of hesitation as they looked at him closely!
Immensity gathered around them as if they were questioning themselves, questioning what they perceived, questioning whether this confrontation would proceed as they had originally planned!
And in that hesitation.
The moment Noah looked into those decrepit faces and golden pupils and saw that brief flash of uncertainty...
He raised his hand.
THE Absolute Seal of Infinity began to spin above his palm, burning with patterns of boundlessness that made space itself groan!
"When you fuck around..."
His voice carried across the Wastes with the inevitability of judgment being delivered.
"Eventually, you find out."
HUUM!
The distant Gilgamesh and the weaker THE entities from THE Loom stepped back slightly!
The weight of his words and Seals pressed against their existence with force that demanded respect!
And...!
And...!
WAP!
As everyone waited to see what this entity on the caliber of THE Creature and THE Living Paradox and THE Primordial Chaos would do...
Neon light flickered!
He, Skoll, and the shocked Lumivara and stern Ul’moreth disappeared!
Gone in an instant!
Extracted from the confrontation with speed that left afterimages of neon flame burning in the corrupted air!
Gilgamesh was astonished.
He froze completely, his ancient mind struggling to process what had just occurred. An entity had appeared, claimed Absolute status, displayed power that seemed to support that claim...
And then ran away?
And momentarily, THE Weavers also paused!
Their golden eyes flickered with confusion that beings of their classification rarely experienced. Their decrepit faces twisted with expressions that cycled through surprise, uncertainty, and then...
Understanding.
They had been played.
This entity had never intended to fight.

This entity had used presence and words and displayed power to create a moment of hesitation, a window of opportunity, and then exploited it with speed that should not have been possible for someone of his apparent classification.
An instant later...
BOOM!
An utterly overpowering and immense aura spilled from THE Weavers like an endless sea!
The Wastes around them cracked and fractured under the pressure of their fury! Reality itself screamed as three Absolutes released their suppressed authority in response to being deceived!
Their faces showed anger that had not touched them in eons!
Their voices spoke in unison, three ancient beings expressing the same sentiment as one!
"VILE!"
BOOM!
The word carried weight that would have collapsed anything below THE Fundamental Depth instantly!
An instant after, the Wastes around them fractured like broken mirrors!

THE Weavers disappeared, giving chase toward a direction only they could perceive! Their authority over fate and potentiality allowed them to track the threads of possibility that connected their quarry to their destination!
The chase had begun!
A moment after they shot out, Gilgamesh shook his head with incredulity.
Then he followed!
An Absolute had been bullshitted!
Three of them, actually!
THE Daughters of THE Night, THE Moirai, THE Weavers who controlled fates and potentialities...
Had been deceived by presence alone!
The Wastes of THE Fallout trembled as the chase thundered through corrupted reality!
Atop Skoll.
Noah felt the warm embrace of Lumivara who hugged him from behind.
"Master! You were gone for such a long time! For eons I waited! For so many years... and... and...!"

The little fox was badly injured. Her brilliant form flickered with instability, her Weavings damaged in ways that made Noah’s heart pulse. But she had him now. Her crimson-gold blood came to cover his back as she pressed against him, seemingly letting out all her grievances in that single desperate embrace.
Noah couldn’t help but soften his gaze.
He turned around to pat her head gently, his fingers running through fur that still burned with stubborn radiance despite everything she had endured.
Skoll continued to run at the fastest speed possible.

At this moment, Noah, Lumivara, and Ul’moreth were all atop the transformed Duke. Raging neon flames of The First Tongue surrounded them, blazing with colors that had no names. Noah’s Seals burned around the group in protective constellation, each one pulsing with weight that pressed against reality itself.
A Thesis was already activated.
|Skoll is fastest in Existence!|

The declaration rang through the fabric of the Wastes, asserting dominance over the concept of velocity itself. It wouldn’t hold forever against genuine Absolutes, but every fraction of advantage mattered.
While Lumivara hugged him, Noah’s gaze also came onto Ul’moreth.

The ancient Ginnu Lifeform’s radiant hairy figure seemed a bit dim after standing against THE Weavers for so long. The countless hairs around his body that usually blazed with obsidian-gold authority had lost some of their luster.
But Noah could feel his smile at this moment.
"You have grown, Little Anomaly."
Ul’moreth’s voice emerged warm despite their desperate circumstances.
"Even that doesn’t seem right at this moment... The First Anomaly? The Tongue Anomaly? Mmm... The Mana Anomaly?"
He seemed to be genuinely contemplating what to call Noah now.
"Either way, a lot has changed from Ginnungagap, but here we are again."
Here they were again.

Noah patted Lumivara as he looked toward Ul’moreth with a smile. He glanced back behind them where the allure of an Absolute felt infinitely close, but it had not arrived before their perception just yet.
He replied calmly.
"Here we are again. Last time, Absolutes were converging around us in Ginnungagap, and this time, it seems about the same. We just have to get past it ourselves."
His eyes blazed with certainty.
"There’s a lot of time to catch up on, but first... is survival. You’ll see a few things here and there, so don’t be too surprised."
Yes!
One had to be ready for surprises!
At this moment, Noah was making a straight beeline toward THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap!
Not because of THE Secretive Eon, no.
He knew she wouldn’t move a hand to help. The simulation had proven that definitively. She would watch him struggle and fall without lifting a finger unless the price was right.
No.
He was going to the same location another body of his had arrived at. The entrance in the Stoa of Dogmata where he was supposed to save the Disciple of THE Secretive Eon.
An entity of THE Fundamental Depth.
And yet even Eon could not go to save her Disciple.
She had said THE Fallout had corrupted many things in an obscene manner. That there were Corrupted Domains with strange Weavings of Existence that didn’t follow conventional logic.
That there was a region ahead that likely nullified power through some ancient methodology.
Perhaps it stripped away accumulated Weight.
Perhaps it enforced a baseline state on all who entered.
Perhaps it did something else entirely.
These were all words Eon had said to him when she showed him the fairy-like image of her Disciple who had gotten stuck in that place!
And Eon herself did not enter to retrieve her.
She said it was for one reason or another, but what was real and what was fake?
In Noah’s mind, a place an Absolute did not wish to enter because of whatever undeniable effect such a Corrupted region had... would be a place THE Weavers would think twice before entering!
And if they did enter?
His body there had already done a partial simulation for what he could expect in that location!
If THE Weavers did enter it... it may very well be their coffin!

chapters.title: Chapter 4753: Si Vis Pacem, Para Bellum III
paragraphs: This was his ideal plan.
Not to reverse time.

But to utilize THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap. The region within it in The Stoa of Dogmata that had been gloriously distorted by THE Fallout. A core domain of THE Vault of Ginnungapbefore it was corrupted!
They simply had to reach it.
But...
HUUM!
At this moment, like a burning sun, the scorching aura of THE Weavers raged behind them!

It pressed against reality with force that made the corrupted Wastes crack and splinter! The weight of three Absolutes in pursuit created pressure that would have collapsed anything below THE Fundamental Depth instantly!
Their voices echoed out.
Glorious.
Terrifying.
Three heavy, scratching voices speaking one after another in sequence that made the air itself recoil!
"Can the Claimer..."
"...of THE First Tongue..."
"...be such a coward?!"
The words overlapped and intertwined, each voice completing the thought of the one before!
"One of THE Four..."
"...running like a little bitch?..."
"...can your Way even survive such cowardice actions?!"
Such terrifying words echoed out!

Behind them, the sound as if Existence was breaking boomed through the Wastes! Obsidian-gold glimmers of light began to bloom as it felt like THE Weavers were getting ever closer! The threads of fate they controlled were pulling them inexorably toward their quarry!
Lumivara remained embracing Noah as if nothing else mattered.
Her injured form pressed against his back with desperate determination. Whatever happened, she would not let go. Whatever came, she would face it with him.
And Ul’moreth seemingly did not even pay attention to that screeching set of voices.
The ancient Ginnu Lifeform looked toward Noah with veiled eyes that seemingly held immense belief in him!
He had seen Noah grow from a curious anomaly in Ginnungagap to something that made Absolutes pause.
He believed.
Noah couldn’t betray this belief!
"In three nanoseconds..."
One of THE Weavers’ voices cut through the chaos with terrible precision!
"...You will be captured in my inescapable net, Little Coward of The First Tongue!"
WAA!
THE Weavers had their voices echo out again!
And at this time... far ahead, the outside boundary of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap appeared!

That massive crimson-gold cloudy barrier that extended for countless miles, shrouded by the ashen clouds and flames of THE Fallout! The entrance to a domain that predated The First Tongue’s differentiation!
Noah’s eyes shone sharply!
He went even faster!

Skoll’s neon flames blazed with intensity that exceeded anything he had displayed before! The transformed Duke pushed past limits that should have been absolute, driven by loyalty and the desperate need to protect his master and those his master cared about!
They surged toward the boundary!
And the moment they approached...
CRACK!
The terrifying figures of THE Weavers shattered space behind them to finally become visible!
Three decrepit forms wrapped in robes and hoods, their ancient faces twisted with fury, their golden eyes blazing with the light of fate itself being manipulated!
The two sides managed to observe each other briefly once more!
Noah stared into those multiple golden eyes!
He saw rage. He saw determination. He saw the absolute certainty of beings who had never once failed to catch their prey!
And then he disappeared into THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap!
BOOM!
Without fail, THE Weavers silently charged forward to follow!

Their obsidian-gold authority blazed around them as they crossed the boundary without hesitation! Whatever dangers this Corrupted Domain held, they would face them! Whatever price had to be paid, they would pay it!
The Claimer of THE First Tongue would not escape!
Across the boundary.
An instant later, things played out as if in slow motion.
Noah, Lumivara, and Ul’moreth seated on Skoll appeared in the Stoa of Dogmata!

The endless colonnade of pillars stretched in all directions, each one carved from crystallized authority that predated differentiation itself. Inscriptions of ancient Dogmata glowed upon their surfaces.
And there, exactly where she always was...
THE Secretive Eon raised her head up in surprise from her seated position!
Her dark eyes widened slightly as she observed the neon-blazing form of Skoll carrying three passengers thundering through her domain at speeds that should not have been possible!
Noah locked his gaze onto hers calmly.
And he nodded.
Just a simple, nonchalant gesture. As if he was casually saying hi while passing through on his way to somewhere else entirely.
Then he disappeared with the speed of an Absolute toward the depths of the Stoa of Dogmata where another body of his waited!
Moments after Noah passed through...
BOOM!
The aura of genuine Absolutes spilled out as space tore apart!
THE Weavers appeared!

Their wild authority erupted in all directions, pressing against the ancient pillars of the Stoa with force that made even this primordial domain groan! They were about to continue their chase when...
BOOM!
Their decrepit gazes suddenly became shocked and stern!
They stopped immediately!
They formed a protective circle where they stood, obsidian-gold auras blazing around them as they turned to look at... THE Secretive Eon!
Their gazes were extremely heavy!
As if they had come across something utterly perilous!
As if they wondered whether they had been led into a trap!
Three Absolutes who had been pursuing with absolute confidence now stood frozen, their attention fixed entirely on the small, delicate figure seated calmly upon the obsidian ground!
But...
In the heavy silence that followed, they shockingly observed THE Secretive Eon look toward them with interest.
Then she thoughtfully looked at the distance where Noah and his forces had disappeared to.
She never made a move.
She simply sat there with her legs crossed, her chin resting on her hand, watching events unfold with the patient curiosity of someone observing something mildly entertaining.
THE Weavers seemed to look at each other in sequence.
As if they were affirming something.
As if they were communicating through threads of fate that connected them.
They observed the nonchalant gaze of THE Secretive Eon who was looking at them as if they were absolutely nothing.
Such a gaze of contempt made them extremely stifled!
But they didn’t complain.
They couldn’t complain.
Not to her.
At this moment, one of THE Weavers pulled a golden string from the air and broke it. The snap echoed through the Stoa with finality that spoke of fate being read and accepted.
"We... are not her targets."
After such words, THE Weavers glanced at THE Secretive Eon with care.
Then slowly... they began to surge toward the same direction Noah had disappeared!
Their prey awaited!
And whatever that Corrupted Region held, it could not be worse than remaining in the presence of THE Secretive Eon while she stared at them like insects beneath her notice!
All that was left behind was Eon herself.
She remained where she was as if she was merely an observer and not a participant in all this!
"Interesting... very interesting."
Her voice emerged measured and unhurried, each word placed with precision.
"Where did THE Scale Breaker get such a speedy dog? And to have them chasing him..."
She smiled.
At this moment, Eon was seeing Skoll for the first time in actual Existence rather than simulation.
And this glorious moment here...
Noah’s entry.
THE Weavers’ entry.
The brief few seconds wasted by THE Weavers as they sensed the terrifying aura of Eon who at this time wasn’t hiding it.
They had stopped.
They had almost thought they were led into a trap.
All of this brought precious seconds for Noah!
He crossed the Stoa of Dogmata at impossible speed, racing toward the point where his other body stood before a massive swirling obsidian cluster of event horizons!
That body turned into a streak of light and fused into him!
He patted Skoll’s fur one final time.
The neon flaming brilliance blazed around them all!
And they delved into a Corrupted Region of THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungapap.
A region that even THE Secretive Eon did not wish to enter!

chapters.title: Chapter 4754: The Shores of Kleos!
paragraphs: THE Fallout did countless things that others could not even begin to fathom.
Only Absolutes truly understood what THE Fallout did and the long lasting effects that would carry out across Observable Existence.

But the idea of corruption and distortion was widespread throughout. One of the major things to understand was that THE Fallout came, yes, but there were always places that others had never been to. Places that even Fundamental Depth entities and Absolutes explored with caution even in Ginnungagap.
THE Vaults of Ginnungagap was one of them.
At this moment, they held the moniker of THE Corrupted Vaults of Ginnungagap!
So just what had the unique internal compartments that others may have never even been to changed into? The answer to this could only be experienced.
Because Existence was vast and filled with wonders.
THE Secretive Eon had told Noah there was much he didn’t know and understand. There was so much that many did not understand!
And he was about to experience one of those things firsthand.
BOOM!
Noah opened his eyes to a booming sound of Existence distorting and the sound of waves splashing on his body.

Even a partial simulation of this place had only yielded bits of information before it dissolved. It was an extremely unique place that resisted being modeled by THE Moirai Thread. But he had grasped what this place was upon initial entry.
At this time, he was looking at an endlessly blue sky filled with rivers of golden light and clouds moving above.
Not the corrupted gray of the Wastes.
Not the burning obsidian of Muspelheim.
An actual blue sky. Pristine. Ancient. Beautiful in a way that felt like it had been preserved from an era before corruption was even a concept.
He rose up from the waters hitting his body.
Nearby, Skoll shook his entire form to splash water everywhere!

Even Skoll was affected by this place.
And yet his tail still wagged. His tongue still lolled out. He was still having fun despite everything.
Such a good boy!

Her injuries from the confrontation with THE Weavers seemed less severe now, as if the waters themselves carried healing properties. Her brilliant form still flickered with instability, but there was hope in her eyes.
"Master... where are we?"
Her voice came soft with amazement.
The hairy figure of Ul’moreth had already stood up straight. He looked around with his veiled face showing amazement and a light of fervor. As if he had arrived at a place he had always dreamed of!
"This is... can it be?"
The ancient Ginnu Lifeform’s countless hairs rippled with excitement despite being suppressed.
"Little Anomaly, do you know what this place is? Do you understand where we have arrived?"

|Welcome to equality.|

The prompts were grand ones that outlined exactly where they had entered!
Noah rose fully while raising his hand and clenching to feel the vibrant power flowing through him!
His Way and Civilization was restricted to THE Surface Depth, yes.
But many beings at THE Surface Depth held varying Weights and Immensity.
His?
Hoho!

Even suppressed to Surface levels, he could feel the density of what he had accumulated. Twenty-seven Seals compressed into a space that should only hold a fraction of that authority. Knowledge of The First Tongue that most Surface Depth entities couldn’t even dream of. Techniques and understanding that transcended the limitations being placed upon his raw power.
And this place was one of boundless possibilities!
Beings like Ul’moreth had been looking for it whenever they delved into THE Vaults of Ginnungagap before. A place of complex and stable civilization put in place by Perfected Ginnu Lifeforms.
There were Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms like Ul’moreth who were the first tries of Existence, experimental creations that came before the template was refined.
And then there were Perfected Ginnu Lifeforms!
The ideal. The complete. The final expression of what that ancient race was always meant to become.
And...
HUUM!
Further ahead, on the sandy beaches, auras bloomed!
Noah, Ul’moreth, and Lumivara turned toward the source of the pressure.
The brilliance of one Fundamental Depth entity and three Intermediate Depth entities floated over as they looked... grand.
Even at Fundamental Depth within this domain’s limitations, the lead entity radiated presence that felt utterly suffocating. As if one was staring at a Half-Step Absolute! His Weight was that heavy!
This was what it meant to accumulate merit within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment. To build authority through contribution and wisdom rather than external power.
A voice filled with power boomed out from the forefront.
"Newly arriving Hoplites, welcome to The Shores of Kleos."

The speaker was a muscular humanoid man whose body glinted with white and gold. His physique was carved from millennia of existence, every muscle defined with the precision of something that had been perfected rather than merely developed.

His face held ancient beauty that transcended conventional aesthetics. High cheekbones beneath eyes that shimmered with golden light. A strong jaw softened by lips that seemed accustomed to both stern judgment and warm welcome. His hair was dark as the void between stars but threaded with strands of silver that caught the golden rivers of light flowing across the sky.

He wore a toga of pristine white trimmed with gold, draped across his form with the casual elegance of someone who had worn such garments for longer than most civilizations had existed. A laurel wreath of living leaves crowned his head, and upon his chest, a golden pin depicted a shield, spear, and laurel wreath intertwined.
Fundamental Depth within this domain. One of the elite!
"Welcome to THE Ideal Civilization, THE Agora of Primordial Judgment."
His voice resonated with authority that made the very air compress.
"Come now, and let us see what you can contribute to the vastness of Existence."
BOOM!
The three Intermediate Depth entities flanking him stepped forward in unison.
They were not all humanoid.

One resembled a great lion whose mane was composed of flowing golden light rather than fur. His eyes held the same ancient beauty as the leader, that sense of having been refined across eons until only perfection remained. A toga was draped across his massive shoulders in a manner that should have looked ridiculous but somehow appeared utterly natural.

Another was serpentine, her coils shimmering with scales that shifted between white and gold with each movement. Her face was humanoid but elongated, beautiful in a way that made observers question what beauty even meant. Laurels wrapped around her crown, and her toga flowed down her upper body before transitioning seamlessly into her serpentine lower half.

The third was abstract, a being of geometric shapes that constantly rearranged themselves into configurations that suggested humanoid form without ever quite achieving it. And yet even this entity carried that same grace, that same sense of ancient perfection that defined the Primordial Perfected.
These were not the Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms that Noah had encountered before.
These were not experimental creations still finding their form.
These were the Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeforms!
Beings who had achieved what Ul’moreth and his kind had always aspired toward. Beings who represented the final, ideal expression of the Ginnu template.
And they looked upon Noah and his companions with gazes that held neither hostility nor particular warmth.
Only assessment.
Only evaluation.
Only the patient curiosity of a civilization that had seen multiple newcomers wash upon these shores and would soon see more.

"I am Alexandros," the muscular Lifeform continued."I oversee the integration of new arrivals into our society. You have questions. That is natural. You have concerns. That is expected. You may even have plans to leave as quickly as possible."
His lips curved into a smile that held eons of experience with exactly such plans.
"All of that can be addressed in time. For now, understand this single truth."
His golden eyes swept across Noah, Ul’moreth, Lumivara, and the neon-blazing form of Skoll.

"Within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, you are what you prove yourself to be. Nothing more. Nothing less. Your past achievements mean nothing here. Your external power means nothing here. Only what you contribute, only what you demonstrate, only what you earn through merit will determine your standing."
He gestured toward the beaches and the civilization that lay beyond.
"Welcome to equality, Hoplites. Now... let us see what you are truly made of."

chapters.title: Chapter 4755: Paths And Merit!
paragraphs: The Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeforms were unique in that even when Noah activated his Lens of a Civilization...
|ENTITY ANALYSIS: ALEXANDROS|
|Classification: Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeform|
|Rank: Polemarch (War Leader of Wisdom)|
|Depth Within Domain: THE Fundamental Depth|
|Weight Assessment: Approaches Half-Step Absolute parameters despite Depth limitations|
|Additional Information: Restricted. Higher clearance required.|
|ENTITY ANALYSIS: LEONIKOS|
|Classification: Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeform|
|Form: Leonine|
|Rank: Lochagos (Captain of Merit)|
|Depth Within Domain: THE Intermediate Depth|
|Additional Information: Restricted. Higher clearance required.|
|ENTITY ANALYSIS: OPHELIA|
|Classification: Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeform|
|Form: Serpentine|
|Rank: Lochagos (Captain of Merit)|
|Depth Within Domain: THE Intermediate Depth|
|Additional Information: Restricted. Higher clearance required.|
|ENTITY ANALYSIS: GEOMETROS|
|Classification: Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeform|
|Form: Abstract/Geometric|
|Rank: Lochagos (Captain of Merit)|
|Depth Within Domain: THE Intermediate Depth|
|Additional Information: Restricted. Higher clearance required.|
He obtained the bare minimum information on these beings as they led them away from the shore.
The Lens of a Civilization could only pierce so far into the mysteries of Primordial Perfected entities. They were ancient beyond measure, and many things here were restricted!
Noah patted an excited Skoll who seemed ready to run off and explore everything at once.

The transformed Duke’s neon flames still burned despite being suppressed to Surface Depth. His tail wagged with enthusiasm. This place was new. This place was interesting. This place had so many things to smell and see!
Alexandros continued to speak as he led them up the beach.
"We have had different entrants across the Weavings of Existence since THE Great Change occurred."
His voice carried the weight of someone who had witnessed countless arrivals over eons.

"Some act up and need to be beaten down a little before they come to accept the terms of this place. Pride makes fools of even the powerful. They believe their external authority should translate into internal standing."
He glanced back at Noah with golden eyes that held knowing amusement.
"It does not."
His toga rippled as he walked, the fabric catching light from the golden rivers flowing across the sky.

"But even the dumbest ones eventually realize that this place is a paradise for power and immensity. Only those who have forged a Civilization may enter here, and those who do arrive for the first time get brought down to THE Surface Depth as this place gives you a chance to rebuild an unrivaled foundation for your Depth."
He paused to let those words settle.
"To learn about expressions of power perfected over eons. Power relating to the Oldest Paradox of Existence itself. And of course..."
His smile widened.

"Unfathomable treasures from THE Vault of Ginnungagap. Items that have not seen the light of Observable Existence since before THE Fallout. Knowledge that predates the modern understanding of Depth entirely."
The beach gradually transitioned into firmer ground as they ascended a gentle slope.
"But first, as any Hoplites get the chance to... you get to choose which path you follow."
And then the view opened up before them.
Massive archway gateways shimmered ahead!
Four of them, arranged in a grand semicircle at the crest of the hill. Each one was constructed from stone that seemed to have been carved by concepts rather than tools.

Pillars supported triangular pediments adorned with intricate reliefs depicting scenes of philosophical triumph. The architecture spoke of an era when beauty and function were inseparable, when every structure was built to last for eternities.
Each archway had a radiant road leading from it toward a barely discernible outline of glorious structures in the distance!

Similar to the limitation outside in The Wastes of THE Fallout, one could barely perceive anything less than a mile ahead in this domain. Many things in the distance were a haze of golden light that obscured details while hinting at grandeur beyond imagination.
But their focus was on the golden archways themselves!
They shone with brilliance that Noah, Ul’moreth, and Lumivara very much recognized!
The light of The First Tongue’s influence. The resonance of fundamental principles given architectural form.
Alexandros stopped before the four gateways and turned to face them fully.
"The choice for any Hoplites is the path they follow."
He gestured toward the first archway.
"There are the Chaosites. Followers of Chaos."
The archway shone with deep stellar obsidian!

Not mere black, but the darkness between stars given physical form. Within that darkness, points of light flickered and died and were born again in patterns that followed no discernible logic. The pillars seemed stable one moment and fluid the next. The pediment above depicted scenes of order crumbling into beautiful entropy.

"Their philosophy holds that order is an illusion. Structure is temporary. Only by embracing disorder can one understand the true nature of reality. They seek truth through the dissolution of false certainties."
Alexandros moved to the second archway.
"Then there are the Existentialists. Followers of Existence."
This archway shone with multicolored brilliance!

Every color that could be perceived and many that could not swirled across its surface in patterns that somehow remained coherent despite their complexity. The pillars pulsed with the rhythm of heartbeats, of breath, of the simple act of being. The pediment depicted scenes of entities simply existing in various forms, celebrating the fundamental fact of their presence.

"Their philosophy holds that being precedes essence. Existence itself is the highest value. All other considerations are secondary to the fundamental fact of existing. They seek truth through the pure experience of being."
He moved to the third archway.
"Then there are the Paradoxians. Followers of Paradox."
This archway shone with light that was simultaneously white, gold, and black!

The pillars appeared solid and ethereal at the same time. The pediment depicted scenes that showed both victory and defeat, creation and destruction, truth and lies, all occupying the same space without contradiction. Looking at it for too long made one’s perception twist in ways that were uncomfortable but strangely enlightening.

"Their philosophy holds that truth is found in contradiction. The highest understanding comes from holding two opposing ideas simultaneously and finding meaning in their tension. They seek truth through the embrace of impossibility."
Finally, he moved to the fourth archway.
"And lastly, there are the Glossarians. Followers of The First Tongue."
This archway shone with blue-gold radiance that Noah recognized intimately!

The pillars were inscribed with Phonemes that shifted and reformed with each passing moment. The pediment depicted scenes of words creating worlds, of language shaping reality, of speakers whose declarations became law. The very air around it hummed with linguistic authority.

"Their philosophy holds that language is the foundation of all reality. The First Tongue is not merely a tool but the very fabric from which Existence is woven. Mastery of language is mastery of everything. They seek truth through perfect expression."
Alexandros turned back to face them fully.
"So, which path will you follow?"
His golden eyes swept across Noah, Ul’moreth, Lumivara, and Skoll.

"Different paths, but here, everybody falls under the same rankings. All beings within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment are assigned a rank that determines the maximum Depth they can express. Ranks are earned through merit, not accumulated through external power.The Taxis of Merit!"
He began counting on his fingers.

"Merit is gained through contributing to society. Inventions, ideas, unique items, services that benefit the collective. Through winning formal debates in Dogma and Thesis contests. Through completing tasks assigned by higher-ranked officials. Through demonstrating philosophical insight that advances understanding. And through acts of valor in defense of the domain, though those are rare but highly valued."
His smile returned with warmth that seemed almost paternal.

"You all are currently Hoplites at THE Surface Depth. But you can increase in rank as you refine your foundations. Rise to become LOCHAGOS, the Captains of Merit, with a Depth Limitation of THE Intermediate Depth. Or even become a POLEMARCH like myself, a War Leader of Wisdom who is unrivaled at Fundamental Depth!"

|Rank: Lochagos (Captain of Merit)|
|Depth Within Domain: THE Intermediate Depth|
|Additional Information: Restricted.
Higher clearance required.|
He obtained the bare minimum information on these beings as they led them away from the shore.
The Lens of a Civilization could only pierce so far into the mysteries of Primordial Perfected entities.
They were ancient beyond measure, and many things here were restricted!
Noah patted an excited Skoll who seemed ready to run off and explore everything at once.
The transformed Duke’s neon flames still burned despite being suppressed to Surface Depth.
His tail wagged with enthusiasm.
This place was new.
This place was interesting.
This place had so many things to smell and see!
Alexandros continued to speak as he led them up the beach.
"We have had different entrants across the Weavings of Existence since THE Great Change occurred."
His voice carried the weight of someone who had witnessed countless arrivals over eons.
"Some act up and need to be beaten down a little before they come to accept the terms of this place.
Pride makes fools of even the powerful.
They believe their external authority should translate into internal standing."
He glanced back at Noah with golden eyes that held knowing amusement.
"It does not."
His toga rippled as he walked, the fabric catching light from the golden rivers flowing across the sky.
"But even the dumbest ones eventually realize that this place is a paradise for power and immensity.

Only those who have forged a Civilization may enter here, and those who do arrive for the first time get brought down to THE Surface Depth as this place gives you a chance to rebuild an unrivaled foundation for your Depth."
He paused to let those words settle.
"To learn about expressions of power perfected over eons.
Power relating to the Oldest Paradox of Existence itself.
And of course..."
His smile widened.
"Unfathomable treasures from THE Vault of Ginnungagap.
Items that have not seen the light of Observable Existence since before THE Fallout.
Knowledge that predates the modern understanding of Depth entirely."
The beach gradually transitioned into firmer ground as they ascended a gentle slope.
"But first, as any Hoplites get the chance to... you get to choose which path you follow."
And then the view opened up before them.
Massive archway gateways shimmered ahead!
Four of them, arranged in a grand semicircle at the crest of the hill.
Each one was constructed from stone that seemed to have been carved by concepts rather than tools.
Pillars supported triangular pediments adorned with intricate reliefs depicting scenes of philosophical triumph.
The architecture spoke of an era when beauty and function were inseparable, when every structure was built to last for eternities.
Each archway had a radiant road leading from it toward a barely discernible outline of glorious structures in the distance!
Similar to the limitation outside in The Wastes of THE Fallout, one could barely perceive anything less than a mile ahead in this domain.
Many things in the distance were a haze of golden light that obscured details while hinting at grandeur beyond imagination.
But their focus was on the golden archways themselves!
They shone with brilliance that Noah, Ul’moreth, and Lumivara very much recognized!
The light of The First Tongue’s influence.
The resonance of fundamental principles given architectural form.
Alexandros stopped before the four gateways and turned to face them fully.
"The choice for any Hoplites is the path they follow."
He gestured toward the first archway.
"There are the Chaosites.
Followers of Chaos."
The archway shone with deep stellar obsidian!
Not mere black, but the darkness between stars given physical form.
Within that darkness, points of light flickered and died and were born again in patterns that followed no discernible logic.
The pillars seemed stable one moment and fluid the next.
The pediment above depicted scenes of order crumbling into beautiful entropy.
"Their philosophy holds that order is an illusion.
Structure is temporary.
Only by embracing disorder can one understand the true nature of reality.
They seek truth through the dissolution of false certainties."
Alexandros moved to the second archway.
"Then there are the Existentialists.
Followers of Existence."
This archway shone with multicolored brilliance!
Every color that could be perceived and many that could not swirled across its surface in patterns that somehow remained coherent despite their complexity.
The pillars pulsed with the rhythm of heartbeats, of breath, of the simple act of being.
The pediment depicted scenes of entities simply existing in various forms, celebrating the fundamental fact of their presence.
"Their philosophy holds that being precedes essence.
Existence itself is the highest value.
All other considerations are secondary to the fundamental fact of existing.
They seek truth through the pure experience of being."
He moved to the third archway.
"Then there are the Paradoxians.
Followers of Paradox."
This archway shone with light that was simultaneously white, gold, and black!
The pillars appeared solid and ethereal at the same time.
The pediment depicted scenes that showed both victory and defeat, creation and destruction, truth and lies, all occupying the same space without contradiction.
Looking at it for too long made one’s perception twist in ways that were uncomfortable but strangely enlightening.
"Their philosophy holds that truth is found in contradiction.
The highest understanding comes from holding two opposing ideas simultaneously and finding meaning in their tension.
They seek truth through the embrace of impossibility."
Finally, he moved to the fourth archway.
"And lastly, there are the Glossarians.
Followers of The First Tongue."
This archway shone with blue-gold radiance that Noah recognized intimately!
The pillars were inscribed with Phonemes that shifted and reformed with each passing moment.
The pediment depicted scenes of words creating worlds, of language shaping reality, of speakers whose declarations became law.
The very air around it hummed with linguistic authority.
"Their philosophy holds that language is the foundation of all reality.
The First Tongue is not merely a tool but the very fabric from which Existence is woven.
Mastery of language is mastery of everything.
They seek truth through perfect expression."
Alexandros turned back to face them fully.
"So, which path will you follow?"
His golden eyes swept across Noah, Ul’moreth, Lumivara, and Skoll.
"Different paths, but here, everybody falls under the same rankings.
All beings within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment are assigned a rank that determines the maximum Depth they can express.
Ranks are earned through merit, not accumulated through external power.The Taxis of Merit!"
He began counting on his fingers.
"Merit is gained through contributing to society.
Inventions, ideas, unique items, services that benefit the collective.
Through winning formal debates in Dogma and Thesis contests.
Through completing tasks assigned by higher-ranked officials.
Through demonstrating philosophical insight that advances understanding.
And through acts of valor in defense of the domain, though those are rare but highly valued."
His smile returned with warmth that seemed almost paternal.
"You all are currently Hoplites at THE Surface Depth.
But you can increase in rank as you refine your foundations.
Rise to become LOCHAGOS, the Captains of Merit, with a Depth Limitation of THE Intermediate Depth.
Or even become a POLEMARCH like myself, a War Leader of Wisdom who is unrivaled at Fundamental Depth!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4756: Glossarians! I
paragraphs: Alexandros said all of this with a smile while his followers remained calm.
Leonikos the lion observed with eyes that held the patience of eternity.
Ophelia the serpent watched with curiosity that seemed particularly focused on Noah.
Geometros the abstract shifted through configurations that suggested deep contemplation.
They were simply observing and learning from this entity who was higher ranked than them!
"Master! We know where to go so we can outshine everyone, right?!"
Lumivara spoke with excitement at this moment while looking toward a certain archway!
The blue-gold radiance of the Glossarian gate seemed to call to her, to resonate with everything they had learned and become under Noah’s guidance.
Noah and Ul’moreth couldn’t help but smile!
The path was obvious, wasn’t it? They who had claimed The First Tongue, who had forged new Phonemes, who had built their entire advancement upon linguistic mastery...
The Glossarians awaited.
And yet, at this time...
HUUM!
Far behind them, obsidian-gold light shone!
The sandy beach trembled! The shores in the distance vibrated with the arrival of something that carried authority even when suppressed!
When they turned around...
The visages of THE Weavers appeared!

Three decrepit figures wrapped in robes and hoods, their ancient faces twisted with fury that had only grown during their pursuit. Their golden eyes blazed with the light of fate itself being manipulated. Even reduced to Surface Depth, they radiatedmenacethat made the very air recoil.
The moment they appeared, Noah only stared at them calmly.
He did not move. He did not flinch. He did not show any sign of concern whatsoever.
His gaze waspurposefullyraised high and imperious.
As if he were looking atants.
THE Weavers were infuriated and calm at the same time when seeing this gaze!
How dare he?!
How DARE this creature look upon THE Moirai with such contempt?!
Their eyes seemingly broke down where they stood, analyzing the surrounding Weavings of Existence. Calculating. Planning. Preparing to strike despite whatever rules this domain might hold.
And then...
BOOM!
THE Weavers shot toward Noah and the others!
Three streams of obsidian-gold light converging on a single point! Their suppressed power still carried enough force to devastate anything at Surface Depth! Their fury drove them beyond caution!
Lumivara and Ul’moreth frowned while trying to get in front of Noah!
But he held them back while shaking his head.
Not yet.
Not necessary.
Because a moment later...
HUUM!
Alexandros moved!

The Polemarch’s form blurred with speed that should have been impossible at Fundamental Depth! The spear he carried in his hands shone a glorious golden obsidian as infinite seas of Chaos seemed to be contained within its seemingly simple form!
His blow carried unfathomable depth and weight!
A swing of his spear shockingly smashed onto THE Weavers even faster than they came!
BOOM!
The collision was catastrophic!
A paradoxical golden light of immensity buzzed around THE Weavers, their own authority trying to deflect the blow! But their faces showed calm fury as they were shockingly pushed back by Alexandros!
Pushed back!
Three Absolutes, even suppressed, forced to retreat by a single Fundamental Depth entity!
All of the surroundings darkened!
Alexandros revealed himself fully as a Chaosite!

His entire figure now burned with boundless Primordial Chaos! The toga he wore seemed to dissolve into streams of entropy that swirled around his muscular form! His golden eyes became voids filled with dying stars! His spear burned with the authority of endings that came before new beginnings!
Immense waves of Phonemes formed around him!
Chaos! Darkness! Endings!

They coalesced into dense Philologies that pressed against reality itself, constructs of linguistic authority refined over eons until they achieved perfection that modern practitioners could only dream of!
"NO FIGHTING ALLOWED BY ANY HOPLITES!"
His voice boomed across the shores with authority that made even THE Weavers pause!
"REGARDLESS OF WHAT POWER YOU HELD BEFORE!"
His spear pointed directly at the three decrepit figures.
"IF YOU WISH TO FIGHT, DO SO IN THE GLORY OF THE ARENA OR DURING DEBATES! UNTIL THEN... BEHAVE!"
The Chaos around him intensified until it felt like standing at the edge of a collapsing Existence!
"YOU DO NOT WISH TO BE MARKED ASDEPLORABLES!"
BOOM!
A glorious scene unfolded!
Absolutes knocked back by someone seemingly lesser than them!

THE Weavers floated in the air where they had been pushed, their golden eyes burning with calm fury that had no outlet. They could not attack. They could not pursue. They could not do anything without facing consequences within this domain’s rules.
They were bound by the same limitations as everyone else.
And someone of higher rank had just demonstrated exactly what those limitations meant.
Noah looked at this scene with shining eyes!
This place held boundless possibilities!

A domain where Absolutes could be challenged by those who had earned their standing through merit. Where external power meant nothing and internal refinement meant everything. Where THE Weavers, despite being genuine Absolutes outside these boundaries, were now merely Hoplites.
Just like him.
Just like Ul’moreth and Lumivara.
Equal in rank.
Equal in suppressed Depth.
But not equal in knowledge. Not equal in understanding. Not equal in the foundations they had built.
And in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, those foundations were exactly what mattered.
Noah’s smile widened as he turned back toward the four archways.
And he whispered just for THE Weavers to hear...
"Wait for me, you old hags. Just wait for me to butcher you and eat you whole."
BOOM!
THE Weavers could wait for him to butcher them.
Their eyes flashed with a chilly light as they heard his words!
At this time, Noah went toward the gateway of The Glossarians as if THE Weavers had absolutely nothing to do with him.
After all, he couldn’t do anything against them right now.

An Absolute restricted to Surface Depth versus the current him right now? He wouldn’t be able to leave a scratch on them. Their accumulated knowledge, their refined techniques, their eons of Depth... all of that remained even when their raw power was suppressed.
What he needed to do was gain enough merit to become a Polemarch.
And be faster than THE Weavers at doing it.

Because with these entities at the level of Absolute, he knew they would quickly adapt in this place. They would use their terrifying power of understanding to gain merit and rapidly ascend through the ranks. They had existed for eons beyond counting. They had accumulated wisdom that most beings couldn’t even comprehend.
At that time, if he was slow...
They could challenge him in the arena or debates and butcher him instead!
