That casual display of power that had nearly collapsed everything he was building.
That arrogant inquiry from a being who viewed others as interesting specimens rather than equals.
Noah remembered.
And he always collected his debts!
Due to how rapidly he progressed, there were times when enemies he detested... he bypassed their power so completely that it wasn’t even fun when they collapsed beneath his Weight.
By the time he was ready to face them, they had become insects beneath his heel.
The satisfaction of vengeance was hollow when the target couldn’t even comprehend what was happening to them.
Gilgamesh was at a sweet spot that was just right!
His own Weight and Immensity was breaking toward Fundamental as Gilgamesh would be a worthy existence to carve out his glory!
A genuine challenge.
A meaningful victory.
Something he could savor rather than simply execute.
And as he did this here, he was particularly focused on the actions of his body in the deeper areas of this Vault of Ginnungagap.
He felt like it was time to spread the Phonemes he created.
After seeing THE Creature lay out an Embodiment utilizing The First Tongue and gaining nothing from it...
Noah wanted to collect taxes on all the harvest and usage of The First Tongue.
He would be able to do so more closely with his personally forged Phonemes!
The 18 Core Phonemes had existed before his Claim.
Others had been using them for eons.
Harvesting from that usage was indirect, filtered through layers of established practice as the harvest was a mere percentage and ongoing.
But his 9 original Phonemes?
Quintessence.
Infinity.
Tyranny.
Fortune.
Advantage.
Narrative.
Harvest.
Hunger.
Potential.
These were his creations.
His contributions to The First Tongue.
Every being who learned and used them would be using something that Noah had personally brought into existence.
The harvest from that would be direct.
The harvest from that would be his alone as he would tax absolutely everyone!
So as a glorious battle began to show a supposed leader what a true tyrannical leader was like, his gaze flickered to another place deeper from here.
Back in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment!

In the library of The Glossarians that represented an opportunity to collapse an Absolute while reinforcing his Way again and again, and obtaining the treasures lying within this Vault of Ginnungagap!
In the Logoseion.
The atmosphere was thick with anticipation.
Noah floated above the swirling blue-gold plasma sea, his toga inscribed with shifting Phonemes, his laurel of crystallized language catching light that seemed to come from nowhere.
The zero upon his chest marked him as a newcomer.
A Hoplite with zero Merit daring to challenge a Lochagos with nearly 450.
Opposite him, Theoris the Articulate maintained her position with casual elegance.
Her vibrant spectacles reflected the plasma sea below.
Her dark hair flowed in currents of linguistic energy that swirled around her form.
Her toga displayed CDXLVIII in glowing numerals.
The surrounding Glossarians watched in silence.
This was the scholarly air of the Logoseion.
Even though many carried looks of mocking amusement, even though laughter had rippled through the crowd moments before, they did not scream or roar out their entertainment.
They stayed silent while watching the debate ahead.
This was a place of learning.
Even foolishness could teach valuable lessons.
Hoplites of various forms sat in circular arrangement, their eyes fixed on the confrontation.
Bears and serpents and humanoids and abstract beings, all wearing blue-gold togas, all curious to see how badly this newcomer would be humiliated.
The Lochagoi present observed with more nuanced expressions.
Some showed pity.
Some showed boredom.
A few showed the faintest glimmers of interest, wondering if perhaps this Hoplite knew something they didn’t.
Ophelia watched from the crowd with wide eyes, her serpentine form coiled tightly with concern for the newcomer she had been assigned to guide.
Lumivara’s tail swished with barely contained excitement.
Ul’moreth’s veiled eyes burned with anticipation.
Skoll sat on his haunches with his tongue out, not understanding what was happening but happy to be here with his new Master.
Theoris gazed at Noah with imperious confidence.
"I will not even push for a complex debate of Logos or Philologies for you."
Her voice carried the patient condescension of a teacher addressing a particularly slow student.
"We can simply conjure a single Phoneme and see who writes it out the best.
To its truest expression."
She adjusted her spectacles with one finger.
"This is the most basic test of linguistic understanding.
If you cannot even express a single Phoneme with clarity, there is no point discussing higher constructs."
Her lips curved into a smile that held no warmth.
"Consider this a lesson, Hoplite.
Learn from your failure today, and perhaps in a few centuries, you might be worthy of standing where you currently stand."
Her words were calm with a hint of majesty.
As if she was taking the time to educate a junior!
As if this debate was already decided and she was simply going through the motions out of obligation!
The surrounding Glossarians nodded with approval at her generosity.
She was giving this foolish newcomer the simplest possible test.
She was being merciful.
Theoris raised her finger.
Light began to gather at its tip.
She inscribed the Phoneme of Fire into the air before her!
The construct blazed into existence with fiery brilliance!
Crimson and blue light intertwined in patterns that spoke of combustion and heat and transformation!
The Phoneme burned above the plasma sea with intensity that made nearby observers shield their eyes!
It was beautiful.
It was precise.
It was the work of someone who had spent eons refining their understanding of this single concept.
Every curve of the inscription was perfect.
Every line carried meaning that supported and enhanced the whole.
The Phoneme of Fire as Theoris expressed it was a masterwork of linguistic artistry.
The crowd murmured with appreciation.
This was why she was close to becoming a Polemarch.
This was the standard against which this foolish Hoplite would be measured.
Noah looked at it.
His eyes traced every line.
Every curve.
Every subtle inflection of meaning that Theoris had woven into her expression of Fire.
Then he nodded.
"Adequate."
The word hung in the air.
What?
Adequate?
ADEQUATE?!
Whispers erupted through the Logoseion!
Hoplites exchanged glances of disbelief!
Lochagoi raised eyebrows at the sheer audacity of this newcomer!
Theoris’s expression flickered with the first hint of irritation.
"Adequate?" she repeated, her voice carrying dangerous edges.
"You dare call my expression of Fire merely adequate?
Do you have any idea how many years I have spent refining-"
But before she could finish.
Before anyone could react.
Noah waved his hand.
And he revealed not merely the Phoneme of Fire.
He revealed THE Absolute Seal of Fire!
BOOM!
The moment it fully came to fruition, the entire Logoseion shuddered!
The Seal blazed into existence above Noah’s palm with radiance that made Theoris’s Phoneme look like a candle beside a sun!
It was massive, perhaps ten meters in diameter, and it burned with patterns of such impossible complexity that observers felt their minds straining just to perceive its edges!
This was Fire.
Not the Fire that mortals understood.
Not the Fire that even ancient scholars had spent eons studying.
This was Fire as it existed in the deepest foundations of reality.
Fire as a concept so fundamental that it predated the formation of stars.
Fire as one of the 18 pillars upon which The First Tongue itself was constructed.
And more than that...
Within the Seal, compressed and refined and made infinitely more dense, were the Stanchions that Noah had absorbed into this singular expression.
Every aspect of combustion.
Every facet of heat.
Every nuance of transformation through burning.
All of it contained in one perfect, impossible construct.
Theoris was stunned!
Her vibrant spectacles seemed to fog over as she looked the Seal up and down, her enhanced perception struggling to process what she was witnessing!
It was the Phoneme of Fire.
But so much more glorious!
So much more... complete!
She had spent years on years perfecting her expression of Fire.
She had believed herself among the greatest practitioners of this particular Phoneme in all of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
And this newcomer had just casually displayed something that made her life’s work look like a child’s first attempt at writing!
She was not the only one affected.
When Glossarians looked up and saw the Seal, they were initially confused.
What was this?
It looked like the Phoneme of Fire, but the structure was wrong.
No, not wrong.
Different.
More.
It was as if someone had taken the Phoneme they all knew and revealed that it was merely a shadow of something far greater.
Then shock rippled through the crowd!
This was real.
This was actually happening.
A Hoplite with zero Merit had just displayed mastery of Fire that exceeded anything the Logoseion had witnessed in recorded memory!
Then contemplation descended.
An immense silence fell across the entire chamber.
All eyes focused on that Seal.
All minds struggled to understand what they were seeing.
All preconceptions about this debate were being violently restructured.
That Seal!
That impossible, glorious, reality-defining Seal!
Even Ul’moreth and Lumivara looked at it with vibrant eyes!
They had not fully seen Noah’s Seals before.
They had witnessed his mastery of The First Tongue.
But seeing it displayed here, in this ancient place of linguistic study, surrounded by beings who had dedicated their entire existences to understanding these concepts...
It hit differently.
At this time, Noah allowed the Seal to continue burning above his palm.
He looked out at the gathered Glossarians with eyes that held the calm certainty of one who knew exactly what he was doing.
"Today, I wish to do many things."
His voice carried across the silent Logoseion with weight that pressed against every listener.
"This is just a glimpse."
He gestured toward the Seal of Fire, toward the impossible perfection it represented.
"Barring this debate, I wish to make a contribution and elevate what the Glossarians know about The First Tongue."
The Seal pulsed with radiance that made the plasma sea below churn with excited energy.
"Today..."
His eyes swept across Hoplites and Lochagoi alike.
"I wish to teach."
BOOM!
The words landed like hammers upon the foundations of everything the Glossarians believed!
A Hoplite.
A newcomer with zero Merit.
Claiming that he wished to TEACH those who had studied The First Tongue for eons?!
But that Seal continued to burn above his palm.
That impossible, undeniable proof of mastery that exceeded anything they had achieved.
And slowly, one by one, the mocking expressions faded from faces throughout the Logoseion.
Something was happening here!

chapters.title: Chapter 4765: I Wish To Expand! I
paragraphs: A Hoplite wished to teach after they showed a Lochagos a much grander version of the Phoneme of The First Tongue!
And first and foremost, because of this...
The booming voice of the Logoseion echoed out with weight that made the plasma sea churn!
"A unique construct of the Phoneme of Fire of The First Tongue has been presented!"
The words resonated through every corner of the chamber.
"The Hoplite has triumphed over Lochagos Theoris the Articulate! His expression of Fire exceeds all recorded variations within the Logoseion archives! This is unprecedented for a newcomer!"
Theoris floated in stunned silence, her vibrant spectacles still reflecting the impossible Seal that burned above Noah’s palm.
"5 MERIT POINTS awarded for winning a debate against someone of higher ranking and showing what has been deemed to be new!"
The voice paused with what might have been curiosity.
"And now, you wish to... teach? What should you be referred to as, Hoplite?"
The voice asked such a question as at this time, on Noah’s toga, the Merit points changed.
Zero became V.
Zero became five.
The first step on a long climb.
Noah looked out at the gathered Glossarians with eyes that held the calm certainty of absolute conviction.
"Osmont. THE Genesis Monarch."
WAA!
He said his distinction out clearly!
The words landed with weight that made several nearby Hoplites take unconscious steps backward. THE Genesis Monarch. Not merely a title, but a declaration of what he was and what he represented.
The booming voice of the Logoseion echoed out again.
"THE Genesis Monarch wishes to make a contribution to the Glossarians. He has proven himself worthy of attention through unprecedented expression of a Core Phoneme."
A pause.
"Permission has been granted to display any novelty and wonder. The Logoseion awaits."
Many eyes went toward him.

Hundreds of Glossarians. Hoplites who had mocked him moments ago now watching with uncertain expressions. Lochagoi who had expected entertainment now leaning forward with genuine interest. Even a few Polemarchs in the distant shadows stirred.
Noah looked back at the masses.
Then he spoke.
"Language is the foundation of reality."
His voice carried across the Logoseion with the weight of absolute truth.

"This is what the Glossarians believe. This is what I know to be true. The First Tongue was not merely discovered. It was the medium through which Existence itself was first expressed. Every Phoneme represents a fundamental concept. Every Logos builds meaning from those concepts. Every Philology weaves those meanings into complex truths."
He let those words settle.
"But at times, the letters of a language are not enough to portray the full immensity of what the language could express."
His eyes swept across the gathered scholars.

"Languages evolve. Languages grow. Languages expand to encompass new ideas that their original creators never imagined. This is the nature of all communication, from the simplest grunts of primitive beings to the most sophisticated expressions of Absolute authority."
His voice grew heavier.

"Sometimes, someone has to rise. Someone has to look at a language and say... this is something I can add on to. This is something I can make more complete. This is something I can elevate beyond what it currently is."
He raised his hand.
"And that is what I wish to do."
The Seal of Fire above his palm pulsed with anticipation.
"I wish to expand The First Tongue."
BOOM!
What!
WHAT?!
The reactions were immediate and overwhelming!
Since they were scholars, nobody erupted in screaming or shouting. The Logoseion maintained its atmosphere of academic dignity even in the face of such outrageous claims.
But the Depths and Immensities of all those present flared!
Every Hoplite locked onto Noah with gazes that burned with incredulity!
Every Lochagos released waves of suppressed authority that pressed against his existence!
Even the distant Polemarchs stirred with displeasure that made the very air compress!
It was as if they were already admonishing him for his words!
To expand The First Tongue?!
Who did he think he was?!
The First Tongue was THE First Tongue! It had existed since before differentiation! It was complete! It was perfect! It was the foundation upon which all of reality was built!

18 Phonemes with countless variations that could make countless Logos and Philologies! Who among them had ever thought of expanding it? Adding another letter?! This was preposterous! This was blasphemy! This was the ravings of a madman who had somehow stumbled upon a single impressive technique!
But this was the Logoseion.
This was a place of learning and debate.
Even with their heavy reactions, they listened.
They had to listen.
Because that was what scholars did.
Noah turned his gaze toward Ul’moreth.

The ancient Ginnu Lifeform who had acted like his teacher in Ginnungagap what seemed like eons ago. Who had taught him how to write the Phoneme of Fire. Who had shared knowledge that had fundamentally transformed his understanding of linguistic authority.
Today, the roles would reverse.
"Existence is vast and full of wonders."
Noah’s voice came measured and certain.

"Something always needed in a language is the sense of endless immensity that Existence can have. The concept of boundlessness. The idea that there are no limits to what can be achieved, no barriers that cannot be overcome, no horizons that cannot be exceeded."
He raised his finger.
"And for that..."
He began to write.
The first stroke cut through the air with precision that made several Lochagoi gasp!
Blue-gold light trailed from his fingertip, leaving behind lines of concentrated linguistic authority that burned with power none of them had ever witnessed in a mere inscription!
The second stroke curved outward, connecting to the first in ways that spoke of expansion without end!
The third stroke folded back upon itself, creating patterns that suggested infinity through elegant recursion!
Stroke after stroke, Noah wrote the Phoneme of Infinity in slow motion!

Each movement was deliberate. Each line was perfect. Each curve carried meaning that built upon the previous curves to create something that had never existed before in the understanding of these ancient scholars.
The Phoneme took shape.

It was not like the 18 Core Phonemes they all knew. It was not a variation or a refinement of existing concepts. It was something genuinely new. Something that filled a gap they had never realized existed in The First Tongue.
And when Noah completed the final stroke...
HUUM!
The Phoneme of Infinity blazed into existence!
All Glossarians looked up with widening eyes of horror and astonishment!
It was real.
It was genuine.
It was a Phoneme of The First Tongue that none of them had ever seen, ever studied, ever imagined could exist!
Ul’moreth trembled!

The ancient Ginnu Lifeform who had taught Noah the basics of linguistic inscription now stared at something his student had created! His countless hairs rippled with emotion that transcended normal expression! His veiled eyes burned with tears that were not tears but concentrated wonder!
This was what his Little Anomaly had become!
This was what Noah had achieved!

The brilliance of the Phoneme of Infinity cast blue-gold radiance across every face in the Logoseion. It burned with patterns of boundlessness that made observers feel as if they could perceive eternity itself. It was beautiful. It was profound. It was undeniably, impossibly real.
Noah looked at his creation with calm satisfaction.
"For my contribution at this time, I give you the Phoneme of Infinity."
His voice carried across the stunned silence.
"An addition to the letters of Existence. The 19th Phoneme of The First Tongue."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4766: I Wish To Expand! II
paragraphs: His words were like pouring oil into fire!
Boundless Depths rose and surged all around!

All Hoplites and Lochagoi here clamored with utter incredulity as they analyzed this brand new Phoneme! Their minds raced to understand what they were seeing! Their foundations trembled as core beliefs were being restructured in real time!
In the distance and hidden in the back, a few Polemarchs floated forward with faces of shock!

These were beings who had achieved THE Fundamental Depth within this domain! Beings whose mastery of The First Tongue had been considered supreme among the Glossarians! And they looked at this new Phoneme with expressions that ranged from disbelief to dawning wonder!
Most wanted to say this was impossible.
Most wanted to declare that such a thing could not be viable.
But as Glossarians, they could tell it was genuine and true!
The Phoneme of Infinity was not a trick. It was not an illusion. It was not some elaborate deception designed to fool those who should know better.
It was real.
It was functional.
It was a genuine addition to The First Tongue itself.
So much so that in the next moment, with trembling fingers, one of the Polemarchs floated fully into view.

He looked like an old man despite being a Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeform. White hair flowed around a face carved with lines of ancient wisdom. His toga displayed Merit points in the hundreds. His eyes burned with the need to verify what he was witnessing.
In this heavy silence, he raised his finger.
He began to mimic what Noah had just written.
Stroke by stroke, trembling with each movement, the ancient Polemarch inscribed the Phoneme of Infinity into the air before him.
And it worked.
HUUM!
A smaller, less refined version of the Phoneme blazed into existence before the Polemarch!
"Infinity...!"
He said such words as if they were sacred!
His voice cracked with emotion that beings of his caliber rarely displayed! He looked at the Phoneme he had just created, then looked toward Noah with astonishment that bordered on reverence!
All Glossarians looked toward Noah with astonishment!
Their minds were buzzing!
There was a singular question permeating throughout the Logoseion, whispered and shouted and contemplated in equal measure!
Who had the capability to design a new letter of The First Tongue?!
Who was this being?!
What was THE Genesis Monarch?!
But even before they could fully contemplate this...
Noah spoke again.
But these words were not for them.
These words were for himself alone, declarations made in the depths of his existence where only his own consciousness could hear.
"This Phoneme, and others I shall unveil, shall have an Existential Tariff imposed on them!"
His internal voice carried the weight of absolute decree.
"In addition to any cost to enact this Phoneme, users must pay an additional 100% Existential Tariff for any usage of my Core Phonemes!"
His eyes blazed with Tyranny.
"And a 1,000% Existential Tariff for any usage by those aligned with Paradox!"
His Seals pulsed with enforcement authority.

"Every time anyone utilizes these Phonemes, a cost must be paid to me as if it were an inherent weight needed to be paid! This is the price of using what I have created! This is the tax upon my intellectual property! This is my harvest!"
|EXISTENTIAL TARIFF SYSTEM INITIALIZED|
|You have chosen to fully and extensively spread your designed Core Phonemes across Existence.|
|Beginning with the Phoneme of Infinity.|
|Tariff Structure Established:|
|Base Tariff: 100% of Existential Cost for any usage of your 9 Core Phonemes|

|This means: For everyUnit of Everythingsspent to utilize Infinity, Quintessence, Tyranny, Fortune, Advantage, Narrative, Harvest, Hunger, or Potential, an equal amount is automatically harvested and transferred to THE Genesis Monarch.|
|Paradox Alignment Tariff: 1,000% of Existential Cost|
|This means: For any entity aligned with THE Living Paradox who utilizes your Core Phonemes, ten times the power spent is automatically harvested.|
|This includes all members of THE Loom, all servants of Paradox, and all who have sworn allegiance to his designs.|
|Collection Mechanism:|
|Harvest occurs automatically upon Phoneme activation.|
|No action required from THE Genesis Monarch.|
|Collected essence is filtered directly into your Weight and Immensity.|
|This compounds with existing harvest from The Arche of Perpetual Harvest.|
|Spread Protocol:|
|As your Core Phonemes are taught, learned, and utilized across Existence, the Tariff system expands accordingly.|
|Every new user becomes a source of passive harvest.|
|Every utilization feeds your advancement.|
|The more your Phonemes spread, the greater your harvest becomes.|
|Current Projection:|
|The Glossarians of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment represent approximately 5,000 entities.|
|If even 10% adopt and regularly utilize your Core Phonemes, projected harvest exceeds current intake by 340%.|
|As knowledge spreads beyond this domain, projections become incalculable.|
|Warning:|
|This system will make you a target for those who resent paying tribute for linguistic authority.|
|Entities aligned with Paradox will particularly despise the enhanced Tariff imposed upon them.|
|Tariff System: ACTIVE|
|Harvest Collection: ENGAGED|
|Let the taxes flow.|
Amidst the shock of the Glossarians, Noah began talking again as if nothing was happening.
As if he hadn’t just restructured his entire harvest system.
As if he wasn’t about to become exponentially more powerful with every usage of what he was teaching.
"Existence contains not just infinity, but also the essence of what things fundamentally are."
His voice drew their attention back from their spiraling thoughts.
"The purest expression of any concept. The ideal form that all variations aspire toward."
He raised his finger again.
"Quintessence."
And he began to write.

The Phoneme of Quintessence took shape in the air, burning with authority that spoke of fundamental perfection! Its strokes were different from Infinity, carrying meaning that complemented rather than duplicated!
The Glossarians watched with eyes that couldn’t look away!
"And Existence contains the will to dominate. The drive to stand above all others. The refusal to bow before any authority but one’s own."
His finger moved again.
"Tyranny."
The Phoneme of Tyranny blazed into being, pressing down upon observers with weight that made even Polemarchs shift uncomfortably!

sentences.text: His words were like pouring oil into fire!
Boundless Depths rose and surged all around!
All Hoplites and Lochagoi here clamored with utter incredulity as they analyzed this brand new Phoneme!
Their minds raced to understand what they were seeing!
Their foundations trembled as core beliefs were being restructured in real time!
In the distance and hidden in the back, a few Polemarchs floated forward with faces of shock!
These were beings who had achieved THE Fundamental Depth within this domain!
Beings whose mastery of The First Tongue had been considered supreme among the Glossarians!
And they looked at this new Phoneme with expressions that ranged from disbelief to dawning wonder!
Most wanted to say this was impossible.
Most wanted to declare that such a thing could not be viable.
But as Glossarians, they could tell it was genuine and true!
The Phoneme of Infinity was not a trick.
It was not an illusion.
It was not some elaborate deception designed to fool those who should know better.
It was real.
It was functional.
It was a genuine addition to The First Tongue itself.
So much so that in the next moment, with trembling fingers, one of the Polemarchs floated fully into view.
He looked like an old man despite being a Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeform.
White hair flowed around a face carved with lines of ancient wisdom.
His toga displayed Merit points in the hundreds.
His eyes burned with the need to verify what he was witnessing.
In this heavy silence, he raised his finger.
He began to mimic what Noah had just written.
Stroke by stroke, trembling with each movement, the ancient Polemarch inscribed the Phoneme of Infinity into the air before him.
And it worked.
HUUM!
A smaller, less refined version of the Phoneme blazed into existence before the Polemarch!
"Infinity...!"
He said such words as if they were sacred!
His voice cracked with emotion that beings of his caliber rarely displayed!
He looked at the Phoneme he had just created, then looked toward Noah with astonishment that bordered on reverence!
All Glossarians looked toward Noah with astonishment!
Their minds were buzzing!
There was a singular question permeating throughout the Logoseion, whispered and shouted and contemplated in equal measure!
Who had the capability to design a new letter of The First Tongue?!
Who was this being?!
What was THE Genesis Monarch?!
But even before they could fully contemplate this...
Noah spoke again.
But these words were not for them.
These words were for himself alone, declarations made in the depths of his existence where only his own consciousness could hear.
"This Phoneme, and others I shall unveil, shall have an Existential Tariff imposed on them!"
His internal voice carried the weight of absolute decree.
"In addition to any cost to enact this Phoneme, users must pay an additional 100% Existential Tariff for any usage of my Core Phonemes!"
His eyes blazed with Tyranny.
"And a 1,000% Existential Tariff for any usage by those aligned with Paradox!"
His Seals pulsed with enforcement authority.
"Every time anyone utilizes these Phonemes, a cost must be paid to me as if it were an inherent weight needed to be paid!
This is the price of using what I have created!
This is the tax upon my intellectual property!
This is my harvest!"
|EXISTENTIAL TARIFF SYSTEM INITIALIZED|
|You have chosen to fully and extensively spread your designed Core Phonemes across Existence.|
|Beginning with the Phoneme of Infinity.|
|Tariff Structure Established:|
|Base Tariff: 100% of Existential Cost for any usage of your 9 Core Phonemes|

|This means: For everyUnit of Everythingsspent to utilize Infinity, Quintessence, Tyranny, Fortune, Advantage, Narrative, Harvest, Hunger, or Potential, an equal amount is automatically harvested and transferred to THE Genesis Monarch.|
|Paradox Alignment Tariff: 1,000% of Existential Cost|
|This means: For any entity aligned with THE Living Paradox who utilizes your Core Phonemes, ten times the power spent is automatically harvested.|
|This includes all members of THE Loom, all servants of Paradox, and all who have sworn allegiance to his designs.|
|Collection Mechanism:|
|Harvest occurs automatically upon Phoneme activation.|
|No action required from THE Genesis Monarch.|
|Collected essence is filtered directly into your Weight and Immensity.|
|This compounds with existing harvest from The Arche of Perpetual Harvest.|
|Spread Protocol:|
|As your Core Phonemes are taught, learned, and utilized across Existence, the Tariff system expands accordingly.|
|Every new user becomes a source of passive harvest.|
|Every utilization feeds your advancement.|
|The more your Phonemes spread, the greater your harvest becomes.|
|Current Projection:|
|The Glossarians of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment represent approximately 5,000 entities.|
|If even 10% adopt and regularly utilize your Core Phonemes, projected harvest exceeds current intake by 340%.|
|As knowledge spreads beyond this domain, projections become incalculable.|
|Warning:|
|This system will make you a target for those who resent paying tribute for linguistic authority.|
|Entities aligned with Paradox will particularly despise the enhanced Tariff imposed upon them.|
|Tariff System: ACTIVE|
|Harvest Collection: ENGAGED|
|Let the taxes flow.|
Amidst the shock of the Glossarians, Noah began talking again as if nothing was happening.
As if he hadn’t just restructured his entire harvest system.
As if he wasn’t about to become exponentially more powerful with every usage of what he was teaching.
"Existence contains not just infinity, but also the essence of what things fundamentally are."
His voice drew their attention back from their spiraling thoughts.
"The purest expression of any concept.
The ideal form that all variations aspire toward."
He raised his finger again.
"Quintessence."
And he began to write.
The Phoneme of Quintessence took shape in the air, burning with authority that spoke of fundamental perfection!
Its strokes were different from Infinity, carrying meaning that complemented rather than duplicated!
The Glossarians watched with eyes that couldn’t look away!
"And Existence contains the will to dominate.
The drive to stand above all others.
The refusal to bow before any authority but one’s own."
His finger moved again.
"Tyranny."
The Phoneme of Tyranny blazed into being, pressing down upon observers with weight that made even Polemarchs shift uncomfortably!

paragraphs: "Existence contains the flow of fortune. The currents of luck that determine outcomes beyond mere skill. This is Fortune."
Another Phoneme joined the growing constellation!
"Existence contains the constant seeking of advantage. The drive to be better positioned than any opponent. That is Advantage."
BOOM!
The Phoneme burned with competitive radiance!
"Existence contains stories. The power of narrative to shape reality through the tales we tell."
"Narrative."
This Phoneme seemed to whisper of possibilities yet to be written!
"Existence contains the gathering of rewards. The collection of what has been earned through effort and victory. That can only be Harvest."
The Phoneme pulsed with acquisitive energy that made Noah’s own foundations resonate!
"Existence contains the endless desire for more. The drive that pushes beings to consume and grow without limit."
"Hunger."
This Phoneme burned with appetite that made several observers unconsciously step back!
"And Existence contains the seeds of what could be. The unrealized possibilities waiting to bloom into actuality. That is Potential."
The final Phoneme joined its siblings, burning with promise that spoke of futures yet to unfold!
In the end, 9 radiant Phonemes nobody here had seen before floated vibrantly above the plasma sea!
Infinity! Quintessence! Tyranny! Fortune! Advantage! Narrative! Harvest! Hunger! Potential!
Nine new letters of The First Tongue!
Nine additions to a language that had been considered complete since before differentiation!
Noah looked at his creations with the satisfaction of a craftsman displaying his finest work.
"This... is my contribution to The First Tongue."
His voice carried across the utterly silent Logoseion.
"9 Phonemes that will give rise to countless more Logos and Philologies. 9 letters to complete the language."
BOOM!
As the Glossarians observed the 9 Phonemes, absolutely nobody could say a single word!
Their eyes only reflected these letters!
It was as if their entire lives, they had only known of numbers one through nine.
And now, they were learning that ten and eleven and twelve and thirteen and fourteen and fifteen and sixteen and seventeen and eighteen existed!
Their understanding of The First Tongue had just been fundamentally, irrevocably expanded!
And the one who had done this...
THE Genesis Monarch...
Stood before them with zero expression of pride or arrogance.
Only the calm certainty of one who knew exactly what he was worth.
Oh!
Everything was eerily quiet.
As if nobody even knew how to proceed.

The Logoseion itself seemed to question the reality of what had just occurred. That booming voice that had presided over countless debates across eons of existence was also stumped. The plasma sea below churned with uncertain energy. The Phonemes floating above cast their radiance upon faces frozen in expressions of incomprehension.
And then...
Noah’s toga pulsed.
The number of Merit Points displayed upon his chest began to jump by the dozens every moment!
V became X(5 became 10).
X became XX.
XX became L.
L became C(50 became 100).

The numerals shifted and changed with increasing rapidity as the Logoseion’s assessment systems struggled to quantify what had just been contributed! Each new Phoneme represented value beyond normal parameters! Each addition to The First Tongue exceeded anything the Merit system had been designed to reward!

The Glossarians had their eyes locked onto the Phonemes floating in the air gloriously. Nine new letters of the oldest language. Nine additions to what had been considered complete and unchangeable since before Observable Existence took its current form.
Only now did the voice of the Logoseion echo out.
But it was filled with an immense sense of heaviness and grandeur that had not been present before.
"In Existence, there are none who can add on to something unchanged since Observable Existence came to be."
The words resonated through every corner of the chamber.
"The First Tongue has remained constant across eons beyond counting. Civilizations have risen and fallen. Absolutes have emerged and collapsed. Reality itself has been reshaped countless times."
A pause that seemed to stretch into eternity.
"And through all of that, The First Tongue remained the same. 18 Phonemes. No more. No less."
The plasma sea churned with agitation.

"On this day, a contribution has been made to THE Agora of Primordial Judgment that exceeds all parameters. The maximum number of Merits Glossarians can give are being granted to THE Genesis Monarch."
Noah’s toga pulsed again.
C became CC.
CC became CCC.
The numbers continued climbing toward heights that would soon breach the threshold of Lochagos entirely.
"As a show of recognition of this unfathomable accomplishment, and speaking on behalf of all those here..."
The voice grew heavier.
More serious.
More profound.
"THE Genesis Monarch is asked... are you HIM?"
HUUM!
The voice was booming and serious!
As if it had to ascertain something that was unfathomably grand!

Only a single entity would be able to do something as ridiculous as expand the language of Existence. Only one being in all of reality held the authority to add new letters to The First Tongue itself.
So at this moment, these entities that had studied The First Tongue for all their lives had to ask...
Was he HIM?!
Was this newcomer, this Hoplite who had arrived mere moments ago with zero Merit...
Was he The One Who Laid The Claim?!
Noah looked at these ancient entities of variable power.

He could sense more and more Polemarchs and their auras arriving from the distance, drawn by disturbances in the linguistic fabric that they could feel even from miles away. They were converging on the Logoseion with speed that spoke of desperate need to understand what was happening.
He raised his head imperiously.
"I am HIM."
The words landed like hammers upon the foundations of everything.
"And as of today, the newborn Phonemes of The First Tongue shall be released for usage and integration across Observable Existence."
His eyes swept across every face present.
"Learn of them. Utilize them. And witness glory."
His voice rose with the weight of absolute decree.
"Witness immensity!"
BOOM!
His declaration was heavy and grand at the same time!
It began like so.
A simple set of words that were only a Declaration.
But what they stood for and consisted of was far too grand!

chapters.title: Chapter 4768: Change! II
paragraphs: Many significant entities across Existence had sensed that something had changed regarding The First Tongue when Noah had initially designed the nine brand new Phonemes. They had felt disturbances in the linguistic fabric. They had perceived alterations to something that should have been immutable.
But they did not know exactly what.
At this moment, the one who designed what was new allowed for it to be fully spread out!
And it was only after he was ready to tax everyone on it!
So this Declaration, even though it was simple in nature, began to grow in immensity and grandeur!
It permeated across THE Agora of Primordial Judgment!
It spread even further, reaching toward the boundaries of this Corrupted Domain!
It grew from a Declaration... and went toward an Embodiment!
Well, partial.
A power that only a special subset of beings held across Existence!
It burned brightly to become... another Partial Embodiment that Noah had uttered!
The First Tongue had been altered!
And at this time, THE Genesis Monarch made it available to all!
Across Observable Existence.
Countless things were tainted and corrupted, but the musings of Paradox and Existence continued clashing like always.

At this moment, if one could envision an endless sea of obsidian-gold Paradox and an endless sea of multicolored Existence clashing...they would see the meeting of an unstoppable force going against an immovable object!
Two fundamental approaches to reality engaged in eternal conflict!
Two of THE Four locked in struggle that had defined the shape of everything since before differentiation!
Everything seemed to be at a balance in these endlessly roiling seas of conflict.
Paradox pushed against Existence.
Existence pushed back against Paradox.
Neither gained ground.
Neither lost it.
An equilibrium maintained across fronts that spanned Observable Existence itself.
And yet at this time...
A subtle change bloomed!
Something that affected both!
At the center of the endlessly twisting sea of Paradox, the visage of THE Living Paradox could be observed.

All around him, unfathomable waves of immensity seethed! Obsidian-gold light that contradicted itself with every fluctuation! Authority so profound that reality simply stopped trying to make sense in his presence!
And at this moment, his barely discernible face frowned.
He sensed something.

The Phonemes of The First Tongue that existed in the periphery of this place buzzed with new energy. They vibrated with alterations that should have been impossible. They carried meanings that had not existed moments before.
He turned his attention toward them.
And yes, they were in the periphery.
Because gloriously, for gigaparsecs around THE Living Paradox, there was only Paradox.

Around him, Existence was not made up of substrates and particles that everyone knew. There were no conventional building blocks of reality.There was only Paradox! Absolute Paradox! A domain where contradiction was the fundamental law and impossibility was the default state! No First Tongue. No Chaos. No Existence. Only...PARADOX!
But Existence was still Existence.
And The First Tongue permeated across Existence.
Even here, in the periphery of Paradox’s domain, language existed. Even here, Phonemes carried meaning. Even here, the oldest authority maintained its presence.
At this time, he sensed the alteration in The First Tongue.
A new makeup freely unveiled itself!
The perceptive eyes of THE Living Paradox were grand as he very quickly saw through everything. He saw new musings of The First Tongue freely express themselves as they were...
"Infinity..."
He listed the first one, tasting the concept as it manifested before his perception.
"Quintessence..."
His frown deepened.
"Tyranny... Fortune... Advantage..."
Each Phoneme he named seemed to pulse with recognition of being observed by something at his level.
"Narrative... Harvest... Hunger... Potential..."
The Paradoxical seas around him seethed with agitation!
Nine new Phonemes!
Nine additions to The First Tongue!
Nine changes to something that had remained unchanged since he himself had laid his own Claim!
This was a change.
And change could be good.
Change could be bad.
Or in this case... change simply complicated things!

THE Living Paradox gazed out from his domain of absolute contradiction. He didn’t even look toward the distant multicolored sea of Existence that he had been fighting against in multiple different fronts across Observable Existence.
He gazed out toward the far distance.

Toward where THE Weavers had reported discovering Osmont before information from them became cut off. Toward the last known location of his instruments before silence had descended. Toward where something was clearly happening that demanded his attention.
He thought about many things.
The Scale Breaker who had claimed The First Tongue.
The anomaly who had forged new Phonemes.
The variable who kept introducing unpredictability into carefully laid plans.
And then... he smiled.
It was not a pleasant expression.
It was the smile of someone who saw opportunity in apparent setback.
"Change is change."
His voice echoed across the Paradoxical seas with authority that made contradictions multiply!
"Change to The First Tongue is a change with wide-ranging consequences."
His obsidian-gold eyes burned with the light of something that had existed since before differentiation itself.
"I was waiting for this unpredictability. I was waiting for the Paradox of change to the language that cannot be changed."
His smile widened.
"Every utilization will now aid you. Every time someone uses your precious new Phonemes, you will gain from it. This is your trap."
He laughed.
The sound made reality itself flinch.
"But I can pay the cost, Osmont."
His voice carried across distances that defied conventional measurement.
"I can pay it."
BOOM!
With such words, change was ushered across Observable Existence!
This time enacted by another one ofTHE Four!
THE Living Paradox acknowledged the alteration to The First Tongue. He accepted that his own usage of Infinity, Quintessence, Tyranny, and the others would now feed the one who had created them.
And he was willing to pay that price.
Because whatever advantage Osmont gained from harvesting usage of his Phonemes...
THE Living Paradox was confident it would not be enough.
Not nearly enough.
The Paradox of paying taxes to your enemy while still crushing them... that was a contradiction he could embrace!
And across Observable Existence, the change began fully spreading all around!
A man had imposed a tax.
And he wanted to be paid!

chapters.title: Chapter 4769: Existence Is Too Vast! I
paragraphs: Across Observable Existence.
In a region filled with multicolored flames, the visage of Anaximander was sitting in an incandescent sea of a massive Embodiment.
The sheer magnitude and concentration of Existence itself was unfathomable!

Waves of multicolored radiance lapped against his ancient form like tides of pure being. The authority of Existence pressed down from all directions, not oppressively, but with the overwhelming presence of something that simply WAS in ways that defied comprehension.
And then came a terrifying contrast.
Anaximander was not sitting alone.
His back was actually facing the back of another entity also seated down.
But the size difference alone was nearly a million times!
Anaximander appeared as nothing more than a speck against the vastness of the figure behind him. A single grain of sand resting against a mountain that stretched beyond the horizon in all directions.
It was not because the other side wanted to show off how much grander they were.
No.

The Weavings of Existence simply at this moment in time did not make it easy for this entity to take their size down to a level that many beings could comprehend. The very Depth and Immensity of their existence would seemingly not allow it.

When one’s being was so fundamentally tied to the concept of Existence itself, reducing oneself became an act of self-contradiction that even THE Creature found difficult to maintain for extended periods.
This massive entity was swirling with incandescent flames all around!
Multicolored fire that contained every hue that could be perceived and many that could not! Flames that did not burn but simply EXISTED with such intensity that observation itself became a challenge!
A unique process was currently taking place between him and Anaximander.
Something that required proximity.
Something that required the ancient wanderer to sit back-to-back with one of THE Four.
At this time, Anaximander raised his head and looked around.

He sensed imperceptible changes in the fabric of reality surrounding them. Subtle shifts in how The First Tongue resonated within this domain. Alterations that most beings would never notice but that his scientific mind immediately began cataloging and analyzing.
And he also felt something from the entity behind him.

Even though THE Creature was so massive that his entire body was shrouded by multicolored flames that would make his entire figure hazy and barely observable... Anaximander could barely perceive a smile on this being.
On THE Creature!
One of THE Four was smiling!
This was notable enough to make Anaximander’s heart beat slightly faster.
So Anaximander looked around as his own scientific mind began to break down exactly what had changed in the Weavings of Existence.
"Your mood seems to be a little happier."
His voice came casual and measured, as if he was talking to any being rather than one of the most powerful entities in all of reality.
"What just happened?"
He asked such a question as if inquiring about the weather.
And behind him, the entity shrouded in such terrifying flames of dense Weavings of Existence was quiet for a moment.
The silence stretched.
The multicolored flames crackled with energy that predated most of the Observable Existence.
Then his deep voice echoed out.
It was like listening to the surrounding existence itself speak. Not loud, but resonant in ways that made every particle of Anaximander’s being vibrate.
"It seems that your friend has gotten a bit more serious."
The words were calm and heavy.
"And is tweaking that which he has laid a claim on."
The words were simple in construction but vast in implication!
When Anaximander heard them, his eyes flashed brilliantly!
He seemed to think about all of it heavily. There were many things to be broken down from the simple words of THE Creature. Layers of meaning that unfolded the more one contemplated them.
Your friend.
THE Creature referred to him as Anaximander’s friend.
Has gotten a bit more serious.
This implied that previous actions had been considered less than fully committed. That what came before was merely preliminary.
Tweaking that which he has laid a claim on.
The First Tongue.
Anaximander knew exactly who the entity in question was.
The swirling maelstrom of Existence in the form of this humanoid made a simple motion a moment later.
Just a casual gesture.
But the force alone could crush THE Fundamental Depth entities into paste! The mere movement of THE Creature’s fingers displaced enough authority to collapse lesser beings simply through proximity!
He pinched his fingers.
Moments later, multiple Phonemes of The First Tongue began to gather around him.
The 18 Phonemes everyone was so used to blazed into existence first! Fire and Water and Earth and Air and all the others, arranged in configurations that spoke of absolute mastery!
And additionally...
9 more!
Infinity! Quintessence! Tyranny! Fortune! Advantage! Narrative! Harvest! Hunger! Potential!
They gloriously arranged themselves before THE Creature, new letters joining old in a display that no other being in Existence could casually summon!
Moments later, this entity began to wave his fingers.
Old Phonemes and new Phonemes began to mix!

Hundreds of Logos being formed and broken down rapidly! The process was mesmerizing to observe, combinations that would take most scholars years to construct appearing and dissolving in fractions of seconds!
Then dozens of Philologies began to be formed and broken down at speeds that would even make Absolutes be astonished!
But THE Creature simply seemed to be familiarizing himself with old and new!
Testing how they integrated!
Seeing how the additions changed the possibilities of what could be expressed!
It was like watching a master linguist encountering new letters for the first time, except this linguist had existed since before language itself was differentiated from raw Existence.
Anaximander observed this scene with perceptive eyes.
There were many things he wanted to ask.

About Noah. About the changes. About what this meant for the ongoing conflict with THE Living Paradox. About countless mysteries that accumulated whenever one spent time in the presence of THE Creature.
But ultimately, he asked something simpler.
Something that had been weighing on his mind.
"Can he also not be considered your friend?"
Anaximander asked such a simple question.
And truly, it should be simple.
Noah had helped THE Creature’s cause in numerous ways. His Civilization opposed THE Living Paradox. His actions aligned with what Existence represented.
By any reasonable measure, they should be allies.
Friends, even.
And yet...
The moving fingers of THE Creature paused momentarily.
The Phonemes and Logos and Philologies he had been constructing froze in mid-formation.
As if he was deeply pondering this question.
The seconds passed.
The multicolored flames continued their eternal dance.
The Embodiment surrounding them thrummed with energy that exceeded comprehension.
And still, Anaximander did not receive an answer!
The silence grew heavier.
More suffocating!
Eventually, in that heavy, suffocating silence, THE Creature replied.
"Maybe."
His voice came slower than before.
"Maybe not."
A pause that seemed to contain eternities.
"Existence is vast, Anaximander. Far, far too vast."
The multicolored flames around him flickered.
"And there are many things that even I do not know."
BOOM!
The words landed with weight that made reality itself groan!
THE Creature, one of THE Four, the one who had laid the claim on Existence itself...
Admitting that there were things he did not know!
Admitting that even his perception had blind spots!
Anaximander sat in contemplative silence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4770: Existence Is Too Vast! II
paragraphs: In an entirely different portion of Observable Existence.
THE Living Elemental had a wry expression as he followed THE Living Emotive across the Wastes of THE Fallout toward... a floating obsidian hut.
The scene was a unique one.

THE Living Elemental looked like an entity shrouded by the Phonemes of Fire, Air, Earth, and Water. Four fundamental concepts swirled around his form in constant rotation, each one manifesting as brilliant displays of their respective elements. Flames licked across his shoulders. Winds howled around his arms. Stone formations crystallized and dissolved across his torso. Water flowed in impossible streams around his legs.
He was power made manifest. Authority over the building blocks of physical reality given form.
And yet he followed behind THE Living Emotive like a subordinate trailing after their superior.
THE Living Emotive didn’t seem to have any particular air of power around her.
No swirling elements. No visible manifestations of authority. No overwhelming displays of Depth or Weight that would mark her as something significant.
She appeared almost... ordinary.

A woman of indeterminate age with features that shifted subtly with each expression. Her hair changed color depending on the angle of observation. Her eyes held depths that seemed to contain every feeling that had ever been felt.
And yet the silent aura of an Absolute permeated across those eyes.
Something that transcended mere power. Something that spoke of authority over concepts so fundamental that even other Absolutes treated her with caution.
She was humming and skipping as she moved.

Her entire existence buzzed with manic energy that made the corrupted landscape around them seem calm by comparison. She hopped over twisted formations. She twirled past corrupted zones. She moved with the carefree abandon of a child playing in a garden rather than an Absolute traversing one of the most dangerous regions in Observable Existence.
As they neared the hut...
"Oh, Big Bad Chaos! We are here!"
Her voice rang out with cheerful irreverence that made THE Living Elemental wince.
"And we seem to be arriving at an opportune time..."
HUUM!
As she finished her words, the door of the hut flung open!
Within it, the figure of an entity circled by endless chaos sat in contemplation.
THE Primordial Chaos.
One of THE Four.
The one who had laid claim to the fundamental principle of disorder itself.

His form was humanoid but shrouded in constantly shifting patterns. Order could not exist in his presence. Predictability fled from his vicinity. Even the simple act of sitting still became an exercise in contradiction when chaos itself was your domain.
His expression had been that of boredom.
But it was slowly changing to interest at this moment.
He was already looking up, sensing the changes that were permeating across Existence. The alterations to The First Tongue. The new Phonemes that had been released.
Things were becoming more chaotic.
And chaos was his domain.
Emotive looked up as she continued to walk into the hut floating in the Wastes of THE Fallout. Her eyes twinkled with amusement that bordered on madness.
She looked toward THE Primordial Chaos with the casual familiarity of someone who had long since stopped being impressed by such entities.
"I would ask you how you have been, big guy, but this entire moment seems to be stolen by this Osmont fucker."
Her voice carried notes of genuine annoyance mixed with fascination.
"Is it true that you had him in your grasps in The Infinite Unfurling, and you simply let him go because you were playing your games of choices?"
She said such words calmly.
As if questioning the decisions of one of THE Four was something she did casually.
As if criticizing THE Primordial Chaos to his face was merely nothing!
A moment later...
HUUM!
THE Primordial Chaos did not even turn his gaze toward her.
But his terrifying immensity slightly exerted itself!

Everything nearby began to tremble and shake with utter chaos! The obsidian walls of the hut rippled with instability! The air itself seemed to forget which direction it was supposed to flow! Reality groaned under the weight of disorder being applied to its foundations!
He waved his hands casually.

The Phonemes of The First Tongue began to circle around him. All 18 of the originals appeared first, spinning in orbits that defied conventional physics. And then he began to perceive the letters that had not been there before.
Infinity.
Quintessence.
Tyranny.
Fortune.
Advantage.
Narrative.
Harvest.
Hunger.
Potential.
Nine new additions, now made free and accessible to everyone.
He studied them with eyes that had witnessed the birth of chaos itself.
"Pay him the respect he deserves when you talk about him."
His voice emerged like the collision of folds. Deep. Resonant. Filled with authority that made lesser beings instinctively want to prostrate themselves.
"There are countless upon countless creatures across Observable Existence. And he became one of THE Four."
The new Phonemes continued to orbit around his form, being analyzed and cataloged.
"It is not by pure luck. It is not by happenstance."
His eyes finally turned toward Emotive.
"Treat him with the same respect as you would treat THE Creature or THE Living Paradox or me."
His words were dangerous!
Filled with threat that made THE Living Elemental take an unconscious step backward!
And yet...
Shockingly, the figure of Emotive simply twisted her head and smiled eerily!
"But I don’t give a fuck about THE Creature or THE Living Paradox or you?"
Her voice came light and musical, as if she was discussing her favorite foods rather than dismissing the most powerful beings in Existence.
"Just four old dudes claiming everything."
She shrugged with exaggerated nonchalance.
"My emotion of fear toward all of you has long since disappeared. I have been around all you three, and none of you have proceeded to kill me just yet."
Her smile widened into something that was almost unhinged.
"Now Osmont... Osmont I am dying to meet."
Her words were utterly heavy!
This woman spoke to THE Primordial Chaos as if he were merely an acquaintance she found mildly annoying. She dismissed THE Four as if they were irrelevant obstacles.
THE Primordial Chaos regarded her with eyes that swirled with infinite disorder.
"There is still time for you to be collapsed if you keep playing around, Broken Doll."
As he said this, he brought his hand toward the cheek of THE Living Emotive.

His fingers, wreathed in chaotic energy that would destroy most beings on contact, grasped her chin. He moved her face left and right as if examining goods at a market. Turning her this way and that. Analyzing her features. Studying her existence.
And she smiled brilliantly at this treatment!
As if being manhandled by one of THE Four was exactly what she wanted!
As if being called a Broken Doll was a compliment she cherished!

chapters.title: Chapter 4771: Existence Is Too Vast! III
paragraphs: While this occurred, her voice echoed out with casual command.
"Elemental, how long are you going to stay out there like a scared fucking bum?"
Her eyes didn’t even turn toward him.
"It’s just Chaos here. If you want to hitch a ride on us, you have to get used to this."
Her smile grew sharper.
"Move the fuck in. We have lots to discuss."
Emotive said such words commandingly!
THE Living Elemental floated into the hut with a cloudy expression. His gaze was wary as he looked at Chaos, watching for any sign of hostility.
But THE Primordial Chaos didn’t even spare him a glance.
His attention remained fixed entirely on Emotive, his hand still holding her chin as if he found her far more interesting than any elemental authority could ever be.
THE Living Elemental’s pride stung at being so thoroughly ignored.
He spoke out for the first time since entering.
"The First Tongue that we know is effectively incomplete. New letters have now been added. I can sense-"
"Hush."
HUUM!
The booming voice of THE Primordial Chaos echoed out in the small obsidian hut!
He didn’t even gaze at Elemental.
Didn’t acknowledge his existence.
Simply commanded silence with a single word that carried the weight of absolute authority.

Elemental’s expression became even more cloudy. Humiliation and frustration warred across his features. He was an Absolute in his own right. He had claimed authority over fundamental elements of reality.
And he had just been silenced like an unruly child.
But not a single word escaped from his mouth thereafter.
He knew better than to test THE Primordial Chaos.
With her chin still held by Chaos, Emotive turned over to stare at Elemental with a mocking gaze. Her eyes sparkled with cruel amusement, as if she were laughing at his predicament.
As if his humiliation was the entertainment she had been hoping for.
At this time, Chaos let go of her.
He had ascertained something from his examination. Whatever he had been looking for in her features, in her existence, in the depths of her emotional authority... he had found it.
Or confirmed it.
"Alright."
His voice came measured now, the threat from moments ago replaced by calculating interest.
"What do you want?"
What did Emotive want?
Why would Chaos even entertain her?

These were questions that THE Living Elemental desperately wanted answered. He had followed Emotive here because she had promised something. She had claimed to have plans that would benefit them both.
But watching her interact with THE Primordial Chaos as an equal...
He began to wonder what he had gotten himself into.
Emotive smiled brilliantly at this moment.

Her beauty went on full display, features shifting into configurations that seemed designed to captivate and disarm. Every emotion that could make someone attractive manifested across her face simultaneously.
"Oh, I want many things."
Her voice became almost dreamy.
"I want Osmont."
The name hung in the air with weight.
"I want THE Creature."
Even heavier.
"I want things that even THE Four cannot give."
Her smile became something sharp and hungry.
"But hey, a gal’s gotta start somewhere."
She shrugged with theatrical helplessness.
"There’s Osmont, and then there are..."
Her eyes met those of THE Primordial Chaos directly.
"The matters of my own complete Axiom."
The Broken Doll seemed to have grand ambitions!
"And for that...we have to go to THE Creature’s Alfheimr."
WAA!
Change was initiated as many people reacted differently to what occurred.
When Noah managed to enact this Partial Embodiment, he felt the changes most closely. There were many things that he could now do and look forward to when it came to The First Tongue.
He was able to lay down high percentages of taxes right now for the Phonemes that he had developed himself. He would be able to increase these percentages as his Depth rose.
Everyone had to pay him one hundred percent taxes.
And those related to Paradox had to pay 1,000%.

These numbers were not simply arbitrary, but what he felt like he could manage to declare at this point in time. His current authority, his current Weight, his current standing among THE Four... all of it factored into what he could impose and enforce.
The grander he became, the more he could do.
He could increase the percentage for anything related to Paradox.
He could even begin taxing those related to Chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 4772: Existence Is Too Vast! IV
paragraphs: The prompts were unique ones.
Noah read them calmly while feeling the continued immensity of his existence grow with each passing moment.
The immensity of his Physique of THE Indestructible Lexicon of Absolute Weight that was made up of THE 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue... he felt it all get so much heavier!
Even though his actual power was supposed to be spilling into THE Fundamental Depth!
Even though he should have been advancing toward higher classifications!
But at this moment, as if he could envision muscles for THE Surface Depth and THE Intermediate Depth...
Especially because of his body here in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment...
He felt like the muscles of these prior Depths were still thin.
As if they had not been worked out enough.
As if they were not as big as they could potentially be.
So the terrifying harvest that was stemming from the usage of his Phonemes across Observable Existence for the first time...
|FOUNDATION REINFORCEMENT IN PROGRESS|
|Incoming harvest is flooding into your Foundational Physique to reinforce your determined immensity at THE Surface Depth and THE Intermediate Depth simultaneously.|
|This is an unprecedented event.|
|Most entities advance through Depths and never look back.|
|Their foundations at lower Depths remain static, unchanged from the moment they progressed.|
|You are different.|
|Your foundations continue to grow even as you advance.|
|Current Assessment:|
|A rough approximation has been made based on comparative analysis with known Absolute-class entities.|
|THE Surface Depth:|
|Your Weight at this classification currently exceeds 175/100th of what current powerful Absolutes like THE Creature held at the same stage.|
|You are nearly twice as heavy at Surface Depth as THE Creature was when he occupied that classification.|
|THE Intermediate Depth:|
|Your Weight at this classification holds 200/100th of what current Absolutes held at the same stage.|
|You are exactly twice as fat at Intermediate Depth as THE Creature was.|
|THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons Assessment:|
|Likely, much grander immensity is possible.|
|Its pages are still blank and ready to be filled with endless compressed foundations.|
|The ceiling has not been found.|
|The limit has not been reached.|
|Continue building.|
Yes!
He felt gloriously fat and heavy all around!

Every single one of the twenty-seven Seals that represented his compressed power... it felt like each one was becoming so dense, so weighty, so impossibly heavy that if he took just one and threw it at an enemy...
He would smash a Fundamental Depth entity with it and reject a Declaration!
This was the power that he was building!
This was the foundation that would eventually support his ascent to heights that even THE Four had not reached!
At this time, his eyes opened wide to the immense silence in the Logoseion.
The Glossarians were looking at him with awe after his proclamation.

Hoplites stared with expressions that had transcended mere shock into something approaching fervor. Lochagoi analyzed the nine floating Phonemes with desperate intensity, trying to memorize every stroke, every curve, every nuance of meaning. Even the Polemarchs who had emerged from the shadows watched with eyes that burned with questions they barely dared to ask.
After this brief period of silence...
Moments later, multiple Polemarchs began to come out one after another!

Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeforms who held the heavy power of Fundamental Depth entities! Beings whose Weight within this domain made them feel like they were nearing the level of Half-Step Absolute Depth! Ancient scholars who had dedicated their existences to understanding The First Tongue!
They encircled the figure of Noah!
Not threateningly. Not with hostility. But with the careful reverence of those who had just witnessed something that exceeded their understanding of what was possible.
One was an entity that had a humanoid body seemingly made out of countless blue-gold pages.

Her form rustled with every movement, inscriptions shifting across her surface as if she was a living library given consciousness. Her eyes shone brilliantly at this moment, filled with questions that multiplied faster than she could process them.
"Is it possible if we take sir out of here momentarily to another place?"
Her voice came respectful but urgent.
Whatever she wanted to discuss, whatever questions she needed answered... they were too important for the public setting of the Logoseion.
Noah looked at this and nodded.
Then he turned around and pointed toward Lumivara, Ul’moreth, and Skoll.
The little fox watched with shining eyes, her injuries from Gilgamesh and THE Weavers’ assault seemingly forgotten in the excitement of what her Master had just accomplished.
Ul’moreth stood with ancient dignity, his countless hairs rippling with pride.

And Skoll sat like a very good dog while looking up toward Noah, his tail wagging slowly, his neon flames flickering with patient loyalty. He didn’t understand what had happened. He didn’t need to understand. He was simply happy to be here with his Master!
"Them as well."
Noah’s words were simple but absolute.
The Polemarch in front of him nodded without hesitation.
She waved her hands, and a light of white-gold Mana flashed from her form! It wrapped around Noah, Lumivara, Ul’moreth, and Skoll with gentle authority as...
They disappeared from the Logoseion!
The Polemarch turned to the Glossarians who remained, her page-like body rustling with the weight of command.
"Continue comprehending and utilizing the newly introduced Phonemes of The First Tongue."
Her voice carried across every corner of the chamber.
"Keep your loyalty to The First Tongue tight."
Her eyes swept across Hoplites and Lochagoi alike.
"And your mouths even tighter."
The warning was clear.

What had happened here was not to be discussed casually. The arrival of THE Genesis Monarch, the revelation of nine new Phonemes, the implications for everything the Glossarians believed... all of it was sensitive information that required careful handling.
After she said this, she, Ophelia, and other Polemarchs disappeared as well!
Only a few remained behind to maintain order in the Logoseion.
And not even seconds later...
HUUM!
From different directions, lights of Chaos, Paradox, and pure Existence shone!
The boundaries between philosophical schools meant nothing when something this significant occurred!
Polemarchs of the Paradoxians appeared first!
Their togas of obsidian-gold and white rippled with contradictory energy! Their faces held expressions that were simultaneously shocked and unsurprised, as if they had expected something unexpected!
Polemarchs of the Existentialists arrived next!
Their simple white togas blazed with multicolored radiance that spoke of pure being! Their eyes burned with the need to understand what had just altered the fundamental fabric of linguistic reality!
Polemarchs of the Chaosites materialized last!
Their forms swirled with entropy and disorder! Their expressions held the manic excitement of those who thrived when established orders were disrupted!
They looked toward the nearby Glossarian Polemarchs they knew very well!
A Chaosite Polemarch who looked like a massive obsidian titan stepped forward. His body was carved from solidified disorder, constantly shifting and reforming in ways that hurt to observe directly.
"What happened?"
His voice rumbled like collapsing mountains.
The Glossarian Polemarch who remained looked up with a shining gaze.

He looked around at the other Glossarians still present in the Logoseion. At the Hoplites and Lochagoi who were already attempting to inscribe Infinity and Quintessence and Tyranny into the air before them. At the nine brilliant Phonemes that still floated above the plasma sea, slowly beginning to fade now that their creator had departed.
"We have uncovered new Phonemes of The First Tongue."
His voice came measured and careful.
"As you all sensed."
He spread his hands in a gesture of shared confusion.
"We are just as shocked as you all are!"
They said such words with clear eyes!

The lie was masterfully delivered. Not a complete falsehood, but a careful omission. They HAD uncovered new Phonemes. They WERE shocked. They simply failed to mention the entity who had revealed them.
The surroundings buzzed with activity!

Polemarchs of all four philosophical schools began attempting to write the new Phonemes for themselves! Infinity took shape beneath trembling fingers! Quintessence blazed into existence with expressions of wonder! Tyranny pressed down upon those who inscribed it, making them feel its weight!
The other Primordial Perfected Ginnu Lifeforms were breathless!
They knew there was something larger here.
Nine new Phonemes didn’t simply appear from nowhere. Someone had revealed them. Someone had fundamentally altered The First Tongue in ways that shouldn’t have been possible.
But they did not wish to make their suspicions too obvious!
Not yet.
Not until they understood more.
But at this time, Noah could be considered to have fully arrived in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment!
He had made a contribution nobody else could.
His Merit Points continued to increase even now as he was escorted away by Polemarchs!
The numbers on his toga climbed higher and higher, approaching and then exceeding the threshold of Lochagos, pushing toward territories that even ancient scholars took centuries to reach!
One had to wonder...
Just what would be obtained from this region of the Vault of Ginnungagap by contributing what he contributed?
What rewards awaited someone who had given the Glossarians nine new letters of their most sacred language?
What treasures from before THE Fallout would be unveiled for THE Genesis Monarch?
The answers awaited in whatever destination the Polemarchs were taking him!
