chapters.title: Chapter 4773: THE Villa Dei Boscoreale I
paragraphs: Existence moved in cycles.
Birth and death. Rise and fall. Beginning and ending, only to begin again.

Noah had come to understand this truth deeply across his journey. Every event led to another. Every action created reactions that rippled outward to touch things that seemed entirely unrelated. Every choice opened doors while closing others, and those closed doors would eventually open again in different forms.
One had to be an active participant in Existence in order to enjoy the boons of Existence.

Those who sat idle, waiting for opportunities to come to them, would wait forever. Existence rewarded movement. It rewarded engagement. It rewarded those who stepped forward and seized what they wanted rather than hoping it would be given.
Before THE Fallout and even now, Noah continued to actively move with Existence as events unfolded.
And those events had now brought him to THE Vault of Ginnungagap, albeit in a different form than he had originally expected.
He had expected to see THE Vaults of Ginnungagap in The Infinite Unfurling. That had been the plan. Before THE Primordial Chaos offered him a choice.
His traversal was ended short before he could go.
And now, eons later, here he was!
Not through Temporal Traversal. Not through the methods he had originally intended.
The cycles of Existence were strange like that!
When he thought about Temporal Traversal and its possibility right now...
|The capability of Temporal Traversal still persists within your arsenal.|
|It carries heavy influence in THE Existential Paradox Loop.|
|Current Status:|
|Utilizing Temporal Traversal for movement to the Earliest Folds or Infinite Unfurling before the emergence of THE Fallout is nearly impossible.|
|THE Fallout has created temporal barriers that resist penetration.|
|The corruption extends across time as well as space.|
|Attempting traversal to pre-Fallout eras risks catastrophic paradox formation.|
|Analysis:|
|Feasibility studies are still being conducted.|
|Potential methods of circumvention are being explored.|
|Current recommendation: Focus on present opportunities rather than past destinations.|
|What you sought in the past has manifested in the present.|
|Perhaps...this was always the intended path.|
Noah regarded the prompts calmly.
Then he looked out at the surroundings the Polemarch had brought them to.
They seemed to have arrived inside a bronze hall stretching out into the distance.
The architecture was ancient beyond measure. Inscriptions covered every surface, Phonemes of The First Tongue arranged in patterns that spoke of knowledge accumulated across eternities of study.
The hall led to a massive villa visible in the distance.

Grand columns supported a structure that seemed to have been designed for beings far larger than those currently walking these corridors. Terraces and balconies extended outward at various levels. Windows of crystallized language filtered light that came from no discernible source.
Around the hall, seas of blue-gold Phonemes flowed all around!

Rivers of authority that carried meanings Noah could read if he focused. They swirled past in endless streams, each one representing concepts and ideas that had been refined across eons of Glossarian scholarship.
Noah could already feel his Seal of Harvest buzzing.
There was so much to collect here. So much knowledge. So much authority. So much potential harvest waiting to be gathered by one who knew how to take it.
Skoll rubbed against his leg with enthusiasm.

The transformed Duke’s neon flames flickered happily as he pressed his massive form against Noah’s side. He didn’t understand where they were or why they had been brought here. He simply wanted to be close to his Master.
Before them, the Polemarchs turned to face the group.

The Polemarch whose entire body was made up of countless blue-gold pages stepped forward. Her form rustled with every movement, inscriptions shifting across her surface. She gave a slight bow that spoke of respect rather than subservience.
"Polemarch Lunaris greets The One Who Laid The Claim."
Her voice emerged like pages turning in an ancient library.
"I brought you here first because out of THE Four, you are the last one to have crossed this Nexus of the Primordial Realms."
Her page-like eyes met his directly.

"THE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, and THE Living Paradox have all crossed here various times in the Infinite Unfurling. They walked these halls when the Vaults were not yet corrupted. They contributed to what we have built. They took what they needed and left marks upon our society that persist to this day."
She paused.

"And while THE Agora of Primordial Judgment has set rules to be followed, THE Change corrupted many things. There could be a great deal of differences between what they experienced and what you will experience. Much has altered since those ancient times."
Her form straightened.
"So until everything is ascertained, it is the job of any Glossarian to ensure the safety of THE Glossarian."
BOOM!
THE Glossarian!
Noah gained another distinction so easily!
The words of Lunaris were heavy ones! She was not merely calling him a member of their philosophical school. She was designating him as THE Glossarian. The supreme representative of their Way.
All of THE Four had passed here before him.
Was this the place where they also forged their foundations? Was this ancient Nexus Point one of the crucibles that had shaped the most powerful beings in Observable Existence?
As he thought of this, he nodded.
Then he turned his gaze toward the distant villa.
"I have a few things that I wish to accomplish here."
His voice came measured and direct.
"I have an Absolute that came in with me. One Absolute with three separate bodies who has gone ahead to the Paradoxians."
His eyes blazed with calculation.

"What do I need to watch out for if I wish to speedily collapse them before they earn enough Merit to reclaim all their power? I should have enough Merit to exceed the distinction of a Lochagos, but there seems to be certain conditions I have yet to meet."
He asked an equally heavy question!

Ophelia, Lunaris, and the other Polemarchs in this region frowned with concern at his words. Collapsing an Absolute, even one suppressed, was no simple task. The implications of such an endeavor were vast.
At this time, Ul’moreth spoke up with his deep and heavy voice.
Vibrant obsidian-gold light flowed around the ancient Ginnu Lifeform as he stepped forward. His countless hairs rippled with the weight of what he was about to share.
"My senses are unique ones, Scale Breaker."
His veiled eyes turned toward the distant reaches of the domain.
"I cannot say definitely, but apart from THE Weavers... there should be 4 other Absolutes here."
His voice grew heavier.
"I can feel their heat as if they were blinding suns. It was how I was able to locate Little Lumivara who was being stalked by Gilgamesh and THE Weavers."

sentences.text: Existence moved in cycles.
Birth and death.
Rise and fall.
Beginning and ending, only to begin again.
Noah had come to understand this truth deeply across his journey.
Every event led to another.
Every action created reactions that rippled outward to touch things that seemed entirely unrelated.
Every choice opened doors while closing others, and those closed doors would eventually open again in different forms.
One had to be an active participant in Existence in order to enjoy the boons of Existence.
Those who sat idle, waiting for opportunities to come to them, would wait forever.
Existence rewarded movement.
It rewarded engagement.
It rewarded those who stepped forward and seized what they wanted rather than hoping it would be given.
Before THE Fallout and even now, Noah continued to actively move with Existence as events unfolded.
And those events had now brought him to THE Vault of Ginnungagap, albeit in a different form than he had originally expected.
He had expected to see THE Vaults of Ginnungagap in The Infinite Unfurling.
That had been the plan.
Before THE Primordial Chaos offered him a choice.
His traversal was ended short before he could go.
And now, eons later, here he was!
Not through Temporal Traversal.
Not through the methods he had originally intended.
The cycles of Existence were strange like that!
When he thought about Temporal Traversal and its possibility right now...
|The capability of Temporal Traversal still persists within your arsenal.|
|It carries heavy influence in THE Existential Paradox Loop.|
|Current Status:|
|Utilizing Temporal Traversal for movement to the Earliest Folds or Infinite Unfurling before the emergence of THE Fallout is nearly impossible.|
|THE Fallout has created temporal barriers that resist penetration.|
|The corruption extends across time as well as space.|
|Attempting traversal to pre-Fallout eras risks catastrophic paradox formation.|
|Analysis:|
|Feasibility studies are still being conducted.|
|Potential methods of circumvention are being explored.|
|Current recommendation: Focus on present opportunities rather than past destinations.|
|What you sought in the past has manifested in the present.|
|Perhaps...this was always the intended path.|
Noah regarded the prompts calmly.
Then he looked out at the surroundings the Polemarch had brought them to.
They seemed to have arrived inside a bronze hall stretching out into the distance.
The architecture was ancient beyond measure.
Inscriptions covered every surface, Phonemes of The First Tongue arranged in patterns that spoke of knowledge accumulated across eternities of study.
The hall led to a massive villa visible in the distance.
Grand columns supported a structure that seemed to have been designed for beings far larger than those currently walking these corridors.
Terraces and balconies extended outward at various levels.
Windows of crystallized language filtered light that came from no discernible source.
Around the hall, seas of blue-gold Phonemes flowed all around!
Rivers of authority that carried meanings Noah could read if he focused.
They swirled past in endless streams, each one representing concepts and ideas that had been refined across eons of Glossarian scholarship.
Noah could already feel his Seal of Harvest buzzing.
There was so much to collect here.
So much knowledge.
So much authority.
So much potential harvest waiting to be gathered by one who knew how to take it.
Skoll rubbed against his leg with enthusiasm.
The transformed Duke’s neon flames flickered happily as he pressed his massive form against Noah’s side.
He didn’t understand where they were or why they had been brought here.
He simply wanted to be close to his Master.
Before them, the Polemarchs turned to face the group.
The Polemarch whose entire body was made up of countless blue-gold pages stepped forward.
Her form rustled with every movement, inscriptions shifting across her surface.
She gave a slight bow that spoke of respect rather than subservience.
"Polemarch Lunaris greets The One Who Laid The Claim."
Her voice emerged like pages turning in an ancient library.
"I brought you here first because out of THE Four, you are the last one to have crossed this Nexus of the Primordial Realms."
Her page-like eyes met his directly.
"THE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, and THE Living Paradox have all crossed here various times in the Infinite Unfurling.
They walked these halls when the Vaults were not yet corrupted.
They contributed to what we have built.
They took what they needed and left marks upon our society that persist to this day."
She paused.
"And while THE Agora of Primordial Judgment has set rules to be followed, THE Change corrupted many things.
There could be a great deal of differences between what they experienced and what you will experience.
Much has altered since those ancient times."
Her form straightened.
"So until everything is ascertained, it is the job of any Glossarian to ensure the safety of THE Glossarian."
BOOM!
THE Glossarian!
Noah gained another distinction so easily!
The words of Lunaris were heavy ones!
She was not merely calling him a member of their philosophical school.
She was designating him as THE Glossarian.
The supreme representative of their Way.
All of THE Four had passed here before him.
Was this the place where they also forged their foundations?
Was this ancient Nexus Point one of the crucibles that had shaped the most powerful beings in Observable Existence?
As he thought of this, he nodded.
Then he turned his gaze toward the distant villa.
"I have a few things that I wish to accomplish here."
His voice came measured and direct.
"I have an Absolute that came in with me.
One Absolute with three separate bodies who has gone ahead to the Paradoxians."

I should have enough Merit to exceed the distinction of a Lochagos, but there seems to be certain conditions I have yet to meet."

chapters.title: Chapter 4774: THE Villa Dei Boscoreale II
paragraphs: Ul’moreth said such words as Noah turned to him with sharp eyes!
4 Absolutes in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment!
Apart from THE Weavers who had just entered!
That meant this domain already contained beings of the highest classification. Beings who had been here long enough to establish themselves.
As Noah thought of this, Lunaris nodded.
"Yes, THE Glossarian. This is where one of the difficulties for you will lie, and also why we brought you here."
She began walking toward the distant villa, gesturing for them to follow.
"In our Agora of Primordial Judgment, there are 4 Absolutes sitting atop each faction."
Her pages rustled as she moved, each step measured and deliberate.

"Khaotikos the Unbound leads the Way of Chaos. He has existed within this domain since The Infinite Unfurling. His mastery of disorder is legendary even among other Absolutes. He is unpredictable in all things, which makes him both dangerous and occasionally beneficial."
They passed through sections of the bronze hall where the Phonemes flowing around them changed in character.

"Ontikos the Unwavering leads the Way of Existence. His dedication to the fundamental principle of being is absolute. He rarely takes action, preferring to simply exist and observe. But when he does act, his authority is overwhelming. He represents the most stable of the four leaders."
The villa grew larger as they approached.

"Paradoxos the Dual leads the Way of Paradox. He... or they... are perhaps the most difficult to understand. Two minds in one form, constantly disagreeing yet always speaking in unison. His relationship with THE Living Paradox is complex. They share a philosophical foundation but not necessarily goals."
Her voice grew more cautious.

"And Glossikos the Articulate leads the Way of The First Tongue. She had been...seeking to also lay The Claim since The Infinite Unfurling. Of all four leaders, she is most likely to support you. But do not mistake likely support for guaranteed alliance."
She stopped before the entrance to the villa.
"All four of these Absolutes carry the status of Strategoi. Supreme Commanders of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment."
Her page-like eyes met Noah’s with gravity.

"The rank of Strategos is the highest achievable within this domain. It exceeds Polemarch in all ways. The Depth Limitation for a Strategos is THE Absolute Depth if the entrant was originally an Absolute, or THE Fundamental Depth as the maximum for non-Absolutes."
She continued explaining.

"Strategoi are the supreme authorities of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment. They govern all aspects of society. They judge the most important debates. They hold the power to grant or deny departure to any being within the domain."
Her pages shifted to display relevant inscriptions.

"To become a Strategos, one must achieve this rank through one of two methods. The first is the Trial of Primordial Judgment. This is a series of debates against all four leaders of the Ways simultaneously. The candidate must demonstrate understanding of Chaos, Existence, Paradox, AND The First Tongue. All four philosophies. All four approaches to reality."
She paused.

"The second method is Unanimous Acclaim. All current Strategoi must unanimously agree that the candidate has contributed something of unprecedented value to the domain. No dissent. No abstention. Complete agreement from all four."
Her expression grew more serious.

"As a Strategos, one gains full restoration of their original Depth. Absolutes who achieved this rank would regain their Absolute power within the domain. They would have complete authority. They could grant departure to any being. They could alter the laws of the domain with the consensus of other Strategoi. And they would gain access to The Primordial Archive."
Her voice dropped.
"The Primordial Archive contains knowledge from before THE Change. It is perhaps the greatest repository of ancient wisdom in all of Observable Existence."
She raised a cautionary hand.

"But Strategoi carry restrictions as well. They cannot leave the domain themselves. They are bound to it. They must defend the domain against existential threats. It is a position of ultimate authority but also ultimate responsibility."
Lunaris looked toward Noah with grave eyes.
"I am...confident Glossikos the Articulate will stand with you, THE Glossarian. Your contribution of nine new Phonemes is unprecedented.."
Her pages shifted uneasily.

"But I am not so sure of the other Strategoi. Khaotikos may support you simply because it would be chaotic to do so. Ontikos may oppose you because change disrupts the stability of existence. And Paradoxos... Paradoxos is impossible to predict."
She gestured toward the villa before them.
"That is why I have brought you here first. To THE Villa Dei Boscoreale."
The massive structure loomed above them, ancient and magnificent.

"This villa requires 9 Polemarchs to open for one they deem to have contributed tremendously to the Glossarians. It is the highest tier vault within THE Agora of Primordial Judgment apart from the one that Strategoi have access to."
Her pages rustled with significance.

"Here, THE Glossarian can use the tools within to elevate your ranking and move toward the standing of a Polemarch. Before that, the goal of collapsing a Paradoxical Absolute, especially under the watch of Paradoxos the Dual..."
Lunaris smiled at this moment.
A teasing look appeared on her pages, unexpected from someone who had been so grave moments before.
"Respectfully, as grand as THE Glossarian is right now, your Depth is very different from those like you."
Her smile widened.
"If sir debated with me on The First Tongue, you would win. Your understanding exceeds mine. Your authority exceeds mine. Your contribution to our Way exceeds anything I could offer in a lifetime."
She tilted her head.
"But if you debated me on raw Depth... sir would lose."
The words were not meant as insult but as honest assessment.
"And I am not confident of being able to collapse an Absolute, even if they haven’t recovered their standing in here."
She met his eyes directly.
"Sir has... lots of work to do."
She gestured toward the villa’s entrance.
"But what is inside there should help. THE Villa Dei Boscoreale contains treasures of utter wonder, and they scale depending on your contribution."
Her pages settled into something like anticipation.
"Will you enter, THE Glossarian?"
Noah looked at the ancient villa with eyes that blazed with possibility.

chapters.title: Chapter 4775: THE Villa Dei Boscoreale III
paragraphs: Noah stood before the golden doors of THE Villa Dei Boscoreale.

Around him, Lunaris, Ophelia, and seven other Polemarchs touched the Merit points on their togas simultaneously. Their authority flowed into the ancient seals protecting this vault, recognizing them as worthy guardians granting access to one they deemed worthy.
The golden doors flung outward and opened!
Ancient light spilled from within, carrying warmth that spoke of treasures accumulated across eons.

The door and the villa itself almost seemed to be purely decorative. The external structure outside was just that, a structure. Inside was a place spanning countless distances. A pocket of reality that existed independent of normal spatial limitations.
Noah went down and played with Skoll’s head.
"I’ll be right back."

The transformed Duke’s tail wagged with enthusiasm despite not understanding what was happening. His neon flames flickered happily at the attention. He was content to wait as long as his Master would return!
Noah then nodded to Lumivara and Ul’moreth.
"Hang on tight for me."
The little fox’s eyes shone with confidence in her Master. Ul’moreth’s veiled gaze held ancient wisdom and sterness at this moment.
His gaze then went to Lunaris and Ophelia.
"Help them become Lochagoi in the meantime if possible. I don’t know how long this will take."
The Glossarians nodded with enthusiasm at this task.
Lunaris’s pages rustled with genuine warmth.
"Good luck, sir."
With such words, Noah took a step toward the golden gate.
And disappeared!

This time, the movement he felt was a smooth one. As if he was simply stepping through a door and entering another room. No violent transportation. No disorienting transition. Just a single step that carried him somewhere else entirely.
Yet vibrant Philologies unfurled all around him!

Dense constructs of linguistic authority swirled past his perception, welcoming him to this ancient place! They carried meanings that spoke of refinement and purification, of foundations being strengthened and impurities being burned away.
He entered a region filled with mist of ancientness and wonder.
|You have arrived in THE Thermae of Cyclic Refinement.|
|The Baths of Foundation.|
Baths?
Noah almost shook his head with incredulity.
The vibrant treasures from THE Vaults of Ginnungagap began with a bath?
Even as he had this thought, he smiled.

He felt all his 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue vibrating with expectation! They resonated with this place as if recognizing something fundamental about its nature! As if they had arrived somewhere that would feed them in ways nothing else could.
And glorious it was!
It was quiet.
Not a single other soul was in sight.
Only a faint golden gateway stood behind him, marking the path he had taken to arrive here.
Noah looked around at what lay before him.
The region resembled ancient bathing complexes of impossible grandeur.

Pools of various sizes filled chambers that stretched beyond normal perception! Some were intimate, designed for solitary reflection. Others were vast enough to qualify as small seas. Steam rose from waters that glowed with blue-gold luminescence, carrying warmth that penetrated not just the body but the very foundations of one’s existence.

Mosaics covering the floors and walls depicted the journey of refinement. Beings entering as rough stones, jagged and unpolished. The same beings emerging as gems of perfect clarity, their edges smooth, their surfaces brilliant.
When he looked up, he saw a ceiling open to an artificial sky.
And that sky displayed the 27 Phonemes of The First Tongue in slow rotation!
The original 18 blazed with authority accumulated across eons.
And his 9... they were already there!
Infinity! Quintessence! Tyranny! Fortune! Advantage! Narrative! Harvest! Hunger! Potential!
They had found their place in the artificial sky, rotating alongside the originals as if they had always belonged there.
Their light filtered down to bless those who bathed below, and Noah could feel the resonance between this place and his own existence.
This seemed to be part of the reason why he was receiving such a grand harvest every second to his foundation!
Apart from his Phonemes being used by Absolutes across Observable Existence, they were also being used HERE! In this ancient vault!
As he stared at the radiant pools in the distance that seemed to call out to his existence, The First Tongue within him received waves of information.
|THE THERMAE OF CYCLIC REFINEMENT|
|The Baths of Foundation|
|This region allows one’s current Depth to undergo Passive Refinement when specific treasures are consumed.|
|The more one consumes, the more rounds of refinement they cross until they attain the highest cycle of Depth Refinement possible within this vault.|
|The treasures will descend based on determined contribution to the Glossarians and THE Agora of Primordial Judgment overall.|
|The Nine Cycles of Katharsis (Purification):|
|1. Prima Katharsis (First Purification): Initial cleansing of foundational impurities. Weight increases by 10%.|
|2. Deutera Katharsis (Second Purification): Compression of scattered authority into denser forms. Weight increases by 20%.|
|3. Trita Katharsis (Third Purification): Harmonization of conflicting aspects within one’s Depth. Weight increases by 30%.|
|4. Tetarta Katharsis (Fourth Purification): Strengthening of the boundaries between Depth levels. Weight increases by 40%.|
|5. Pempte Katharsis (Fifth Purification): Integration of external knowledge into core foundations. Weight increases by 50%.|
|6. Ekti Katharsis (Sixth Purification): Refinement of the connection between Way and Depth. Weight increases by 60%.|
|7. Evdomi Katharsis (Seventh Purification): Approaching the theoretical limits of current classification. Weight increases by 75%.|
|8. Ogdoi Katharsis (Eighth Purification): Transcending normal parameters for current Depth. Weight increases by 90%.|

|9. Enati Katharsis (Ninth Purification / THE Wheel of Foundation): The absolute pinnacle of refinement possible without advancing to a higher Depth. Weight increases by 100%, effectively doubling one’s foundation at current classification.|
|Historical Note:|
|Most Polemarchs who enter THE Villa Dei Boscoreale achieve only 1-3 cycles of Katharsis.|
|Reaching the 5th cycle is considered exceptional.|
|The 7th cycle is legendary.|
|The 9th cycle has been achieved by only... a select few.|
The Nine Cycles of Katharsis flowed before his mind!
Noah jubilantly took more steps within, already liking this place very much.

Unlike others, with his Formless Depth, he could elevate the foundation of his Surface and Intermediate Depth even now. There was still a ways to go before those foundations reached their theoretical maximum.
Exceeding the foundation that THE Creature or THE Living Paradox built was nice and all.
But why not exceed it tremendously?
Why not outstrip it completely?!

Pempte Katharsis (Fifth Purification): Integration of external knowledge into core foundations.
Weight increases by 50%.|
Ekti Katharsis (Sixth Purification): Refinement of the connection between Way and Depth.
Weight increases by 60%.|
Evdomi Katharsis (Seventh Purification): Approaching the theoretical limits of current classification.
Weight increases by 75%.|
Ogdoi Katharsis (Eighth Purification): Transcending normal parameters for current Depth.
Weight increases by 90%.|
Enati Katharsis (Ninth Purification / THE Wheel of Foundation): The absolute pinnacle of refinement possible without advancing to a higher Depth.
Weight increases by 100%, effectively doubling one’s foundation at current classification.|
|Historical Note:|
|Most Polemarchs who enter THE Villa Dei Boscoreale achieve only 1-3 cycles of Katharsis.|
|Reaching the 5th cycle is considered exceptional.|
|The 7th cycle is legendary.|
|The 9th cycle has been achieved by only... a select few.|
The Nine Cycles of Katharsis flowed before his mind!
Noah jubilantly took more steps within, already liking this place very much.
Unlike others, with his Formless Depth, he could elevate the foundation of his Surface and Intermediate Depth even now.
There was still a ways to go before those foundations reached their theoretical maximum.
Exceeding the foundation that THE Creature or THE Living Paradox built was nice and all.
But why not exceed it tremendously?
Why not outstrip it completely?!

chapters.title: Chapter 4776: THE Villa Dei Boscoreale IV
paragraphs: So he stepped deeper toward the vibrant pools.

Above him, the artificial sky seemed to shimmer with anticipation. The contribution he had made would allow the descent of loot for him to consume in these pools to refine his foundation even further.
As he neared the pools, his existence was literally fed more information through The First Tongue!
|TREASURES OF THE THERMAE|
|The treasures in this region take the form of consumable items that must be ingested while bathing in the pools.|
|Each treasure contributes to progression through the cycles of Katharsis.|
|Examples of Known Treasures:|
|Ambrosia Pellets: Small golden spheres that taste of honey and starlight. Contributes 1% toward next Katharsis cycle. Classification: Common.|
|Nectar of the Muses: Liquid silver that flows upward when poured. Contributes 5% toward next Katharsis cycle. Enhances comprehension during refinement. Classification: Uncommon.|
|Ichor Crystals: Crystallized essence that pulses with inner light. Contributes 10% toward next Katharsis cycle. Temporarily elevates perception during consumption. Classification: Rare.|
|The Apples of the Hesperides: Golden fruits that never rot, warm to the touch. Contributes 25% toward next Katharsis cycle. One of the most sought-after treasures. Classification: Very Rare.|

|Prometheus’s Ember: A fragment of an infinite flame contained in a small bronze vessel. Contributes 50% toward next Katharsis cycle. Burns away impurities with divine fire. Classification: Extremely Rare.|
|The Cornucopia Draught: Liquid that contains the essence of endless abundance. Instantly completes current Katharsis cycle regardless of progress. Classification: Legendary.|
|Kronos’s Crystallized Moment: A frozen instant of time given physical form. Completes current cycle AND provides 50% progress toward the next. Only 3 have ever been found. Classification: Mythical.|
The treasures ranged from common to mythical!
One may ask... just what would the one who contributed 9 new letters of The First Tongue obtain in a treasure vault of Glossarians that protected and studied The First Tongue itself?
Noah had a brilliant smile as he thought of this.
He arrived before an incandescent obsidian-blue pool.
The moment his eyes landed on it, its details unveiled before him!
|You have arrived before The Pool of Lethe (Forgetting).|
|Function: Helps one forget inefficient patterns in their foundation, allowing for reconstruction.|
|Stepping into any pool will also allow for the generation and acceptance of treasures based on the quality and immensity of your contributions.|
|This pool is particularly effective for those seeking to rebuild foundations that have accumulated flaws over time.|
A glorious pool lay before him!
Noah’s steps didn’t stop.
He went down the glistening blue-gold stairs that led into the vast pool. It looked more like a mini sea than a bathing area, stretching outward until steam and distance obscured its far edges.
And it felt...
"Well damn..."
It felt fucking hot!

The steam emanating from the Pool of Lethe did not do justice to the level of heat the waters held! Just halfway in, Noah felt the scorching temperatures penetrate into his skin and toward his existence.
The heat sought any and all inefficiencies to eradicate!
It burned through patterns that had calcified without his notice.
It seared away assumptions that had become limitations.
And while it did so...
Noah fully submerged his body!
The obsidian-gold waters surged around his upper chest, lapping against his muscular form with heat that would have vaporized normal THE Surface Depth entities!
He reclined back gloriously, finding a position that allowed him to relax while the waters worked their magic.
He raised his head to see the shimmering artificial sky.
The 27 Phonemes continued their slow rotation, and the sky itself began shining gold! No doubt allowing many vibrant treasures to manifest soon.
But...
At such a time.
The obsidian waters a few meters away from him churned.
His eyes became sharp.
He looked over with the alertness of one who had survived countless ambushes.
And shockingly... a vibrant head of hair began to rise from beneath the surface!
An...entity.
The only way Noah could describe the emerging head and figure was that of a Dryad.
Her hair was composed of flowing vines and leaves that seemed perpetually in bloom, colors shifting between emerald and gold with each movement.
Her features were delicate but ancient. Her skin had a faint bark-like texture that spoke of connection to primordial nature itself!

Her upper body emerged from the waters with casual grace, revealing form that was simultaneously organic and grand. Shoulders that seemed to grow from living wood. Arms that flowed like branches reaching toward sunlight. A presence that spoke of forests that had existed before differentiation gave them names.
And her eyes!
They had a brilliant obsidian-blue swirl of immensity and glory.
Depths that contained ages of accumulated wisdom! Light that spoke of authority earned through eons of dedication! Patterns that seemed to write and rewrite themselves with each passing moment.
While looking at her, Noah could have sworn he felt the aura of a Muspeli Lifeform.
That particular resonance of fire and transformation that marked those born in Muspelheim.
But this being whom he did not sense or observe before they showed themselves... she gazed at him calmly.
Her eyes were filled with analysis that missed nothing. Every detail of his existence was being cataloged. Or she was trying to anyways.
Then she waved her hand.
A wall of pure Mana formed behind her!
She leaned back on it casually, just like Noah, her arms outstretched behind her in a pose of complete relaxation.
Steam swirled around her form, obscuring and revealing in equal measure!
And Noah... could not sense any aura from her at all.
Nothing.
As if she simply didn’t exist from a perceptual standpoint.
And yet Noah felt the same perception from her that he had now felt from a few others.
That stifling sensation of oppression.
That heaviness that felt undeniable!
That brilliance as if one was standing too close to the sun.
It was without a doubt the brilliance of an Absolute!
An Absolute that at this moment looked at Noah with eyes that held ancient amusement.
"You come into someone’s spring unannounced, and you don’t even introduce yourself?"
Her words were oppressive.

Her voice carried authority that made the waters around them ripple in response! The artificial sky above seemed to dim slightly in deference to her presence! Even the heat of the Pool of Lethe seemed to intensify, as if recognizing its master.
Her gaze was even more so!
Those obsidian-blue eyes bore into Noah with weight that would have crushed most beings into submission. They demanded acknowledgment! They required respect!
Yet Noah stared back calmly.
His voice came out soon after, steady and unshaken.
"You must be Glossikos the Articulate."
BOOM!
Glossikos!
An entity that was one of the four Absolutes in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment!
The supreme leader of the Glossarians!

chapters.title: Chapter 4777: Leaders and Kings I
paragraphs: Glossikos.
Noah looked at this being with a calm gaze.

She seemed to be trying to utilize her immensity to see if he would crack. To see if he would show weakness. To see if the weight of an Absolute pressing against his existence would make him flinch or bow or reveal some vulnerability she could exploit.
But Noah had stood before THE Creature.
He had faced THE Primordial Chaos in the Infinite Unfurling.
He had been pursued by THE Weavers across the Wastes of THE Fallout.
One more Absolute, even one bathing in the same pool as him, was not enough to make him falter.
Moments later, Glossikos spoke.
"How did you do it?"
Her voice came grand and oppressive, carrying power that made the waters around them ripple in response.
"How did you take your position among THE Four?"
Her obsidian-blue eyes bore into him with intensity that would have crushed lesser beings into submission.

"I learned everything about The First Tongue. I spent eons perfecting my understanding of every Phoneme, every Logos, every Philology that could be constructed from its foundations. I pushed further than any other scholar in the history of the Glossarians."
Her voice grew heavier.
"And I could still never lay a claim on it. Not completely."
Something flickered in those ancient eyes.

"Every time that I tried, I felt like I had to take a step. And the moment that I did, the immensity of The First Tongue itself would come crashing down on me completely. As if the language knew I was reaching for something I wasn’t meant to grasp."
Her smile became dangerous.
"So how did someone so much weaker than me manage to do what I could not do?"
She tilted her head, studying him like a predator considering prey.
"And... if I were to take a gulp and eat you up right now... would I have whatever you had that allowed you to lay this claim?"
BOOM!
She smiled dangerously as she finished saying these words!
The threat hung in the air between them, heavy with the promise of violence that an Absolute could deliver without effort.
Noah looked at her for a few seconds.

Then he stretched his arms out behind him even more, getting even more comfortable in the pool. He actually looked up to the artificial sky where vibrant treasures had begun to form, golden light coalescing into shapes that promised power beyond measure.
"Now that I have integrated my own designed Phonemes across The First Tongue permeating through Existence, the level of control that I have over it is rising."
His voice came casual and glorious, as if discussing the weather rather than responding to a death threat from an Absolute.

"Not too long ago, I applied a Thesis that allowed me to negate the usage of The First Tongue for a Fundamental Depth entity and a Half-Step Absolute entity. And then somewhat on an Absolute, but there wasn’t much time there..."
He continued gazing at the sky.
"Right now, I feel like I can apply this Thesis, if I so wish, and deny the usage of The First Tongueabsolutelyto even an Absolute entity."
His eyes finally returned to meet hers.
"Now, I am sure that you would have other means to move against me apart from The First Tongue. Your sheer Weight and Depth would allow you options that don’t rely on linguistic authority."
His smile matched hers in danger.

"But I don’t think you ever wish to experience the Rejection from the letters of Existence that you have been so closely studying and perfecting the usage of for eons now. Something that you have been trying to lay a claim on."
He let those words settle.
"If I tried to think of it myself, it would feel unbearable if a day ever came when Mana itself rejected me. Do you want that?"
She had begun the conversation with a threat.
So he simply threw out a threat himself, even though he was facing an Absolute entity.
His words were heavy, carrying the weight of someone who could actually deliver on the promise they implied.
Glossikos regarded him for a long moment.
The dangerous smile on her face shifted. Changed. Became something that looked almost like... acceptance.
"The one who took the position that I sought all my life..."
Her voice came softer now, though no less weighted.
"I am glad to see that it is someone with a pair of balls."
She laughed, and the sound was surprisingly warm despite the tension that had filled the air moments before.
"It would have been even more unbearable for me to say The First Tongue was claimed by someone feeble of mind and stature."
Her obsidian-blue eyes sparkled with something that might have been approval.
"You seem big. You feel big."
At these words, Noah looked back at the Dryad with eyes that held no false modesty.

"I am big. Bigger than many across Observable Existence dismiss me to be. I won’t posture and brag at this moment as the best time to do so will be when I stand atop the cliff that shows all others below me. Until then..."
BOOM!
A heavy silence settled between them.

As if they were staring each other down across the steaming waters of the Pool of Lethe. Two entities who had both dedicated their existences to The First Tongue, now measuring each other’s worth through gaze alone.
A moment later, Glossikos sighed.
The tension didn’t disappear, but it transformed into something more bearable. More... productive.
"Your eyes are most similar to... THE Primordial Chaos."
Her words came contemplative.
"Unpredictable. Grand."
Noah’s eyes flashed.
This was the first time that he had been compared to THE Primordial Chaos.
Most of the time, others drew parallels between him and THE Creature.
But THE Primordial Chaos?
That was a different comparison entirely.
Glossikos continued, not waiting for him to respond.
"Go through the Cycles of Katharsis. We can talk meanwhile."
She settled back against her wall of pure Mana, getting comfortable as if preparing for an extended conversation.
"Even though I lost, I still want to see if I am better than you in The First Tongue."
"Oh?"
Noah blinked toward this entity.
"Are you able to make new letters of The First Tongue?"
Glossikos blinked calmly and replied.
"No?"
And Noah replied once more.
"Then you are not better than me in The First Tongue. You can’t make any new letters, while I already made 9."
He shrugged with casual dismissal.
"So let’s not waste time there."
BOOM!
His words were calm and almost commanding!
Glossikos smiled dangerously in response!
"Ho? You seem to have gone from bold to commanding."
Her voice carried edges that promised consequences.
"Don’t forget where you are and where I am. Even if you represent what I want the most, I can still make life miserable for you."
Noah looked at her.
Then he shook his head with surety.
"But you won’t."
His voice came absolute and unwavering.
"And I’m sure of that as I’m sure that the first treasure I will grasp will be... the highest tiered one."
His eyes met hers directly.
"I am sure of that because I am The First Tongue. And a follower of it, regardless of their power, must follow me."
The words landed like declarations of absolute truth!
And then Noah raised his hand toward the artificial sky.
The golden light that had been coalescing above responded to his gesture!
From the shimmering expanse where the 27 Phonemes rotated in eternal dance, the first treasure began to float down based on his contribution!
It descended with the inevitability of prophecy being fulfilled!
And it was...
Kronos’s Crystallized Moment!
A frozen instant of time given physical form!

It appeared as a small sphere of impossible clarity, no larger than a fist, yet containing depths that seemed to stretch into infinity. Within its crystalline structure, light moved in ways that defied normal observation...simultaneously frozen and flowing, static and dynamic, past and future occupying the same space.
The sphere pulsed with temporal authority that made the Pool of Lethe’s waters still momentarily around it.
This was a Mythical-tier treasure.
Only 3 had ever been found in the entire history of THE Villa Dei Boscoreale.
And now a fourth descended to Noah’s waiting hand.
He grasped it.

The moment his fingers closed around Kronos’s Crystallized Moment, he felt time itself acknowledge his touch. Eons compressed into instants. Instants stretched into eternities. The boundaries between moments blurred and sharpened simultaneously.
Then he swallowed it.
Without hesitation. Without ceremony. Without the reverence that most beings would show to something so impossibly rare.
He simply put it in his mouth and let it slide down his throat.
HUUM!
The effect was immediate and overwhelming!

His muscles undulated and vibrated with energy that transcended normal physical response! Every fiber of his being began to compress and refine! The Pool of Lethe churned around him, waters that had been calm now surging with the force of the transformation occurring within!
The inefficient patterns in his foundation were erased from the timeline of his existence entirely! As if they had never been there to begin with! As if his foundation had always been pristine!
His immensity began to rise!
The Cycle of Katharsis that would have required 100% progress to complete?
Kronos’s Crystallized Moment completed it instantly!
And provided 50% progress toward the next!
Prima Katharsis would be achieved!
And Deutera Katharsis would be at 50% progress!
And he wasn’t even worried about utilizing it now or later. Because he was also sure that...more would come.
Opposite him, Glossikos was looking at him with very sharp eyes.
Those obsidian-blue orbs had widened slightly, the first genuine surprise she had shown since revealing herself here!

Within its crystalline structure, light moved in ways that defied normal observation...simultaneously frozen and flowing, static and dynamic, past and future occupying the same space.
The sphere pulsed with temporal authority that made the Pool of Lethe’s waters still momentarily around it.
This was a Mythical-tier treasure.
Only 3 had ever been found in the entire history of THE Villa Dei Boscoreale.
And now a fourth descended to Noah’s waiting hand.
He grasped it.
The moment his fingers closed around Kronos’s Crystallized Moment, he felt time itself acknowledge his touch.
Eons compressed into instants.
Instants stretched into eternities.
The boundaries between moments blurred and sharpened simultaneously.
Then he swallowed it.
Without hesitation.
Without ceremony.
Without the reverence that most beings would show to something so impossibly rare.
He simply put it in his mouth and let it slide down his throat.
HUUM!
The effect was immediate and overwhelming!
His muscles undulated and vibrated with energy that transcended normal physical response!
Every fiber of his being began to compress and refine!
The Pool of Lethe churned around him, waters that had been calm now surging with the force of the transformation occurring within!
The inefficient patterns in his foundation were erased from the timeline of his existence entirely!
As if they had never been there to begin with!
As if his foundation had always been pristine!
His immensity began to rise!
The Cycle of Katharsis that would have required 100% progress to complete?
Kronos’s Crystallized Moment completed it instantly!
And provided 50% progress toward the next!
Prima Katharsis would be achieved!
And Deutera Katharsis would be at 50% progress!
And he wasn’t even worried about utilizing it now or later.
Because he was also sure that...more would come.
Opposite him, Glossikos was looking at him with very sharp eyes.
Those obsidian-blue orbs had widened slightly, the first genuine surprise she had shown since revealing herself here!

chapters.title: Chapter 4778: Leaders and Kings II
paragraphs: How could he describe the feeling of going through the Cycles of Katharsis?

The Pool of Lethe worked all around him, its scorching waters penetrating into every layer of his existence. It sought out the inefficiencies that had calcified over time. The assumptions that had become limitations. The patterns that served no purpose but had settled into his foundation simply because they had been there long enough to feel permanent.
And Kronos’s Crystallized Moment acted like a hammer and fire to cleanse his existence.
It was not gentle or particularly pleasant.

It felt like his very being was being melted down and reforged. Like every Seal of Absolute Tongue within him was being pulled apart, examined for flaws, and reconstructed with precision that transcended mortal craftsmanship. His muscles trembled not from exertion but from fundamental reconstruction. His bones hummed with frequencies that spoke of foundations being compressed into denser, more perfect forms.
Prima Katharsis burned away the surface impurities.

It was like shedding a skin he hadn’t realized was dead. Like exhaling breath he had been holding for eons without knowing. His Weight at the Surface Depth solidified into something harder, sharper, more absolute than it had been moments before.
Deutera Katharsis went deeper.

It compressed scattered authority into denser forms.The twenty-seven Seals within him, already impossibly heavy, grew heavier still. They pressed against the boundaries of his existence with weight that would have crushed lesser beings into paste. But Noah was not a lesser being. He was THE Genesis Monarch. And his foundations welcomed the compression like starving wolves welcoming meat.
|KATHARSIS PROGRESSION CONFIRMED|
|Prima Katharsis: COMPLETE|
|Initial cleansing of foundational impurities achieved.|
|Weight increase at current Depth: 10%|
|Deutera Katharsis: 50% PROGRESS|
|Compression of scattered authority into denser forms: ONGOING|
|Estimated completion upon consumption of additional treasures.|
|The Weight of your Surface Depth and Intermediate Depth continue to elevate alongside your elevating foundation.|
|Current Surface Depth Weight: 192/100th of baseline Absolute parameters (previously 175/100th)|
|Current Intermediate Depth Weight: 220/100th of baseline Absolute parameters (previously 200/100th)|
|Your foundations are approaching theoretical limits.|
|THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons confirms: Pages remain blank. Ceiling not found. Continue building.|
As all of this occurred, Noah kept his eyes on Glossikos.

This terrifying entity maintained her calm smile throughout his transformation. Those obsidian-blue eyes watched him with the patient attention of someone who had witnessed countless beings attempt what he was doing now.
As big as he talked, he also knew Absolutes were unpredictable.

She could have done something crazy regardless of his warnings. She could have decided that eating him was worth the risk of rejection from The First Tongue. She could have simply overwhelmed him with Depth and Weight that no Thesis could fully counter.
But against Absolutes, he had gotten the act of bullshitting down to an art.

If one simply talked big, especially in his position with the standing he had, things were a lot better this way. Confidence bred hesitation in opponents. Certainty made enemies second-guess themselves.
What did they say?
Fake it until you made it?
Even though he wasn’t an Absolute, he simply needed to continue throwing his weight around until he was one.

Even though his power did not match the title, the distinction of The One Who Laid The Claim to The First Tongue gave him his own unique power. It contributed to his Formless Depth, making him unable to be placed into any single classification. Neither Surface nor Intermediate nor Fundamental could fully contain what he was becoming.
He existed between categories.
And in that liminal space, he found advantages that conventional power could never provide.
As he was thinking all this...
Glossikos spoke.
"You contributed 9 brand new letters to The First Tongue."
Her voice came measured and contemplative, eyes still fixed on him with that unreadable smile.
"In THE Villa Dei Boscoreale, not even THE Creature would be blessed as much as you."
She tilted her head slightly.
"I wouldn’t be surprised if you do get more Kronos’s Crystallized Moments. And if you don’t complete all the Cycles of Katharsis after receiving such treasures..."
Her smile sharpened.
"You would truly be a useless bum."

As she said this, she leaned back on the Pool of Lethe and began to float fully once more. Her body submerged slowly, the obsidian-gold waters swallowing her form inch by inch until only her face remained free, staring up at the artificial sky with the lazy contentment of someone who had all the time in existence.
Noah looked at her.
Then he asked what he had been wondering since learning of the Absolutes bound to this place.
"You and the other Absolutes here... just what is going on?"
His voice came direct and probing.
"THE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, and THE Living Paradox came here and left. You are Absolutes just like them. Why are you bound to this realm?"
His eyes narrowed with calculation.
"Are you feeling particularly talkative to share anything about this?"
What secret did THE Corrupted Vault of Ginnungagap truly hold?
What kept four Absolutes imprisoned in a domain they could not leave?
What price had been paid, and by whom?
Glossikos smiled while staring at the artificial sky.
And ridiculously, as if to punctuate the absurdity of this conversation, another Kronos’s Crystallized Moment began to float down toward Noah.
A second Mythical-tier treasure.
Descending to him because his contribution warranted it.
Glossikos watched it fall with eyes that held ancient exhaustion.
"As long as one is not an Absolute, they do not understand the vastness of Existence."
Her voice came different now. Heavier. Laden with weight that spoke of secrets carried for far too long.
"Or the results of choices that many beings make across it."
She paused.
"The results of the actions of THE Creature when he made his Belly of Existence. The results of the actions of THE Living Paradox when he ushered THE Fallout."
Her laugh was bitter.
"You would think they would learn. You would think they would stop."
The second Kronos’s Crystallized Moment continued its descent.
"They never do."

chapters.title: Chapter 4779: Leaders and Kings III
paragraphs: Her obsidian-blue eyes found his.
"You Four... THE Four... always want more. Fucking insatiable monsters you are."
The words landed like accusations.

"It almost makes me wonder why you all were the ones to lay the claims, when all you do is change things again and again. When all you do is make things harder for everyone who has to live with the consequences of your decisions."
She exhaled slowly.
"We... those of us here in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment... and in other places like this... we exist to act as glue. To hold a few critical things together."
Her voice grew colder.

"The Primordial Realms are a unique part of Observable Existence. They share the secrets of its emergence. The foundations upon which everything else was built. Ginnungagap. Muspelheim. Alfheimr. Jotunheim. All of them connected through Nexus Points that predate the modern understanding of reality."
She stared at the artificial sky with something that might have been hatred.
"We are bound to places like this forever precisely because you Four exist and do the things that you do."
The second Kronos’s Crystallized Moment reached Noah’s waiting hand.
"We all... hate you all so, so much."
The words were spoken with the casualness of stating objective fact.
"But it is a unique hate. I do not hate what you stand for, for example. The First Tongue is beautiful. Mana is necessary. Chaos has its place. Paradox... well, Paradox is Paradox."
Her smile became something sharp and wounded.
"But the things you all do are so detestable. And they bring us all ever closer to extinction. All for the sake of..."
She paused.
"Higher Scales."
The word hung in the air.
"Scales."
Repeated with growing venom.
"Scales."
And again.
"Scales."
Her voice dropped to something barely above a whisper.
"Man, fuck you all and your Scales."
BOOM!
The words landed with weight that exceeded their apparent simplicity!
Noah held the second Kronos’s Crystallized Moment in his hand, feeling its temporal authority pulse against his palm.
Higher Scales.
THE Four pursuing something beyond their current positions.
And beings like Glossikos paying the price for that pursuit.
He looked at this Absolute who had just cursed him and everything he represented, and he found that he didn’t have an immediate response.
Because what could he say?
He was pursuing Higher Scales himself.
He was changing things again and again.
He was, by her definition, exactly the kind of insatiable monster she described.
And yet...
He swallowed the second Kronos’s Crystallized Moment.
Because regardless of what she thought, regardless of what any of them thought...
He would not stop.
He could not stop.
The powerless were ground to dust in the endless weavings of time.
And herefusedto be powerless.
Even if it meant the entire Observable Existence learned to hate him for it.
But...
Hatred!
There was actually genuine hatred in the eyes of Glossikos the Articulate.
Did the other three Absolutes in here feel the same way?
If they did feel like this... why didn’t they actively move against beings like him and THE Creature?
Noah looked at her as he asked directly.
"Are you going to tell me any concrete details, or keep the air of mystery? I’ve gotten the information that you all are bound here and protect this place."
His eyes narrowed with calculation.
"Who are you protecting it from? Besides THE Four, what else is there that only Absolutes know about?"
He asked such a simple question.
And yet Glossikos smiled toward him with something between amusement and contempt.
"Maybe we are protecting it from the likes of you. The disruptors and chaotic things all of you are."
She laughed, but there was no warmth in the sound.

"I actually ponder every day how all signs point to THE Primordial Chaos being the strongest. Because all of you bring so much chaos that he can only benefit. And yet THE Creature and THE Living Paradox did their own designs to somehow keep their edge."
She waved her hand dismissively.
"Ah, it doesn’t matter to you now. You won’t be able to do anything now. You need to be an Absolute, otherwise it is meaningless."
Noah looked at her with a defiant glare.
The second Kronos’s Crystallized Moment permeated across his existence, its temporal authority weaving through every fiber of his being.
The transformation was even more intense this time.

His existence reconstructed itself from foundational principles upward. The twenty-seven Seals of Absolute Tongue within him blazed with incandescent brilliance that made the waters of the Pool of Lethe boil around his form. His skin seemed to glow from within as compressed authority sought release through every pore. His muscles trembled with the force of power being packed into denser and denser configurations.
Deutera Katharsis completed with the force of a dam breaking.

Scattered authority that had been spread across his existence compressed into forms so dense that they approached singularities of concentrated power. His Weight at every Depth solidified into something that felt less like flesh and more like existential constants given physical form.
Trita Katharsis followed immediately after.

The harmonization of conflicting aspects within his Depth created resonances that made the entire Thermae tremble. Elements of his foundation that had existed in tension now aligned with perfect precision. The result was a whole that exceeded the sum of its parts by orders of magnitude.
|Deutera Katharsis: COMPLETE|
|Compression of scattered authority into denser forms: ACHIEVED|

|Trita Katharsis: COMPLETE|

|These numbers continue to climb.|
|POOL EFFICIENCY NOTIFICATION|
|The effectiveness of The Pool of Lethe has been fully extracted.|
|All foundational impurities that could be forgotten have been forgotten.|
|All inefficient patterns that could be erased have been erased.|
